title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第三季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest - 2026 Q3

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件与一般动态。上季度立案 17 件、结案 10 件，作出 6 项禁赛、3 项警告，1 件未采取措施。

已发布公开报告的案件

  • WIC 与其他团队合作，结束了一项历时数月、针对某国社群问题的调查，导致多名 WCA 代表降职，一名组织者受到重大处分。详情见论坛帖子。
  • 一名选手取得高水平最少步成绩，引起部分顶尖选手怀疑。其随后向公众及通过邮件向 WIC 承认成绩作弊。比赛代表取消了相关成绩，简短调查后给予禁赛。详情见报告。
  • 一名选手在 2025 年取得突出 Skewb 成绩，包括单次洲纪录。一群顶尖选手报告疑虑后，经数月调查，WIC 认定这些成绩不可能由人类完成，涉及某种规则违反，可能是意外，也可能是故意。因此取消两项成绩，并追溯撤销一项 Skewb 洲纪录。详情见报告。

同期其他案件

本季度处理了多起提前停表事件：

  1. 一名选手被报告在比赛中故意提前停表。联系后其非常配合，还承认了代表未发现或未取消的其他情况。鉴于比赛经验相对不足且诚实，仅给予较短禁赛，并取消成绩。
  2. 另一场比赛发生类似事件。考虑年龄较小、仅涉及少量轮次，WIC 选择警告并取消相关成绩。两案相近，但年龄是后一案没有禁赛的重要因素。
  3. WIC 注意到今年已报告多起提前停表。未来引入四触点模式有望改善问题，但仍请担任裁判的读者认真警觉地观察还原，确保正确停表。
  • 有选手在场馆内将魔方还原成带仇恨含义的符号图案。联系后他们承担责任并道歉，均获警告。
  • 两名选手被发现串通，为彼此取得相对其他选手的优势，其中一人被直接观察到故意错误打乱另一人的魔方。两人均被禁赛，成绩被取消。
  • 一名选手向 WIC 报告在比赛中受到欺凌和骚扰。虽然多数行为发生在 WIC 管辖范围外，但部分行为确实在比赛中发生并被观察到。实施行为的选手获警告。
  • 一名选手因不当行为被场馆管理方请离，多人向 WIC 报告。询问多名选手和代表后，WIC 确认该行为严重，且至少在另一场比赛也发生过。因此禁止其参赛及到场。

一般动态

  • Shain Papalotl Longbehn（2020LONG05）近期卸任高级成员。衷心感谢其过去四年工作，特别感谢担任 WIC 和 WDC 负责人期间的出色贡献。
  • Lars Johan Folde（2018FOLD01）获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • 新设保护小组已开始工作，由少量专业人员处理选手保护问题，并按必要知情原则处理个案。相关引导信息即将完善。如对 WCA 认可活动中儿童及处于风险中的选手的安全、福祉有疑问或忧虑，可联系 safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 17 cases and closed 10. This resulted in 6 bans and 3 warnings, while 1 case ended with no action.

Below, you can find summaries of cases we have published public reports for:

  • The WIC concluded a months-long investigation into community issues in a country, in collaboration with other teams. This resulted in the demotions of multiple WCA delegates and an organizer receiving a significant sanction. Further details can be found in this forum post, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved high-level FMC results which arouse the suspicion of some top competitors. The competitor subsequently confessed to the public and to the WIC via email that they had cheated their results. The competitor had these results disqualified by competition delegates, and after a brief investigation received a ban. More information can be found in this report, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved notable Skewb results, which included a continental record single, in 2025. After a group of top competitors reported these concerns to the WIC and after a months long investigation, we concluded the results were not humanly possible to achieve and involved some sort of regulation violation, whether accidental or intentional. Due to this, the WIC elected to disqualify both results, retroactively reverting a continental record in Skewb. More information can be found at this report, linked here.

Here were other cases the WIC worked on during this time:

  • The WIC dealt with multiple cases this quarter involving early timer stops:
  1. A competitor was reported to be engaging in deliberate early timer stops at a competition. When contacted, the competitor was extremely cooperative and admitted to other occurrences that were not observed/already disqualified by the competition delegates. Given their relative inexperience competing and their honesty, they were issued only a brief ban and solves were disqualified.
  2. A similar case occurred at another competition. Given their young age and the fact that this occurred only over a small amount of rounds, the WIC elected to issue a warning and disqualified the relevant solves. Although we understand that these two cases are relatively similar, the age of the competitor was a large factor into why a ban was not issued in the above case.
  3. The WIC would like to note we have already seen multiple cases with early timer stops being reported this year. While this problem will improve with the eventual introduction of 4-pad mode, we would like to ask readers who serve as competition judges to be vigilant and attentive while watching competitor’s solves to ensure they are properly stopping the timer.
  • Competitors at a competition were observed solving patterns depicting symbols with hateful connotations onto their cubes inside of the venue. The competitors, when contacted, accepted responsibility and apologized for their actions. Warnings were issued to the competitors involved.
  • Two competitors were found to be colluding with one another to give each other advantages over other competitors, including one competitor being directly observed deliberately misscrambling the other competitor’s puzzles. Both of these competitors were issued bans, with results disqualified.
  • A competitor reported to the WIC that they were experiencing bullying and harassment at a competition. Although most of this behavior occurred in areas outside of the scope of the WIC, some of this behavior was present and observed at competitions. The competitor engaging in this behavior was issued a warning.
  • A competitor was removed from a competition by venue management for inappropriate behavior, and their behavior from this competition was reported to the WIC by multiple individuals. The WIC confirmed the existence of this behavior as significant and occurring at at least one other competition after requesting comment from multiple competitors and delegates. The competitor was issued a competing and attendance ban.

General WIC updates:

  • Shain Papalotl Longbehn (2020LONG05) recently stepped down from his positions as WIC Senior Member. We are immensely grateful for all the work Shain has done over the past four years as a WIC member, and we would like to make special mention of his outstanding contribution as WIC Leader and WDC Leader.
  • Lars Johan Folde (2018FOLD01) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.
  • The WIC has recently created a new subteam, the safeguarding subteam, which has commenced work. This subteam will allow for a small group of specialists to handle concerns regarding competitor safeguarding, and for these cases to be handled on a need to know basis. While signposting to this new group will be improved soon, you may contact this safeguarding group at safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org with any questions or concerns that you may have regarding child and at-risk competitor’s safety and wellbeing at WCA-recognized events.

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第二季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest - 2026 Q2

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件与一般动态。上季度立案 10 件、结案 12 件，作出 2 项禁赛、4 项警告，6 件未采取措施。

  • 多次接报一名选手在比赛环境中扰乱秩序，志愿者表示，这使他们对承办该选手擅长的项目感到不安，因此展开调查。WIC 联系选手，讨论调解行为问题的办法，但认为其回应不令人满意，给予短期禁赛。
  • 因怀疑某选手盲拧表现与从眼罩下偷看相符而展开调查。依据视频及代表证词，WIC 认定正式尝试中确有偷看，并认为其说明并非完全真实。相关可疑成绩被取消，并给予正式警告。
  • 收到报告，选手以具有伤害含义的不当符号开玩笑，假装进行正式尝试，却使用摆成这些符号图案而非正式打乱的魔方。负责此事的选手道歉并获正式警告。

一般动态

近期招募后，8 名新成员加入：

  • Blake Thompson（2010THOM03）；
  • Carmen Teo Bin Jie（2012JIET01）；
  • Joran Busser（2022BUSS04）；
  • Jordan Halford（2022HALF02）；
  • Kajtek Kwiatkowski（2023KWIA01）；
  • Lars Johan Folde（2018FOLD01）；
  • Rocío Fernández Usero（2014USER01）；
  • Tyler Williams（2017WILL05）。

Cade Beck（2018BECK05）获任行为小组负责人，Amanda Schmid（2017SCHM12）获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。

Carter Kucala（2015KUCA01）、Glib Vedmid（2016VEDM01）、Yash Budhiraja（2018BUDH01）、Yuji Yoshida（2015YOSH01）近期卸任成员，感谢他们的工作。

如有问题，欢迎给 WIC 发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 10 cases and closed 12. This resulted in 2 bans and 4 warnings, while 6 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • An investigation was opened after repeated reports of a competitor being disruptive in competition settings, which Volunteers shared with the WIC made them uncomfortable with hosting events the competitor specialized in. The WIC reached out to the competitor and discussed means of mediating their behavioural issues but found their responses unsatisfactory. The competitor received a short ban.
  • An investigation was opened after suspicions that a competitor’s behaviour in blindfolded events was consistent with the possibility that they were looking under the blindfold. Based on video evidence and delegate testimony, the WIC concluded that peeking did indeed occur in these official attempts. The WIC also believes the competitor’s account of the situation was not entirely truthful. The solves in suspicion were disqualified and the competitor was issued a formal warning.
  • The WIC received a report detailing competitors making jokes involving inappropriate symbols with hurtful connotations. It was detailed that these competitors had pretended to conduct official attempts with puzzles showing patterns of these symbols rather than official scrambles. The competitor responsible apologized and was issued a formal warning.

General WIC updates:

After a recent application period, 8 new members have joined the WCA Integrity Committee:

  • Blake Thompson (2010THOM03)
  • Carmen Teo Bin Jie (2012JIET01)
  • Joran Busser (2022BUSS04)
  • Jordan Halford (2022HALF02)
  • Kajtek Kwiatkowski (2023KWIA01)
  • Lars Johan Folde (2018FOLD01)
  • Rocío Fernández Usero (2014USER01)
  • Tyler Williams (2017WILL05)

Cade Beck (2018BECK05) was recently appointed as Leader of the Conduct sub-team. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.

Amanda Schmid (2017SCHM12) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate her and wish her the best of luck in her new role.

Carter Kucala (2015KUCA01), Glib Vedmid (2016VEDM01), Yash Budhiraja (2018BUDH01), and Yuji Yoshida (2015YOSH01) recently stepped down from their positions as WIC members. Thank you so much for your work Carter, Glib and Yash, and Yuji!

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第一季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest - 2026 Q1

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件和一般工作动态。上季度立案 12 件、结案 16 件，作出 5 项禁赛、4 项警告，7 件未采取措施。

  • WIC 获悉与一名选手有关的严重疑虑，且正在采取法律行动。事件虽发生于 WCA 范围之外，程序仍在进行，但 WIC 与理事会认为有必要采取预防措施。经理事会事先批准，WIC 暂停其参赛、出席正式比赛及论坛发帖资格。WIC 将关注法律程序，并在结束后采取必要措施。
  • 因此提醒全体成员：若发现不当或违反政策的行为，请报告当地代表及 WIC：integrity@worldcubeassociation.org。我们的使命是成为社群处理纪律问题时可以信赖的对象，始终会认真对待此类事项。
  • 接报选手被抓到偷窃他人魔方并扰乱秩序，且此前已有多起性质类似的较轻事件。其被禁止参赛及到场。
  • 获悉选手在比赛中行为不当，WIC 警告后仍在其他比赛继续，因此禁止其参赛及到场。
  • WCT 向 WIC 反映，选手在论坛多次发布违反行为准则的帖子，已被标记并隐藏。其获得警告。提醒社群：包括论坛在内的所有官方管理平台均受行为准则约束，行为应与之相符。
  • 本季度大多数案件涉及不同方式的作弊，包括还原结束前用手腕停表、盲拧时从眼罩下偷看、观察期间转动。部分选手因此被禁止参赛，相关尝试成绩被取消。

一般工作动态

  • 自成立以来，WIC 持续编写和更新支持志愿者处理安全事项的文件。鉴于本简报第一案，发展小组将加大培训资源工作，保障比赛中的志愿者、选手和观众安全。近期已获得支持，期待未来几个季度与潜在合作伙伴共同开发。
  • WIC 预计很快招募各小组成员，接近月底时会提供更多信息，强烈鼓励感兴趣的社群成员届时申请。
  • Swami Srinivasan（2015SRIN02）近期获任高级成员及伦理小组负责人，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • Cade Beck（2018BECK05）近期获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • Glenn Koster（2022JRGL01）和 Bertie Longden（2014LONG06）近期卸任成员，感谢两人的工作。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.
In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 12 cases and closed 16. This resulted in 5 bans and 4 warnings, while 7 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee was made aware of serious concerns regarding a competitor, which also involved legal action being pursued. Although these incidents happened outside the sphere of the WCA and proceedings are still ongoing, the WCA Integrity Committee and WCA Board determined that precautionary action was warranted. With the prior approval of the WCA Board, the WIC issued a suspension from competing, attending official competitions and posting on the forum. The WCA Integrity Committee will monitor the legal proceedings and take the necessary actions once they are concluded.
  • * With this in mind, the WIC would like to remind all community members that if you notice behavior that is inappropriate or violates our policies, please report such behavior to your local WCA delegates, as well as the WIC at integrity@worldcubeassociation.org. Our mission is to be able to serve as the confidant for disciplinary issues for the community, and we will always take these matters seriously. 
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of a competitor who had been caught stealing puzzles from other competitors and engaging in disruptive behavior. In addition, the competitor had previously been involved in multiple minor incidents of a similar nature. The competitor was issued a ban from competing and attending official competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was made aware of a competitor who was engaging in inappropriate behavior at a WCA competition. This behavior continued at other competitions after the competitor was warned by the WIC. The competitor in question was issued a ban from participating and attending WCA competitions. 
  • The WCT noted to the WIC that a competitor had made multiple posts on the WCA Forum that violated the WCA Code of Conduct, which were flagged and removed from public view. The competitor was issued a warning for these posts. The WIC would like to remind the WCA Community that all officially managed platforms, including the WCA Forum, are under the purview of the WCA’s Code of Conduct and to make sure to conduct themselves in these spaces accordingly. 
  • The majority of our cases this quarter involved the WCA Integrity Committee handling a number of incidents in which some competitors cheated in various ways, including:
  • * Stopping the timer with their wrists before finishing the solve
  • * Peeking under their blindfolds during blindfolded events
  • * Applying moves during inspection 
  • Some competitors were banned from competing for these respective incidents, and the concerned attempts were disqualified.

General WIC updates:

  • Since its creation, the WCA Integrity Committee has been working to create and update a variety of documents aimed at supporting the WCA Volunteers in safety matters. In light of the first incident described in this digest, the WIC Development Team will step up its efforts to develop training resources for ensuring the safety of WCA Volunteers, competitors and spectators at WCA competitions. The WIC recently received support to develop such resources, and we are extremely excited and eager to develop these with potential partners over the coming quarters. 
  • The WIC anticipates opening a new call for applicants soon to fill positions across all subteams. We should have more information to share closer to the end of the month. We highly encourage any interested community members to apply when the call for applicants opens!
  • Swami Srinivasan (2015SRIN02) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. He was also appointed as Leader of the Ethics sub-team. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new roles.
  • Cade Beck (2018BECK05) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.
  • Glenn Koster (2022JRGL01) and Bertie Longden (2014LONG06) recently stepped down from their positions as WIC members. Thank you so much for your work Glenn and Bertie!

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2025 年第四季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest - 2025 Q4

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

上季度 WIC 立案 24 件、结案 19 件，均创委员会纪录。作出 5 项禁赛、8 项警告，6 件未采取措施。部分重要案件如下：

  • 接报一名选手故意提前停表，并被指为避免发现而选择显示屏关闭或没有显示屏的比赛台。录像有限，最初无法立即确认，但持续观察其还原后最终发现证据。WIC 联系选手征询说明，多次给予机会，选手仍未承认不当行为。其被多年禁赛，相关成绩被取消。虽然违规类型与下文第三案相同，但因加重情节，处分更重。
  • 接报选手在观察阶段转动魔方。其承认部分正式尝试存在此行为，但 WIC 认为作弊范围大于承认范围。WIC 决定取消部分成绩并给予短期禁赛。
  • 接报选手进步速度快得可疑，代表也怀疑其用手腕提前停表作弊。在后续比赛中收集到作弊证据，相关成绩被取消，并给予短期禁赛。
  • 证据显示两名选手相互篡改成绩单，记录实际并未取得的时间。两人多场比赛成绩被取消，并获正式警告。
  • 接报选手在盲拧中从眼罩下偷看。WIC 根据证据认定其多次作弊，经内部讨论给予正式警告，并取消其全部盲拧项目成绩。

WIC 其他动态：

Zachary Miller（2017MILL04）成为新任负责人，祝履职顺利！衷心感谢 Shain Papalotl Longbehn（2020LONG05）过去两年担任负责人期间的表现和投入。

新成员：

  • Daniel Darcy（2022DARC03）；
  • Elian Beguec（2014BEGU01）；
  • Finn Trass（2016TRAS01）；
  • Jakub Hanuszkiewicz（2014HANU01）；
  • Max Kwok U Sam（2018SAMK01）；
  • Meng Chon Kuok（2023KUOK01）；
  • Pauline Bonnaudet（2009BONN01）；
  • Yash Budhiraja（2018BUDH01）。

Jonas Balsfulland（2012BALS01）近期卸任成员，感谢其工作！

WIC 将与 WCA 大型锦标赛团队（WMCT）密切合作，协助重大赛事主办方选择志愿者。

如有问题，随时欢迎发邮件。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

In the last quarter, the WIC opened 24 cases and closed 19, both a record number for the Committee. This resulted in 5 bans and 8 warnings, while 6 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of a competitor intentionally stopping the timer prematurely and allegedly positioning himself at solving stations where the display is turned off or where there is no display to avoid being caught. Due to limited availability of footage, it could not be immediately confirmed whether the competitor was performing early stops, but evidence was eventually discovered after monitoring their solves. The competitor was contacted and asked to provide any remarks about the matter. However, the competitor did not admit to any wrongdoing despite the multiple opportunities to do so. The competitor was issued a multi-year ban and the concerned results were disqualified. Despite being the same type of offense as the third case, the ban enacted was more severe due to aggravating circumstances.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee received reports of a competitor who was completing moves on their puzzle during the inspection phase. The competitor admitted to making moves during inspection on some of their official attempts but the WIC believes that the extent of this cheating is further than what was admitted to. The WIC elected to disqualify some of this competitor’s results and enact a short ban.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee received reports of a competitor who had improved at a suspiciously fast pace. The delegates also believed the competitor showed signs of cheating by stopping the timer early with their wrists. Throughout their subsequent competitions, evidence of this competitor cheating was gathered. Affected results were disqualified and this competitor received a short ban.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee received evidence that two competitors had participated in manipulating each others’ scorecards, recording times which were not actually achieved by the competitors. These competitors had multiple competitions worth of results disqualified and were issued a formal warning.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of a competitor cheating in blindfolded events by peeking under the blindfold. Based on the evidence, the WIC determined that the competitor cheated several times. After an internal deliberation the WIC decided to issue a formal warning and disqualify all their results from blindfolded events.

Here are some other general WIC updates:

Zachary Miller (2017MILL04) has become the new Leader of the WCA Integrity Committee. We wish him the best of luck! Also, we are incredibly grateful to Shain Papalotl Longbehn (2020LONG05) for his performance and dedication to his role as leader over the last two years. Thank you so much for your work Shain!

New members have joined the WCA Integrity Committee:

  • Daniel Darcy (2022DARC03)
  • Elian Beguec (2014BEGU01)
  • Finn Trass (2016TRAS01)
  • Jakub Hanuszkiewicz (2014HANU01)
  • Max Kwok U Sam (2018SAMK01)
  • Meng Chon Kuok (2023KUOK01)
  • Pauline Bonnaudet (2009BONN01)
  • Yash Budhiraja (2018BUDH01)

Jonas Balsfulland (2012BALS01) recently stepped down from his position as a WIC member. Thank you so much for your work Jonas!

The WCA Integrity Committee will work closely with the WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) to assist the organizers of major championships in selecting volunteers.

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email any time.

title.en: WCA Integrity Committee Team Leader Announcement (January 2026)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

很高兴宣布，Zachary Miller 成为 WCA 诚信委员会（WIC）新任负责人。他此前已担任 WIC 高级成员。

按委员会与团队动议第 5 节，Zachary 由理事会选出并经投票批准，任命自 2026 年 1 月 13 日生效。

感谢 Shain Longbehn 担任负责人期间的工作，他将留任高级成员。祝 Zachary 顺利履行新职责。

Zachary 是唯一申请人，其获选申请文件见此处。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Zachary Miller has become the new Leader of the WCA Integrity Committee (WIC). Zachary was already working as a Senior Member of the WIC.

Zachary was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of January 13, 2026.

We thank Shain Longbehn, who will remain as a Senior Member of the WIC, for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Zachary the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Zachary was the only applicant for the role, and his successful candidacy document can be found here.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 诚信委员会负责人（2025 年 12 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Integrity Committee Leader (December 2025)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

Shain Longbehn 的任期即将结束，将任命新的 WCA 诚信委员会（WIC）负责人。感谢 Shain 领导委员会所做的工作。

候选人应履行 24 个月任期，平均每周投入至少 8 小时。期望素质包括：强领导力；开展和监督调查的经验；出色的分析与解决问题能力；保密和遵守伦理的承诺；良好的判断及决策能力；熟悉 WCA 活动；出色沟通能力。

申请期为即日起至 2025 年 12 月 31 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请私下发送至执行助理团队 assistants@worldcubeassociation.org，并抄送理事会 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

申请文件必须为 PDF，包含：

  1. 简短自我介绍；
  2. 为 WCA 所做活动概述；
  3. 担任 WIC 负责人的目标。

另请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请副本。

WIC 权利与职责见动议 10.2025.3。申请期结束后，理事会将面试最符合条件的申请人，投票遴选并宣布新负责人，流程见动议 10.2025.0第 5 节。

感谢申请与支持。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) Leader, as Shain Longbehn’s term is ending. We would like to thank Shain for the work he has done leading the Integrity Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Integrity Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Experience in conducting and overseeing investigations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Commitment to confidentiality and ethical conduct
  • Good judgment and decision-making skills
  • Familiarity with WCA activities
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until December 31, 2025, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WIC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WIC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2025.3.

After the application period, the WCA Board will interview the most qualified applicants, make a selection by voting, and announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of WCA Motion 10.2025.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support,

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2025 年第三季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest 2025-Q3

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

上季度 WIC 立案 19 件、结案 18 件，均为委员会纪录。作出 7 项禁赛、5 项警告，6 件未采取措施。部分重要案件如下：

  • WIC 近期公布了一名曾持国家纪录的选手故意不当停表的报告。其被禁止参赛两年半，多场比赛成绩被取消，详情见报告。
  • 接报一名选手比赛中不当触碰观众。观众称此前也有未经同意的类似行为。WIC 联系证人，获得佐证。依据证词可信度、多方观察到的即时情绪影响，以及证人对受害者反应的确认，WIC 认定事件可信且有依据。该选手被多年禁止参赛、到场及参与 WCA 论坛。
  • 收到确凿视频，显示选手在观察时转动魔方。向其出示证据后，WIC 认为其调查中的悔意与合作并非完全真诚，只在被发现后才后悔。其被多年禁止参赛，多场比赛成绩被取消。
  • 接报选手多次发表违反行为准则 2.2.1 的不当言论。选手否认违规，但多名证人证实其行为。其被禁止参赛及到场。
  • 多场比赛的多名代表报告一名选手篡改多张成绩单。选手承认修改部分成绩，因此被短期禁止参赛。提醒参与录入的代表和志愿者仔细检查可疑修改。
  • 收到邮件，报告选手讲带暴力性质、不恰当且不受欢迎的笑话，违反行为准则 2.2.1。询问时，选手否认并不再回复后续邮件。其被禁止参赛及到场。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last quarter, the WIC opened 19 cases and closed 18, both a record number for the Committee. This resulted in 7 bans and 5 warnings, while 6 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee recently posted a public report about a former National-Record holding competitor intentionally stopping the timer inappropriately. The competitor was issued a two-and-a-half-year ban from competing and their results in multiple competitions were disqualified. For further information, please click here.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed that a competitor touched a spectator inappropriately during a competition. The spectator also explained that that was not the first time the competitor did so without consent. The WIC contacted a witness, who corroborated the competitor’s behavior. The WIC determined the incident credible and substantiated based on the credibility of the testimonies, the immediate emotional impact observed by multiple parties, and the existence of witnesses who confirmed the victim’s reaction. The competitor was issued a multi-year ban from competing, attending WCA competitions and participating in WCA forums.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was provided conclusive footage of a competitor performing moves in inspection. When presented with the evidence, the WIC felt that the competitor’s remorse and cooperation during the investigation was not entirely genuine, and that the competitor only regretted their actions when caught. They were issued a multi-year ban from competing and their results in multiple competitions were disqualified.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed that a competitor had made several inappropriate comments that violated 2.2.1 of the Code of conduct. The competitor denied having engaged in any offence. However, multiple witnesses corroborated the competitor's behavior. The competitor was issued a ban from competing and attending WCA competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed by multiple Delegates across several competitions about a competitor manipulating multiple scorecards. As the competitor confessed to having manipulated some results, a short-term ban from competing was issued. We remind all Delegates and Volunteers involved in data entry of the importance of carefully checking the results for suspicious changes.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee received an email reporting inappropriate behavior by a competitor who had made inappropriate and unwanted jokes that were violent in nature and violated 2.2.1 of the Code of Conduct. When confronted, the competitor denied having made such jokes and stopped replying to our subsequent emails. The competitor was issued a ban from competing and attending WCA competitions.

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email.

title.zh: 诚信委员会关于一宗作弊案件的报告（2025 年 9 月）
title.en: Integrity Committee Report on a Case of Cheating (Sep 2025)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

本报告也已译为西班牙语，方便受影响地区阅读。点击此处查看西班牙语版。

诚信委员会已结束一宗调查：一名曾持国家纪录的选手，在多场比赛多个项目中作弊。因此，其被禁止参赛 2 年 6 个月。

选手最初否认任何不当行为，直至看到证据。除三阶最少步外，其跨越数年的成绩也被取消。由于不配合调查，WIC 取消了所有存在成绩合法性疑虑的比赛中该选手的计时成绩。

本报告旨在公开禁赛及取消成绩的理由，警示裁判不专注可能导致的事件，并展示 WIC 在所有地区维护公平的承诺。报告后文还说明委员会目前对作弊案件取消成绩的总体立场。

鉴于被指控选手的年龄，WIC 决定将报告完全匿名化，并强烈劝阻社群公开其姓名。完整报告见此处。

谨致问候， Shain Longbehn，WIC 负责人 代表 WCA 诚信委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Este informe también se ha traducido al español para facilitar su acceso a la región afectada. Haz clic aquí para ver la versión en español.

The Integrity Committee has concluded an investigation on a case of cheating by a former National Record-holding Competitor in multiple events spanning several competitions. As a result, they have been banned for 2-years and 6-months from competing.

The Competitor, who initially denied any wrongdoing until presented with evidence, also had their results disqualified spanning several years, with the exception of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. Because the competitor was uncooperative, the WIC disqualified their times from all competitions where the results were suspected to be illegitimate.

The intent of this report is to publish the reasons behind the decision to ban the Competitor and disqualify their results. This document also aims to serve as a warning of the potential incidents that can occur due to inattentive judges, and to demonstrate the WIC’s commitment to fairness in all regions. The WIC later clarifies the Committee’s current stance on disqualifications in case of cheating as a whole.

The WIC has elected to fully anonymize this report due to the age of the accused competitor. The WIC strongly discourages the community from publicizing the name of the accused competitor for this reason. The full report can be found here.

Kind Regards,
Shain Longbehn (WIC Leader)
On behalf of the WCA Integrity Committee

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2025 年第二季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest 2025-Q2

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

上季度 WIC 立案 12 件、结案 9 件，作出 4 项禁赛，6 件未采取措施。部分重要案件如下：

  • 一名选手投诉代表对待不公平，认为代表越权并提出不合理要求。WIC 认定代表在职责范围内行事，要求合理。WIC 建议：若不同意代表决定，应先遵从要求，之后必要时按16.2025.1—争议提出争议。
  • 接报一名选手通过篡改成绩单作弊。WIC 联系相关代表、裁判，调查该选手各轮情况，发现其在多场比赛多个轮次中篡改成绩单；还认定一名受询问裁判试图包庇。该选手被禁止参赛，裁判也因协助而被短期禁赛。
  • 接报一名选手在网上向他人发送威胁，特别针对 WCA 选手和比赛。WIC 认定行为严重威胁安全的比赛环境，且严重违反行为准则，因此给予多年禁赛，并联系相关主管机关。涉及安全时，WIC 强烈建议先联系当地主管机关。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last quarter, the WIC opened 12 cases and closed 9. This resulted in 4 bans, while 6 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee received a complaint from a competitor regarding perceived unfair treatment from Delegates. This competitor felt that the Delegates had overstepped their role and made unreasonable requests towards the competitor. The WIC found that the Delegates acted within the scope of their role and asked a reasonable request of the competitor. The WIC would like to advise competitors that should they disagree with a Delegate’s decision, they should comply with the request and later file a dispute as defined in 16.2025.1 - Disputes if necessary.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of cheating through manipulation of scorecards by a competitor. The WIC contacted the involved delegates and judges to investigate the possibility of scorecard manipulation in each round this competitor competed in and found evidence of scorecard manipulation in multiple rounds across several competitions. The WIC also concluded one of the judges who had been contacted attempted to cover up for the competitor. The competitor was issued a ban from competing, while the judge was also issued with a short ban for assisting the competitor.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of an incident where a competitor sent threats to individuals online, specifically targeting WCA competitors and competitions. The WIC found that these actions posed a significant threat to the maintenance of a safe WCA competition environment and were major violations of the Code of Conduct. As a result, the perpetrator was given a multi-year ban and appropriate authorities were involved. The WIC strongly recommends that the local authorities are involved first where safety is concerned.

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 诚信委员会成员（2025 年 8 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Integrity Committee Members (August 2025)

html.zh:
目录：WIC 做什么？ · 开放职位 · 如何申请

亲爱的 WCA 社群：

WCA 诚信委员会（WIC）正在招募新成员！人人可申请，尤其鼓励目前不是 WCA 志愿者的社群成员。WIC 重视团队多样性，希望收到来自代表性不足的文化背景、国籍、年龄、能力状况和性别群体的申请。

<a id='what-does-the-wic-do'></a>WIC 做什么？

主要开展独立调查，涉及 WCA 社群成员、志愿者、地区组织，以及 WCA 比赛或官方在线平台上的事件。我们还向代表提供事件处理建议，积极为整个组织编写相关培训材料。成员平均每周工作 3–6 小时。权利与职责详见：

  • 动议 10.2025.3—诚信委员会；
  • 动议 15.2025.1—暂停资格及其他处分；
  • 行为准则；
  • 伦理准则；
  • 纪律日志。

<a id='open-positions'></a>开放职位

WIC 分为四个小组，其中三个有空缺。所有成员必须能清晰地以书面英语沟通；截至 2025 年 9 月 1 日已满 18 岁；以选手或来宾身份参加过至少几场 WCA 比赛；愿意并能够使用 Slack 沟通。我们也重视逻辑和分析推理、协作、审慎保密及在社群中的积极表现。英语以外语言的流利能力也非常宝贵。

行为小组：最多 3 个空缺

你是否喜欢查明事实、追踪线索，擅长发现叙述中的矛盾或缺口？该组调查违反行为准则及 WCA 规则的情况，包括作弊及行为方面的指控。适合成员应具备批判性思考能力，不预先下结论，并能处理敏感话题。冲突解决、儿童保护、调查岗位经验，或一个以上速拧项目的专长属于加分项，并非必需。

伦理小组：最多 1 个空缺

你是否重视公平、维护专业标准，并能在没有明显正确答案时作决定？该组调查 WCA 志愿者违反伦理准则的情况，重点为行为和财务问题。适合成员应善于处理细微差别，能将宏观伦理原则用于实际，并在委员会工作与比赛环境之间维持专业界限。调解、辩论、说服性写作或合规经验为加分项，并非必需。

发展小组：最多 1 个空缺

你是否喜欢将复杂政策变成清晰实用的资源，看到问题便思考解决办法？该组根据 WIC 和整个组织的当前需要开展项目。适合成员应主动积极、热心教育他人，并能创造性地解决复杂问题。教育、儿童保护、文档或流程编写、独立项目开发经验为加分项，并非必需。

<a id='how-to-apply'></a>如何申请

请在 2025 年 9 月 11 日 23:59 UTC 前，向 WIC 负责人 slongbehn@worldcubeassociation.org发送 PDF，必须包含：简短自我介绍；为 WCA 或魔方社群所做活动；相关技能与经验；申请动机；感兴趣的职位。

所有材料须在同一 PDF 内。预计 48 小时内确认收件。申请期结束后开始遴选，可能按职位安排面试或其他评估。如有问题，请联系 WIC 负责人。
html.en:
• What does the WIC do?
  • Open Positions
  • How to Apply

Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) is looking for new members! Everyone may apply, and we strongly encourage Community members who are not a current WCA Volunteer to apply. The WIC also values diversity amongst its team, and seeks applications from underrepresented cultural backgrounds, nationalities, ages, abilities, and genders.

What does the WIC do?

The WCA Integrity Committee primarily performs independent investigations involving WCA Community members, WCA Volunteers, Regional Organizations, and incidents during WCA Competitions or on official, online WCA platforms. We also advise Delegates on managing incidents, actively working on training materials related to these topics for the organization as a whole. On average, members work 3-6 hours per week. For more details of our rights and duties, please see the following materials:

  • Motion 10.2025.3 - Integrity Committee
  • Motion 15.2025.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions
  • Code of Conduct
  • Code of Ethics
  • The Disciplinary Log

Open Positions

The WIC is split into four subteams, and three of them have open positions. All members must:

  • Be able to communicate clearly in written English
  • Be 18 years or older by September 1, 2025
  • Have attended at least a few WCA competitions (as a competitor or guest)
  • Be willing and able to use Slack for communication

Generally, we also look for and value logical and analytical reasoning, collaboration, discretion, and a positive presence in the Community. Fluence in a language other than English is also extremely valuable to our team.

Conduct Subteam - up to 3 positions open

Do you like uncovering facts and following leads? Do you have a knack for spotting inconsistencies or gaps in a story? The Conduct Team investigates violations of the Code of Conduct and WCA Regulations, including cheating and behavioral allegations. A successful member of this subteam is skilled at thinking critically, approaches issues with non-judgement, and is comfortable handling sensitive topics. Although not required, desirable candidates would have experience in conflict resolution, child safeguarding, investigative roles, or expertise in one or more speedcubing events.

Ethics Subteam - up to 1 position open

Are you motivated by fairness and upholding professional standards? Are you comfortable making decisions in situations with no obvious right answer? The Ethics Team investigates violations of the Code of Ethics amongst WCA Volunteers, focusing on conduct and financial concerns. A successful member of this subteam excels with nuance, has the ability to apply large ethical concepts practically, and maintains professional boundaries between work inside the Committee and competition environments. Although not required, desirable candidates would have experience in mediation, debate, persuasive writing, or compliance.

Development Subteam - up to 1 position open

Do you enjoy turning complex policies into clear, practical resources? Are you the type of person who sees a problem and immediately thinks of how to fix it? The Development Team focuses on developing projects based on the current needs of the WIC and the organization as a whole. A successful member of this subteam is a self-starter, has a passion for educating others, and finds creative solutions to complex problems. Although not required, desirable candidates would have experience in education, child safeguarding, writing documentation/workflows, or developing independent projects.

How to Apply

Applicants can send their application as a PDF document to the WIC leader at slongbehn@worldcubeassociation.org before September 11th, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC. The application document must contain:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA and/or for the cubing community
  • Overview of skills and experiences relevant to the role
  • Motivation for applying to the WIC
  • Which position(s) you are interested in

Everything should be contained in a single PDF file. Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application within 48 hours. The selection process will start after the application period is over, and it may include an interview or other kinds of assessment, depending on the specific position applied for.

If you have any questions feel free to contact the WIC Leader at slongbehn@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: 选手因手抖得到低于 0.06 秒的时间
title.en: Competitor got a time below 0.06 because of shaky hands

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，A6b1 已修改，更清楚地说明低于 0.06 秒停表的处理方式。

选手停表时间低于 0.06 秒，现场按器材故障给予额外尝试，但裁判称可能是选手手抖造成。

WRC 认为最可能原因是手抖而非计时器故障，依据 A6b1 决定判 DNF：

A6b1：若魔方还原前计时器停止，且显示时间严格小于 0.06 秒，则以额外尝试替代。若代表认定选手故意停表，则取消获得额外尝试的权利。

申诉至原文所称“WRC Board”后，理事会推翻 WRC 决定，指出手抖不属于故意停表。因此，将 DNF 改为额外尝试的时间。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, A6b1 has been changed, to better state how incidents with a timer stop under 0.06s should be handled.

A competitor got a timer stop with a time less than 0.06s. An extra was given for malfunctioning equipment, but the judge said it could have been the competitors fault because of shaking hands.

The WRC determined that the most likely reason were the shaky hands of the competitor and that the result should therefore be DNF'ed, in accordance with A6b1, because the cause was not a timer malfunction:

A6b1) If the timer stops before the competitor has solved the puzzle and the timer shows a time strictly below 0.06 seconds, then the attempt is replaced by an extra attempt. A competitor forfeits the right to the additional attempt if the WCA Delegate determines that the timer was stopped deliberately.

After an appeal to the WRC Board, the Board decided to overturn the decision by the WRC, citing that shaking hands do not count as stopping the timer deliberately. The DNF was therefore changed to the time of the extra solve.

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2025 年第一季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest 2025-Q1

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

上季度 WIC 立案 7 件、结案 10 件，作出 3 项禁赛、6 项警告，1 件未采取措施。部分重要案件如下：

  • 接报一名比赛组织者存在财务不当行为。审查多名社群成员提供的细节后，委员会认定该选手为个人利益挪用了比赛资金。因此，对其实施无固定期限禁赛，直至归还被挪用资金，并根据严重程度另加多年禁赛。
  • 接到一名选手来宾行为不当的报告。询问多名证人后，确认来宾存在不尊重代表、仇恨言论、恐吓及宣扬此类行为。WIC 决定短期禁止其参赛及到场。
  • 获得确凿视频，显示一名选手在一次正式尝试中滑动双手、不当启动计时器，并同时佩戴入耳式耳机。由于选手不配合，WIC 决定短期禁止其参赛，并取消视频所涉轮次的全部尝试成绩。
  • WIC 也优先推进与新成员共同改进现有工作流程，以及与其他 WCA 团队协作的项目。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在 WCA 论坛诚信板块提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last quarter, the WIC opened 7 cases and closed 10. This resulted in 3 bans and 6 warnings. Also, 1 case ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of financial misconduct by a competition organizer. After reviewing details from multiple community members, the committee determined the competitor misused competition finances for personal gain. As a result, the WIC issued an indefinite ban to the competitor until the misused funds are repaid, along with an additional multi-year ban in accordance with the severity of the offense.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee received reports of misconduct by a competitor’s guest. After consulting multiple witnesses, the committee confirmed that the guest engaged in inappropriate behavior, including disrespect towards delegates, hate speech, intimidation, and advocacy of such conduct. The WIC decided to issue a short-term ban on the guest from competing and attending competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was provided conclusive footage of a competitor starting the timer inappropriately by sliding the hands on the timer during one of their official attempts and wearing in-ear headphones during the same official attempt. Due to the lack of cooperation from the competitor, the WIC decided to issue a short-term ban from competing and disqualify all the attempts from the round in which the video evidence was recorded.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee has also prioritized improving existing workflow with new members and project collaboration with other WCA teams.

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Integrity section of the WCA forum.

title.zh: 选手观察时查看摄像头是否在录制
title.en: Competitor checked if camera was on during inspection

html.zh:
观察时，选手站起查看手机屏幕，确认摄像头是否录制，随后坐下开始还原。此行为可能违反 2i，但是否构成“使用”电子设备并不明确。

WRC 决定不处罚、保留成绩，理由是：

  1. 2i2 允许受限制的摄像头使用，具体见 2i2a、2i2c；
  2. 2i2a 允许代表酌情判断电子设备是否带来优势；
  3. 2i2c 禁止按电子设备按钮，本案没有此行为。

选手只是确认摄像头已开启并录制，查看摄像头未使其取得优势或获得帮助。
html.en:
During inspection, the competitor looked to see if his camera was recording. To do this, he stood up and looked at the screen of his phone, before sitting back down and starting the solve. This behavior could be considered a violation of regulation 2i, but it was unclear if the competitor's behavior qualified as "using" an electronic device.

The WRC concluded that the result should stand without penalty, citing the following reasons:

  1. Regulation 2i2 allows for restricted use of cameras by the competitor, as clarified in 2i2a and 2i2c.
  2. 2i2a clarifies that delegate discretion can be used to determine whether or not a competitor gained an advantage from electronic usage.
  3. 2i2c prohibits the competitor from pressing any buttons on electronics, which did not occur in this incident.

It was determined that since the competitor was just checking to see if their camera was on and recording, they did not gain an advantage or receive assistance by looking at the camera.

title.zh: 选手可能使用手刀方式停表
title.en: Competitor stopped timer with potential karate chop

html.zh:
决赛中，代表在观察比赛以便处理事件，看到选手以“手刀”姿势停表，便让裁判加 2 秒。之后选手提供视频，认为处罚错误。正常速度下仍像不合规停表，慢放后则略有争议。

WRC 同意正常速度观看时，停表违反 A6d。须明确：11f 的逐帧政策可用于撤销裁判或代表最初施加的处罚（11f1d），但施加处罚只能依据正常速度证据，除非还原属于 11f1 范围。
html.en:
During a final round, a delegate was watching the competitors' solves in case any incident occurred. The delegate observed a competitor who stopped the timer in a "karate chop" position, and went to tell the judge to apply a +2 penalty. Afterwards, the delegate was presented with the video of the attempt from the competitor, and the competitor claimed that the +2 was incorrectly given. While watching the video at normal speed, the timer stop still looked illegal, but in slow motion it was slightly more debatable.

The WRC agreed that the timer stop violated A6d when viewing the video at full speed. As an important clarification, the frame-by-frame policy as outlined in 11f can be used to remove a penalty initially assessed by the judge or delegate (11f1d), however, applying a penalty must only be based on evidence viewed at full speed (unless the solve falls within the scope of 11f1).

title.zh: 裁判未复位计时器，记录了前一选手时间
title.en: Judge did not reset timer and recorded the previous competitor's time

html.zh:
选手不知情地在未复位、仍显示前一次时间的计时器上完成第一次还原，错误时间被记入成绩单。复核发现异常，联系选手及家长后，视频证实实际时间差异很大。因无法核实准确时间，成绩改为 DNF，选手和家长接受了处理。

WRC 认为，代表原可给予额外尝试而非 DNF。主要问题是裁判未复位（A3b）；若及时发现，代表可按 A3c3+给予额外尝试。虽然选手可自行复位，最终责任仍在裁判。WRC 提醒裁判留意计时器状态，确保比赛台已为下一次尝试准备好。
html.en:
A competitor unknowingly performed their first solve without resetting the timer, which displayed a time from a previous attempt. The incorrect time was recorded on the scorecard. Upon review, it was noticed that the result seemed unusual. After consulting with the competitor and their parent, a video confirmed the actual time was significantly different. Since the exact time couldn't be verified, the result was changed to a DNF, which was accepted by the competitor and their parent.

The WRC concluded that the delegate could have decided to give the competitor an extra instead of a DNF. Since the main problem in this incident was the judge not resetting the timer (A3b), the delegate could have decided to give the competitor an extra attempt instead of a DNF if the incident was found out about on time (A3c3+). Though the competitor is allowed to reset the timer themselves, this is ultimately the judge's responsibility. The WRC would like to remind judges to be mindful of the state of their timer when judging and to ensure their station is ready for the next attempt.

title.zh: 国家纪录尝试很可能使用了错误打乱
title.en: Competitor likely received a misscramble on a National Record attempt

html.zh:
一名选手打破 Skewb 单次国家纪录，远快于其平均水平。因欢呼和兴奋，代表与选手直到比赛结束才核查打乱。多次尝试后，选手称不熟悉本应收到的正确打乱。

代表鼓励其待打乱公布后在家试做，但选手请求帮助理解记号，引发对纪录有效性的疑虑。代表还发现该次成绩单缺少打乱员签名。这些因素使人高度怀疑打乱不正确。

WRC 同意打乱很可能有误，决定按错误打乱处理。由于现场没有给予额外尝试，依据 11i1 判为 DNS。

为减少因收到错误打乱而必须对选手施加的后果，WRC 建议：

  • 预计可能达到 11i1 标准的选手，打乱应由第二名打乱员复核（11i1+）；
  • 成绩达到 11i1 标准后，应在合理可行时尽快核查打乱；
  • 若当时无法明确裁定，可以给予暂定的额外尝试（11e+++++）。
html.en:
A competitor had broken the National Record single in Skewb, which was significantly faster than their average in the event. Due to the cheering and excitement, the delegate and competitor were only able to meet at the end of the competition to verify the scramble. After multiple attempts, the competitor claimed that they were unfamiliar with the true scramble (that they were supposed to receive)

The competitor was then encouraged to try out the scramble at home once scrambles were posted, but the competitor asked for help in reading the notation, which lead to suspicion regarding the validity of the record. The delegate also noticed that the scorecard for the record-breaking attempt was not signed by the scrambler. Due to all of these factors, there was high suspicion that the cube was incorrectly scrambled.

The WRC agreed that the cube was likely not scrambled correctly, and ruled that the incident should be handled assuming that the scramble was not correct. Following 11i1, since no extra attempt was given at the competition, the attempt was ruled as a DNS.

In order to reduce the penalties that must be given to competitors who receive incorrectly scrambled puzzles, the WRC recommends the following:

  • Competitors who are expected to meet the crieteria in 11i1 should have their scrambles checked by a second scrambler (11i1+)
  • Competitors who achieve results meeting the criteria in 11i1 should have their scrambles checked as soon as is reasonable.
  • Provisional extras can be given if the resolution to an incident is unclear in the moment. (11e+++++)

title.zh: 还原中发现魔方配色被交换
title.en: Competitor realized the color scheme on their puzzle was swapped during their solve

html.zh:
Square-1 决赛中，选手发现朋友将其魔方顶底颜色对调、改变配色，便申请额外尝试。这一修改直接导致还原顶底层交换，结果为 DNF。选手承认魔方由自己提交，但当时并不知情，且在叫代表前没有签名。

WRC 认为，虽然是选手自己提交自己的魔方，不知道此类修改仍可能造成严重干扰。考虑到尚未签名，且 DNF 直接由颜色交换造成，依据 11d，给予额外尝试有理由。

此类情况应由代表合理酌情判断最公平结果。若选手早已知道配色交换，给予额外尝试就不那么合理。
html.en:
A competitor in the Square-1 final round requested an extra attempt after realizing that a friend had swapped the top and bottom colors on their puzzle, altering the color scheme. This resulted in his solve being a DNF with the top and bottom layers being swapped, as a direct result of this modification. The competitor acknowledged that they had submitted the puzzle themselves but was unaware of this modification at that time. They made sure not to sign their time before calling over the Delegate.

The WRC concluded that, even though it was the competitor's own puzzle that he handed in himself, not having knowledge of such a modification can cause a significant amount of distraction. That, combined with the fact the attempt wasn't signed for yet, makes it so that the extra was warranted by 11d, considering that the DNF was a direct result of the swapped colors.

In cases like this, Delegates should use reasonable discretion to determine the most fair outcome. Had the competitor known about their color scheme being swapped, it would not be as reasonable to grant the extra attempt.

title.zh: 第二次启动失败后，选手认为计时器故障
title.en: Competitor thought timer malfunctioned after getting second DNF for timer start

html.zh:
一名经验丰富的选手因计时器未启动第二次得到 DNF，叫来代表，无法解释原因。他认为手放得够久，但裁判不确定绿灯是否亮起。

代表测试了两次 DNF 所用计时器，均无异常；此后比赛中也无人投诉。选手提供了录像。

WRC 审查后决定保留两个 DNF。选手即使在成功启动时，也倾向很快抬手；两次 DNF 时双手按在计时器上的时间更短，足以解释未启动。加上没有其他投诉，很可能只是选手未正确启动。因此两次均保持 DNF。
html.en:
A competitor called a delegate over after getting a second DNF because the timer did not start. This was a very experienced competitor, and had no explanation as to why this happened. The competitor believed they held their hands on the timer long enough, but the judge was unsure if the green starting light was visible or not.

The delegates tested the timers that were used on the two DNF attempts and had no issues with them, and nobody else complained about the timers for the rest of the competition. Videos of the solves were provided for analysis.

The WRC reviewed the information and videos and concluded that the DNFs should be kept. The competitor had a tendency of starting the timer quite fast (even on successful starts), and on the DNF attempts, their hands were held on the timer for a bit less time, justifying why the timer did not start. Additionally, since there were no other complaints about the timer during the competition, it is very likely that the competitor simply did not start the timer correctly. As a result, both attempts remained as DNFs.

title.zh: 无裁判在场时开始多盲
title.en: Competitor started a Multiblind attempt without a judge present

html.zh:
一名选手认为采用流动裁判时可以用 Stackmat 自行开始，于是在没有裁判在场的情况下开始三阶多盲。意识到错误后，他询问是否应判 DNF。代表说是，他便停止。代表重新考虑后又给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 澄清，无裁判在场便开始盲拧违反 B2a，该条要求每次尝试开始时必须有裁判。此外，时限超过 10 分钟，按 A1b 也应启动秒表。选手行为使正常执裁无法进行，因此 WRC 判原尝试 DNF。
html.en:
A competitor began their 3x3x3 Multi-blind attempt without a judge present, assuming they could start with a stackmat timer due to the use of floating judges. Realizing their mistake, the competitor asked if their attempt should be a DNF. When the delegate told them that this was the case they stopped their attempt. After reconsideration however, the delegates provided a provisional extra attempt.

The WRC clarified that starting a blindfolded attempt without a judge violates regulation B2a, which states that a judge must be present at the start of each attempt. Furthermore, a stopwatch should have been started as required by Regulation A1b since the time limit was over 10 minutes. Since the competitor's actions prevented proper judging, the WRC ruled that the original attempt should be disqualified (DNF).

title.zh: 双方漏签，有视频但找不到裁判
title.en: Missing signatures from the judge and competitor, video evidence was available but the judge could not be located

html.zh:
一张成绩单缺少选手和裁判双方签名。视频证实尝试，选手也认可，但无法找到裁判。主办方起初误以为选手是新人，暂时接受成绩，不确定 A7c8 是否允许用视频替代裁判签名。后来确认不是新人，考虑改为 DNF 并征询 WRC。

WRC 澄清：即使是缺少经验的选手，A7c8 也只允许仍能联系到的裁判补签，不允许他人代签。本案找不到裁判，无法补签；选手又不是新人，A7c8 本就不适用。因此 WRC 决定改为 DNF。
html.en:
A score sheet was found missing both signatures. Video evidence confirmed the attempt, and the competitor acknowledged it, but the judge could not be located. Initially, organizers mistakenly believed the competitor was a newcomer and provisionally allowed the result, uncertain if A7c8 permitted video evidence to replace the judge’s signature. After realizing the competitor was not a newcomer, they considered changing the result to DNF and sought WRC confirmation.

The WRC clarified that if this were to involve an inexperienced competitor, Regulation A7c8 allows a judge to add their signature later, but only if they can still be contacted. It is not permitted for anyone to sign on behalf of the judge. In this incident, the fact that the judge was unable to be located meant that the signature could not be added anymore. Furthermore, the competitor in question turned out not to be a newcomer after all, meaning that A7c8 did not apply anymore. All of this resulted in the WRC deciding that this result should be changed to a DNF.

title.zh: 打乱开始后、第一次还原前，选手进入打乱区
title.en: Competitor entered the scramble area after scrambling started, but before his first solve

html.zh:
选手提交魔方并前往候场区，随后误以为魔方被换而进入打乱区，看到了自己魔方的第一条打乱，该次被判 DNF。代表不确定应只取消第一次，还是影响整个平均，向 WRC 询问。

WRC 澄清，违反 A2a1 时，代表可酌情取消全部剩余尝试资格。提前进入打乱区还违反 A2a3；该条虽无特定处罚，但可按 2k5 取消该轮资格。由于发生时尚未完成任何还原，应不记录成绩，而非记为多个 DNF（2j1a）。

WRC 提醒：打乱进行中，选手绝不能进入打乱区，整组期间都必须维持打乱保密。
html.en:
A competitor submitted their puzzle and went to the waiting area but then entered the scrambling area, mistakenly believing their puzzle had been swapped. They saw their puzzle with the first scramble, leading to a DNF for that attempt. Uncertain about the correct penalty, the delegates asked if only the first attempt should be disqualified or if the entire average should be affected.

The WRC clarified that violating A2a1 allows for the disqualification of all remaining attempts at the delegate's discretion. Additionally, entering the scrambling area early violated A2a3, which, while not listing a specific penalty, could justify round disqualification under 2k5. Since this occurred before any solves were completed, the competitor should receive no results rather than DNFs (2j1a).

The WRC would like to give a reminder that competitors must never enter the scrambling area while scrambling is in progress, as scramble secrecy must be maintained throughout the group.

title.zh: 未复位计时器上的三阶盲拧尝试结果为 DNF
title.en: Competitor got a DNF result on a timer that was not reset

html.zh:
一名选手三阶盲拧未成功还原，结束后发现使用的计时器没有复位。

WRC 决定按事件发生顺序处理，较早违规优先。裁判未复位违反 B2a，发生在选手以未还原状态尝试停表之前，因此应给予额外尝试，即使选手还原时并不知道计时器未运行。

若只有第一次成功才给额外尝试，选手就必须连续成功两次，才能取得非 DNF 成绩。
html.en:
A competitor did not solve their puzzle successfully in 3x3x3 Blindfolded. After their attempt was completed it was noticed that the attempt was performed on a timer that had not been reset.

WRC decided that the events in this incident should be evaluated in the order in which they happened, with earlier violations taking precedence over later ones. Since the judge failed to reset the timer (a violation of B2a) before the competitor attempted to stop the timer with an unsolved puzzle, an extra should be granted to the competitor, even if during their attempt the competitor was not aware that their timer was not running.

If an extra would only be granted if the first attempt was a success, the competitor would have to get two successful results in a row to get a non-DNF result.

title.zh: 二阶错误打乱仅需 3 步还原
title.en: 2x2 misscramble took only 3 moves to solve

html.zh:
发现一段视频，选手二阶还原 0.54 秒，当时为北美纪录。分析后确定打乱错误，最优解为 3 步（R U R’），而非原定 4 步（U’ R U R’）。

正式二阶打乱的最优解至少为 4 步（4b3b）。WRC 投票确认判 DNF，符合当时对错误打乱的处理方式。

若按现行规则处理，应依据 11i1 记为 DNS。
html.en:
A video was found where a competitor could be seen performing a 0.54 2x2 Solve, this being the North American Record at that time. After some analysis, it was determined that the cube was in fact misscrambled, with a 3 move optimal solution (R U R’), rather than the intended 4 move optimal solution (U’ R U R’).

The optimal solution for any official 2x2 scrambles has a minimum of 4 moves (Regulation 4b3b). The WRC held a vote to confirm our decision to DNF the attempt, in line with our approach for handling misscrambles at the time.

If this were to happen under the current Regulations, the solve would be marked as DNS as per Regulation 11i1.

title.zh: 判断金字塔错位处罚时，小角盖部分脱落
title.en: Pyraminx tip caps partially detached when determining misalignment penalties

html.zh:
选手完成金字塔还原时，一个小角错位，且盖片未完全保持组装状态：

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDcwNTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b9956b3a663b0bf0a0d839d39b5352e91feba702/Screenshot%202024-11-18%20at%203.08.47%E2%80%AFPM.png

构成小角的两个部件略微分离，第三个仍完整。代表以完整部件为参照，认定转动不足 60 度。

本案判为已还原。类似情况应按完整部件判断错位，正如代表所做，而非按部分脱落的部件。

提醒：部分相似事件可能需要适用 5b5c。本案部件仅轻微位移、部分脱落，因此依据 5b5f，关键部件被视为完整。
html.en:
A competitor finished their pyraminx solve and had one of the tips misaligned with caps not fully intact:

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDcwNTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b9956b3a663b0bf0a0d839d39b5352e91feba702/Screenshot%202024-11-18%20at%203.08.47%E2%80%AFPM.png

Two of the pieces that construct the pyraminx tip were slightly separated. The third piece was intact, and with respect to this piece, the delegates determined that the piece was turned less than 60 degrees.

In this case, the puzzle was determined to be solved. In incidents like this, the misalignment should be judged by the piece that is intact (as the delegates did) rather than any partially detatched pieces.

As a friendly reminder: for some incidents similar to this, regulation 5b5c may need to be applied. In this particular incident, the affected pieces were only minorly displaced and partially detatched, so the critical pieces are considered intact following 5b5f.

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2024 年第四季度
title.en: Integrity Committee Digest 2024-Q4

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

上季度 WCA 诚信委员会立案 16 件、结案 14 件，作出 8 项禁赛、3 项警告，2 件未采取措施。部分重要案件如下：

  • 接报两名选手在多场比赛中行为不当。联系多名潜在证人后，发现持续存在欺凌、骚扰、虐待和恐吓，损害 WCA 精神、使命及行为准则。WIC 认为需要更强措施来保护速拧社群、恢复该地区选手对 WCA 的信任，并明确此类行为不会被容忍。两人在比赛现场的存在被认定具有高度破坏性，因此给予多年禁止参赛及到场的处分。
  • 接报一名选手在多场比赛中反复扰乱秩序。联系相关代表后，确认其持续未妥善完成各类工作任务，也不遵从代表指示。鉴于其曾因同类行为被禁赛，决定再次禁止其参赛。
  • 接报一名选手反复出现问题行为。代表称该选手未受事先挑衅，却对另一名选手越界。鉴于已因相同行为两度被禁赛，决定多年禁止其参赛及到场。
  • 接报一名受处分选手仍到场参加多场比赛。其原处分同时禁止参赛及到场，因此将禁令改为永久，直到其连续不出席比赛的时间达到原禁令期限。
  • 接报一名选手盲拧时被发现使用 CFOP 公式，代表也指出口琴架使用不当。选手承认作弊，但称此前没有作弊；然而我们在网上找到另一段以类似方式完成的盲拧视频。相关成绩被取消，选手被短期禁赛。

WIC 上月开放招募，新成员即将加入。以下人员接受了职位：

  • Alexander Mutch（2014MUTC01）—加拿大，不列颠哥伦比亚；
  • Amanda Schmid（2017SCHM12）—美国，俄亥俄；
  • Amélie Dieterich（2016DIET01）—德国；
  • Austin Reed（2011REED01）—美国，纽约；
  • Bertie Longden（2014LONG06）—英国，南部；
  • Hayden Ng（2018NGHA02）—澳大利亚，昆士兰；
  • Jason Chang（2023CHAN15）—美国，加利福尼亚；
  • Mohamed Arif（2019ARIF05）—印度；
  • Noah Swor（2017SWOR01）—美国，佛罗里达；
  • Yuji Yoshida（2015YOSH01）—菲律宾；
  • Zachary Miller（2017MILL04）—美国，马萨诸塞。

2025 年，WIC 计划加强代表培训与指导，重点是选手安全和福祉。这些工作自 2024 年已开始，仍有许多待完成。新成员带来的丰富个人和职业经验，将帮助 WIC 更有效地分配职责与项目。祝贺所有新成员！

如有问题，可发送邮件至 integrity@worldcubeassociation.org，或在 WCA 论坛诚信板块提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 16 cases and closed 14. This resulted in eight bans, three warnings, two with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of negative behavior by two competitors at multiple competitions. We contacted several potential witnesses and discovered a persistent pattern of bullying, harassment, abuse, and intimidation that undermines the WCA’s Spirit, Mission, and Code of Conduct. The WIC determined that stronger measures were necessary to protect the integrity of the speedcubing community, restore confidence in the WCA amongst speedcubers within this particular region, and send a clear message that such behaviour will not be tolerated. We considered the presence of both competitors at competitions highly disruptive and therefore issued a multi-year ban from both competing and attending WCA competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of recurrent, disruptive behavior of a competitor at multiple competitions. We contacted the involved delegates and, after receiving their concerns, concluded that the accused competitor consistently failed to properly perform various tasks and comply with delegates’ directions. Considering that the accused competitor had already been banned for this kind of behavior, we decided to issue a ban from competing.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of recurrent and problematic behavior of a competitor. The delegate informed us that the accused competitor crossed boundaries with another competitor, without any prior provocation. Considering that the accused competitor had already been banned twice for the same behavior, we decided to issue a multi-year ban from competing and attending WCA competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed that a banned competitor had been attending multiple competitions. Given that the accused competitor had been banned from both competing and attending WCA competitions, the ban conditions were changed to permanent until the competitor does not attend competitions consistently for the length of their original ban.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed that a competitor was caught using CFOP algorithms while solving blindfolded. The delegates also highlighted the poor use of the harmonica holder. The competitor admitted to cheating, but claimed that he had not cheated before that particular attempt. However, we discovered a video online from another blindfolded attempt that was achieved using a similar method. The affected results were disqualified and the competitor was given a short ban.

The WCA Integrity Committee opened a call for applicants last month. New members will be onboarded soon. The following members accepted positions onto the WIC:

  • Alexander Mutch (2014MUTC01) - Canada (British Columbia)
  • Amanda Schmid (2017SCHM12) - USA (Ohio)
  • Amélie Dieterich (2016DIET01) - Germany
  • Austin Reed (2011REED01) - USA (New York)
  • Bertie Longden (2014LONG06) - United Kingdom (South)
  • Hayden Ng (2018NGHA02) - Australia (Queensland)
  • Jason Chang (2023CHAN15) - USA (California)
  • Mohamed Arif (2019ARIF05) - India
  • Noah Swor (2017SWOR01) - USA (Florida)
  • Yuji Yoshida (2015YOSH01) - Philippines
  • Zachary Miller (2017MILL04) - USA (Massachusetts)

For 2025, the WCA Integrity Committee plans to invest in initiatives towards better training and guidance for Delegates with an emphasis on competitor safety and well-being. These initiatives began in 2024, and there is still a lot of work to be done. These new members bring us a wide range of personal and professional experiences that will allow the WIC to more effectively separate delegate responsibilities and projects. Congratulations to all of the new members!

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email (integrity@worldcubeassociation.org), or ask your question in the Integrity section of the WCA forum.

title.zh: 裁判尚未明确检查魔方，选手便开始转动
title.en: Competitor turned the puzzle before the judge had clearly inspected it

html.zh:
还原后，裁判记录成绩时，选手拿起魔方并开始转动，裁判没有处罚。代表随后审查视频，认为选手再次转动前裁判并未明确检查魔方，依据 A6e1 判为 DNF。之后与裁判交谈时，裁判确认自己记录前已确认魔方还原。

WRC 撤销 DNF。虽然裁判没有明显检查动作，但流程已超过本应检查魔方的阶段，选手在当时拿起并转动魔方是合理的。

视频证明魔方已还原，但 WRC 不认为这一点与本决定相关。A6e 要求裁判检查，而非仅基于魔方状态判断。本案视频无法确定裁判是否检查，最终由上述其他因素决定。若允许用显示已还原状态的视频推翻 A6e，可能使代表和 WRC 因审核此类视频而承担不必要增加的工作量。
html.en:
After a solve, a competitor picked up their puzzle and began to turn it again while the judge was recording the result. No penalty was issued by the judge. Competition Delegates subsequently reviewed video footage of the attempt and chose to disqualify (DNF) the result based on Regulation A6e1, as the judge had not clearly inspected the puzzle before the competitor began to turn it in again. When Delegates later spoke to the judge, he confirmed the puzzle was solved before recording the result.

The WRC chose to remove the DNF penalty. While the judge had not clearly inspected the puzzle, the attempt had moved past the point at which the puzzle would be subject to inspection and it was reasonable for the competitor to pick up and turn their puzzle at the time they did.

While video evidence demonstrated that the puzzle was solved, the WRC did not consider this relevant to this decision. Regulation A6e requires the judge to inspect the puzzle, rather than being based on the puzzle's state. In this case the video evidence for the judge inspecting the puzzle was inconclusive, but the other factors described above drove the WRC's overall decision. If video demonstrating a solved state could be used to override A6e then this could lead to an undesirable increase in workload for Delegates and the WRC from assessing such videos.

title.zh: 代表为自己即将参赛的组开始打乱
title.en: Delegate started scrambling for a group they were to compete in

html.zh:
某组开始时，一名负责台面管理的代表见许多裁判已在打乱台等候，便帮忙打乱最初几个魔方。随后他意识到自己也应参加本组。与另一名代表商量后，他们决定不生成新打乱组，而是因该代表只看过第一条，给他使用 E1。

打乱不得让选手看到（WSAP 5.1.1）。选手必须为自己的组打乱时，应防止其看到尚未尝试的打乱（1h1）。该代表打乱了几个魔方并能接触打乱文件，因此有机会看到本组全部打乱。为维护保密要求，WRC 决定删除该平均的全部成绩。

代表被视为高度可信，并负有特定的打乱管理责任；但以选手身份参赛时，仍须遵守适用于选手的打乱保密要求。
html.en:
A delegate was doing table management at the start of a group when they decided to help out scrambling the first couple of cubes because many judges were already waiting at the scrambling table. After scrambling a few cubes, the delegate realized that they themselves were supposed to compete in the current group. After consulting with another delegate, they decided to not generate a new set of scrambles, but instead give the delegate that was to compete E1, as they had only seen the first scramble.

Scrambles must not be visible to competitors (WSAP 5.1.1), and if competitors are required to act as scrambles for their own group, they must be prevented from seeing any scrambles they have not yet attempted (1h1). By scrambling some cubes and having access to the scrambling document, the delegate did have the opportunity to see all scrambles of the group. In accordance with maintaining scramble secrecy requirements, the WRC concluded that all results from the average must be removed. Delegates are considered highly trustworthy and have specific responsibilities for handling scrambles. However, when they act in a competitor role, scramble secrecy requirements applying to competitors must still apply to them.

title.zh: 两只魔方的多盲尝试收到两个相同打乱
title.en: Competitor received two identical scrambles on a 2-cube MBLD attempt

html.zh:
一名选手进行 2 个魔方的多盲，打乱失误导致两者打乱相同。选手继续尝试，结束后才报告。此时比赛代表自己也在进行多盲，因此由裁判给予额外尝试。

依据 1c，裁判代代表给予的额外尝试可采用，因为该条允许代表将职责交给他人。

提醒代表和主办方：若所有代表同时参赛，应提前指定专人监督，并在必要时负责给予额外尝试。

提醒选手：多盲中遇到重复打乱，应立即向代表、主办方或裁判提出，而非继续完成尝试。
html.en:
A competitor attempted 2 puzzles in an attempt of multi-blind. A scrambling mistake was made such that both cubes got the same scramble. The competitor continued with their attempt and only reported the mistake after the attempt. However, the delegates of the competition were doing MBLD attempts themselves at this time. Because of this, an extra attempt was granted to the competitor by the judge.

Citing 1c, it was ruled that using the extra attempt granted by the judge (in lieu of the delegates) was fine to use, as this regulation allows for delegates to appoint responsibilities to other people.

As a general reminder to delegates and organizers, if all delegates are competing at the same time, a specific individual should be prior appointed to have oversight and be in charge of giving out extras if necessary.

As a reminder for competitors: if facing a similar situation of encountering duplicate scrambles in a multiblind attempt, bring this up to the delegates/organizers/judges immediately instead of proceeding with the attempt.

title.zh: 手掌过度出汗的选手无法停表
title.en: Competitor with excessive sweating unable to stop timer

html.zh:
一名选手因身体状况导致手掌过度出汗。受计时器特性影响，汗水过多时可能需要更用力或多次尝试才能停表。本案感应区过湿，计时器无法停止。代表了解该选手及其情况，给予了额外尝试。

WRC 认定，这一决定完全合理。

有类似状况的选手应依据 2s，在比赛之前联系代表寻求适当安排。可能的安排包括用手背停表，但必须先得到代表批准。
html.en:
A competitor with a condition experiences excessive sweating on the palms of their hands. Due to the nature of timers, excessive sweat on the hands can require the competitor to stop the timer with more force or attempting multiple times to stop the timer. In this case, the timer would not stop due to the excessive moisture on the sensors. The delegate were familiar with the competitor and their condition, and in this incident, granted an extra attempt.

The WRC ruled that the decision to give an extra attempt was entirely reasonable.

Competitors who experience a similar condition should contact their delegate prior to a competition to seek accommodations, per 2s. A possible accommodation can be stopping the timer with the back of the hands -- however, this should only be done after a delegate approves of this behavior.

title.zh: 选手成绩单遗失
title.en: Competitor's scorecard went missing

html.zh:
一名选手参加三阶单手后发现成绩未录入，搜索场地仍未找到成绩单。没有怀疑选手故意弄丢，代表讨论后给予暂定的额外尝试。选手最初倾向记录为 DNS，后来同意完成额外尝试。

WRC 认定，既然额外尝试已在比赛现场完成，就必须使用；若没有可用成绩，才适合记为 DNS。

需注意：成绩单遗失且非选手过错时，选手有权获得额外尝试，工作人员应予提供。选手可选择完成这些尝试或记为 DNS。
html.en:
A competitor competed in the 3x3 OH event, but later recognized that their results had not been entered. After searching the venue, the scorecard remained missing. The competitor was not suspected of deliberately misplacing their scorecard, so after discussion amongst delegates, it was agreed to grant the competitor provisional extra attempts. The competitor initially preferred to have their results marked as a DNS, but later agreed to complete the extra attempts.

The WRC ruled that since the provisional extras were completed at the competition, the extras must be used. If there were no results available, then a DNS would have been appropriate.

As an important note: if a competitor's scorecard goes missing at no fault of their own, then they are entitled to an extra, and one should be provided. Competitors then have the option of choosing to complete these extras or to DNS them.

title.zh: 选手收到错误顺序的打乱
title.en: Competitor received incorrect order of scrambles

html.zh:
七阶某轮中，选手第一次误收第二条打乱，未通过及格线。发现错误后，暂让选手进行第一条打乱，仍未通过。

与无及格线轮次中打乱交换的情况一样，成绩应重新排序，因此仅保留使用第一条打乱的成绩。
html.en:
During a round of 7x7, a competitor was mistakenly given scramble 2 for their first attempt. The competitor did not make cutoff. Realizing the mistake, the competitor was given scramble 1 provisionally, and also did not make cutoff.

As would be done with swapped scrambles in a non-cutoff round, the results have to be rearranged, so the result of the attempt with scramble 1 was kept as the only recorded result.

title.zh: 选手补签另一张成绩单后复位计时器
title.en: Competitor reset timer after signing a different scorecard

html.zh:
选手参加三阶单手时，代表发现其另一项目成绩单漏签。还原结束后，代表前来请其补签。随后选手在裁判尚未记录当前时间前复位计时器，现场给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 投票决定该次为 DNF，因为签署另一张成绩单与当前还原无关。选手须对复位负责，A6f1 的处罚也很明确。
html.en:
The delegates of a competition discovered a missing signature for a competitor's scorecard for another event while they were competing in 3x3 One-Handed. After the competitor finished their solve, the delegate approached them, prompting them to add the missing signature. The competitor then reset their timer before the judge was able to write down the time for the current attempt. A provisional extra was given for this attempt.

The WRC voted to have the result for this attempt be a DNF, as having signed the other scorecard is unrelated to their actual solve. The competitor is responsible for resetting the timer in this incident, and A6f1 is clear about the penalty.

title.zh: 观察时三脚架倒在选手身上，选手停止尝试
title.en: Tripod fell on competitor during inspection and stopped attempt

html.zh:
观察时，选手自己的三脚架倒在身上。选手以为按旧规则不能触碰手机，认为已经 DNF，便停止尝试。按较新规则，将三脚架放回原位并不会导致成绩取消。现场给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 依据 2t 认定，选手有责任在参赛前熟悉最新版规则。因此事件属选手自身过错，该次判为 DNF。
html.en:
During inspection, a competitor's tripod fell on them. The competitor stopped the solve, thinking it was a DNF since they believed they could not touch their phone (as was a previous rule). Under newer regulations, putting the tripod back in place would not have disqualified the solve. The competitor was granted a provisional extra.

The WRC ruled that given regulation 2t, the competitor is reponsible for being familiar with the newest version of the WCA regulations before competing. Therefore, this incident is at the fault of the competitor, and the attempt was ruled a DNF.

title.zh: 成绩单遗失后找回，选手决赛成绩被删除
title.en: Scorecards misplaced and later found, removing competitor from round

html.zh:
选手 X、Y 争夺决赛名额，第一轮成绩接近，X 略胜 Y。正式录入前，两人将成绩单拿到一旁自行计算，过程中成绩单遗失。

代表预先明确处理方案：两人用新打乱重赛第一轮以确定晋级者；若找回原成绩单，新成绩不采用；若“错误”的人参加了决赛，则两人都不晋级。这符合 9t。选手同意，重赛中 Y 更快，进入决赛。

轮次结束很久后，原成绩单被找到。依事先约定，删除 Y 的决赛成绩；X 本来就没有任何决赛成绩。

成绩单遗失是选手过错，代表又已给出完整方案，因此 WRC 同意遵循代表决定。WRC 建议类似情况下，若可能，应让两人均暂时参加决赛。
html.en:
Two competitors, competitor X and competitor Y, were both vying for a spot in the final round. Their round 1 results were very close, with competitor X beating out competitor Y, and the competitors took their scorecards aside to do their own calculations before the scores were properly entered. Somewhere along this process, the scorecards were misplaced and could not be found.

The delegates lines up a clear set of circumstances for a procedure: The competitors would redo the first round on a new set of scrambles to determine who would go to the final. The new results would not stand if the original scorecards turned up, and if the "wrong" person competed in the final, then neither of them would advance. These circumstances are in line with Regulation 9t. The competitors agreed to this, and in these new attempts, competitor Y was faster and was placed in the final.

Much later, after the rounds, the original scorecards were found. Since the delegates and competitors had agreed on a procedure, competitor Y's results were removed from the final. Note that competitor X did not have any results for the final at all.

The competitors were at fault for misplacing their scoresheets, and since the delegates had laid out a complete plan of actions, the WRC agreed that it was best to stick to the delegate decision. The WRC recommends in similar situations that both competitors compete in the final provisionally if at all possible.

title.zh: 成绩单时间写有问号
title.en: Question mark written on scorecard

html.zh:
成绩单时间写成“57.?”。代表试图联系裁判和选手，未获回应；赛后邮件询问选手，也未收到回复。

代表推测，问号可能表示裁判或选手在时间写下前复位了计时器。

WRC 同意记为 DNF。选手提前复位确实是一种可能解释，且并非不太可能，因此依据 A7c+ 应为 DNF。
html.en:
The time written on a scorecard appeared as "57.?". The delegates tried locating the judge and competitor for the attempt, but were unable to get a response. The competitor was emailed after the competition asking what happened, but no response was given.

The delegates made the assumption that the question mark on the scorecard meant that the timer was reset by either the competitor or judge before the time was written down.

The WRC agrees with the decision to record this result as a DNF. One possible explanation of what occurred during this attempt is indeed that the competitor reset the timer prematurely, and this situation is not unlikely, thus, under A7c+, the result should be a DNF.

title.zh: 只有逐帧视频分析才能看出的不合规启动计时器
title.en: Competitor started the timer improperly, only visible with frame-by-frame video analysis

html.zh:
发现许多成绩的计时器启动方式违反 A4b 或 A4b1，但正常速度观看视频看不出来。

A4b：选手须用手指触碰 Stackmat 计时器凸起的感应面，掌心朝下，手掌位于计时器靠近自己的一侧；处罚为加 2 秒。 A4b1：开始还原时不得与魔方有身体接触；处罚为加 2 秒。

此前，WRC 根据这起事件，仅以正常速度视频判断处罚。进一步讨论后，WRC 改变处理方式，对此处声明所述特定成绩使用逐帧分析，并经 WCA 理事会许可追溯检查历史成绩。因此，WRC 分析了多项成绩，并对符合条件的情况施加相应处罚。

本案分析计时器启动的方法为：

  1. 确定视频帧率，将尝试时间换算为帧数并向上取整。例如 60 FPS 下，0.74 秒为 44.4 帧，取 45 帧。
  2. 确定计时器最早可能停止的帧。若两帧皆可能，例如停表发生在两帧之间，选较早一帧。至少两名成员须确认停表帧。
  3. 回退第 1 步计算的帧数，将落到的帧视为启动帧，作为处罚分析依据。至少两名成员须确认启动帧。
  4. 只有 WRC 强烈确信存在违规时才施加处罚，并通过投票确定。

受影响尝试详情及最终决定见公告。WCA 规则将更新，以体现 WRC 处理方式的变化。
html.en:
Many instances of results where timers were started in ways that violated Regulation A4b and/or Regulation A4b1 were discovered, but were not visible when viewing footage at full speed.

A4b) The competitor uses their fingers to touch the elevated sensor surfaces of the Stackmat timer. The competitor's palms must be facing down, and located on the side of the timer that is closer to the competitor. Penalty: time penalty (+2 seconds). A4b1) The competitor must have no physical contact with the puzzle while starting the solve. Penalty: time penalty (+2 seconds).

Previously, the WRC only viewed footage at full speed to determine penalties, based on this incident. After further discussion, the WRC decided to change its approach to use frame-by-frame analysis to determine penalties on certain results as described here, and with the permission of the WCA Board of Directors, to do so retroactively on past results. As a result, the WRC analyzed various results and applied the corresponding penalties to applicable cases.

The approach used by WRC to analyze timer starts in this case can be seen as follows:

  1. The video’s frame rate is determined, and the time of the attempt in frames is calculated and rounded up (Example: 0.74 Seconds = 44.4 frames, rounded up to 45 frames @ 60 FPS).
  2. The first frame in which the timer could have been stopped is determined. If there are two frames where the timer could have been stopped (i.e. the stop likely happened in between two frames), the earlier frame is selected. At least two members must confirm the timer stop frame.
  3. The video is rewound by the number of frames calculated in step 1. The frame that the video ends up on after the rewind is considered the timer start and used as a basis to analyze for penalties. At least two members must confirm the timer start frame.
  4. A penalty is only applied if the WRC strongly believes that a violation of the Regulation(s) occurred. This is determined through a vote.

For more details regarding the affected attempts, please see this announcement on the final WRC decision.

The WCA Regulations will be updated to reflect this change in the WRC’s approach.

title.zh: 选手轮次结束后报告错误打乱，但视频不清楚
title.en: Competitor claimed misscramble after round but video footage was unclear

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，11i 已更新，对错误打乱何时应获额外尝试设定更严格标准。

轮次结束后，选手查看应收到的打乱并报告自己收到错误打乱。虽然有录像，但质量很差，仅凭视频无法判断打乱是否正确。代表决定给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 复核后同样无法确定，因此决定依代表酌情判断：代表应根据与选手的沟通判断，若认为收到错误打乱更有可能，则给予额外尝试。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated to provide stricter criteria for when a misscramble should receive an extra.

After the conclusion of a round, a competitor looked at the scrambles they were supposed to receive and reported to have gotten a misscramble. There was a video recording of the solve, but it was very poor footage, and it was unclear whether or not the scramble was correct based solely on the footage. The delegates decided to provide a provisional extra.

The WRC reviewed the footage and were also unable to determine whether or not the scramble was correct. As a result, the ruling was to rely on delegate discretion - delegates should make the decision based on their interactions with a competitor, and give an extra if they believe it is more likely that the competitor received a misscramble.

title.zh: 尝试结束时魔表未完全保持组装状态
title.en: Clock not fully intact at end of attempt

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，新增了 10h1a，明确此类事件处理方式。

结束尝试时，选手的魔表原地“散开”。部分固定螺丝松脱，塑料框明显偏离正常位置。完整的背面支持魔表已还原的判断，但部件未正确组装。

查看照片后，WRC 依据 5b5f 判为已还原：若将外壳组回与当时位置最接近的状态，所有指针都会指向 12 点。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, regulation 10h1a has been introduced to clearly define how these incidents should be handled.

Upon ending an attempt, a competitor's clock "exploded" in place. Some of the screws holding the puzzle together had come undone, and the plastic framing was noticeably out of its home position. The puzzle was clearly solved (supported by the intact, complete backside), but the pieces were not assembled correctly.
