After reviewing picture evidence, the WRC ruled the puzzle to be in a solved state, citing Regulation 5b5f to make the decision. If one were to put the plastic casing of the puzzle back together in the closest position to where it was, all of the dials of the clock would be pointing to the noon position.

title.zh: 正式尝试使用奇艺计时器
title.en: Qiyi timer used for official attempts

html.zh:
发现一场比赛在正式尝试中使用奇艺计时器。代表提供了使用该计时器的选手尝试清单，但无法确定清单完整、准确地列出了全部受影响尝试。

由于很可能已有大量正式还原使用该计时器，难以确定具体是哪些。无法准确确定受影响范围时，只将部分成绩判 DNF 或删除、却保留其他成绩，并不公平。

经过慎重考虑，WRC 决定删除该比赛全部成绩。此决定符合这类先例。
html.en:
A competition was found to have used a Qiyi timer for official attempts. The delegate supplied a list of competitors' attempts that were done on the Qiyi timer, however, it was unclear if this list was complete and had correctly enumerated all of the affected attempts.

Considering that there was likely a large amount of official solves done on the timer, it would be quite difficult to discern exactly which solvers were done using it. Consequently, due to the lack of confidence in the exact solves that were affected, it would not be fair to DNF/remove some results and not others.

In a decision that was not taken lightly, the WRC decided to remove all results from the competition. Please note that this decision falls in line with precedent such as this incident.

title.zh: 尝试结束前裁判短暂触碰魔表
title.en: Judge briefly touched puzzle before conclusion of attempt

html.zh:
选手停表前掉落魔表，裁判介入并触碰魔表，之后选手才将其拾起、完成尝试。

裁判为确认是否还原而作出的合理检查，可能短暂阻止选手重新拿起魔表，但选手未正确停表造成的不利影响，大于裁判介入带来的不利。因此保留原尝试成绩。
html.en:
A competitor had dropped their clock before stopping the timer and the judge interfered and touched the clock before the competitor picked it up and completed the attempt.

While the judge's reasonable attempt to verify if the puzzle was indeed solved may have briefly prevented the competitor from picking up the clock again, the negative impact of the competitor not stopping the timer correctly outweighs any disadvantage caused by the judge's interference. As a result, the original attempt is kept.

title.zh: 选手同时受到他人干扰并遇到计时问题
title.en: Competitor was distracted by another competitor and simultaneously faced a timer issue

html.zh:
一名选手进行金字塔尝试时，另一名选手开始与其讲话。受影响选手完成尝试后叫来代表申请额外尝试，但计时器显示 0.000。选手称自己出于习惯在还原后立即复位；一名裁判却说，自己听见选手完成时说没有启动计时器。

两起事件同时出现，使情况复杂：他人干扰与计时问题。干扰程度及发生时间均不清楚，例如是在观察中，还是极短的还原过程中。

一般而言，同一次尝试出现两起事件，先发生者优先。本案无法确定顺序；若干扰始于观察，则顺序便可确定。由于 WRC 不掌握干扰强度和持续时间，决定留给代表酌情判断，并建议：若干扰始于观察且程度显著，可以采用额外尝试；否则应判 DNF。最终记录为 DNF。
html.en:
During a competitor's pyraminx attempt, a different competitor began talking to them. The affected competitor, upon completing their attempt, called for a delegate to request an extra. However, the timer display showed 0.000. The affected competitor claimed that due to habit, they had immediately reset the timer after their solve. However, a judge mentioned that they heard the competitor mention that they had not started the timer upon completion of the solve.

This is a particularly complex situations because of two incidents occurring in tandem: the distraction from the other competitor, and the timer situation. It was unclear the extent of the distraction by the other competitor as well as when the distraction occurred (i.e. during inspection, in the midst of the very short solve, etc).

In general, if two incidents occur during the same attempt, the incident that occurred first takes precedence. In this situation, it was not possible to determine for certain which incident occurred first. If the distraction occurred during inspection, then the ordering of incidents would be known. Due to the lack of information the WRC had regarding the magnitude and duration of the distraction, the decision was left to delegate discretion, suggesting that if the distraction started during inspection and was significant, then an extra could be used. Otherwise, the penalty should be a DNF. In the end, the result was marked as a DNF.

title.zh: 金字塔轮次出现大量错误打乱
title.en: Pyraminx round affected by a great amount of misscrambles

html.zh:
赛后，两名金字塔选手告知代表，第一轮打乱几乎全部错误。两人合计 10 次中仅 3 次正确，其余存在小角方向或数量错误，或以错误朝向打乱。

WRC 作出了删除受影响金字塔轮次的艰难决定。错误率高，可供核查的视频又很有限，几乎不可能确保所有选手打乱难度相当。因此决定删除该轮，最终意味着删除金字塔全部轮次。
html.en:
After a competition had ended, a delegate received messages from two of the pyraminx solvers indicating that their scrambles for the first round of pyraminx were almost entirely wrong. Between the two competitors, only 3 out of 10 scrambles they received were correct, with the remaining being off by a tip (both direction and quantity) or scrambled in the wrong orientation.

The WRC made the tough decision to remove the affected Pyraminx round. Given the high misscramble rate and the very limited videographic evidence available to check, ensuring that scrambles were equal in difficulty for all competitors would be nearly impossible. As a result, the decision was to remove the affected round, which would ultimately mean removing all rounds of Pyraminx.

title.zh: 误以为打乱生成不正确而重赛
title.en: Round re-run after scrambles were found to be "incorrectly" generated

html.zh:
六阶和七阶各一轮结束后，工作人员发现打乱由 TNoodle“手动模式”生成，认为轮次无效，决定重赛。

通常在 TNoodle 中选择具体比赛生成打乱更简单，但并无规定禁止手动模式。因此建议采用原成绩。不过，主办方和代表认为原成绩无效，已在比赛期间丢弃成绩单，所以最终使用了六阶、七阶重赛轮次成绩。
html.en:
After a round of 6x6 and 7x7 had concluded, the staff found that the scrambles were generated under "manual mode" with TNoodle. They thought that this made the round invalid and decided to re-run the rounds.

While it is typically simpler to generate scramble sets for a selected competition in TNoodle, there is no prohibition against using manual mode. As a result, it was encouraged to use the original results. However, these scorecards were discarded during the competition, as the organizers and delegates believed that they would be invalid. Therefore, the results of the "re-run" rounds of 6x6 and 7x7 were used.

title.zh: 选手连续遭遇打乱和魔方错配
title.en: Competitor faced a sequence of misscrambles

html.zh:
一名选手遭遇一连串打乱及魔方错配，某次拿到不同魔方，还不止一次收到同一打乱。选手两次 DNF，以为平均注定 DNF。轮次结束后才发现其中一次实际上是重复打乱，因此保留那次 DNF 并不公平。

选手原本放弃并记为 DNS 的剩余尝试，仍可能组成有效平均。WRC 依据 11d，从公平竞赛角度认为应交由代表酌情判断。在这一特殊情况下，将尝试顺序正确重排，并恢复了选手剩余尝试机会。
html.en: A competitor was caught in a frenzy of misplaced scrambles and cubes, receiving a different cube on one occasion and a particular scramble more than once. The competitor DNFed two attempts, which gave them the impression that they would DNF the average. However, it was noticed after the round that one of these was actually a duplicate scramble, which meant that it wasn’t fair to retain the DNF on it. Since they could still get an average on the remaining solves that were originally DNSed by them, the WRC decided under 11d that it was best to leave this to delegate discretion in the pretext of fair sportsmanship. The solves were re-ordered appropriately and the remaining attempts were granted back to the competitor under such unique circumstances.

title.zh: 代表在还原结束后给予自己额外尝试
title.en: Delegate awarded themselves an extra attempt after attempt had concluded

html.zh:
一名参赛的代表在四阶还原中拿到了他人的魔方。虽然未因此分心，他在还原后意识到问题并决定给予自己额外尝试，且在裁判记录前立即复位了计时器。现场其他代表意见不一，因为另一名选手遇到类似问题，却因未受干扰而没有获得额外尝试。

WRC 决定交由代表酌情判断，但强烈建议保留原尝试结果，即本案中的 DNF，因为选手直到完成还原才请求额外尝试（见 11e+++）。
html.en: A delegate at this competition was competing and received another competitor’s cube on a 4x4 solve. While the delegate wasn’t distracted by this, he realized and decided to grant himself an extra after the solve, resetting the timer immediately before it was recorded by the judge. There was a split opinion amongst the other delegates at this competition as to whether this warranted the extra, since another competitor also had a similar issue but didn’t receive an extra on account of not being distracted. While the WRC decided to leave this up to delegate discretion, we strongly advised that the original attempt (in this case, DNF) be kept, as the competitor did not request an extra until the solve was complete (see 11e+++)

title.zh: 选手比赛时使用明显损坏的耳机
title.en: Competitor used visibly broken headphones during attempt

html.zh:
发现一名选手比赛时戴着耳机。耳机未连接且明显损坏，选手已经剪断耳机线。WRC 决定保留成绩，指出在 2i 的语境下，明显损坏的耳机可视为非电子设备。

提醒：仅断开连接、但仍保有电子部件的耳机不允许使用（见 2i）。
html.en: A competitor was found to be wearing headphones while competing. The headphones were disconnected and were clearly broken (the competitor had cut the headphone cables). The WRC decided to keep the result, indicating that headphones that are clearly broken can be considered non-electronic for the purposes of 2i. As a kind reminder, disconnected headphones are NOT allowed if they still have electronic parts (see 2i)

title.zh: 选手和裁判均不确定何时停表
title.en: Competitor and judge were unsure of when timer was stopped

html.zh:
尝试接近结束时，选手放下魔方准备停表，却意识到尚未还原，于是补转一步再停表。裁判不确定计时器在第一次还是第二次停表动作时停止。现场给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 决定交由代表酌情判断。如果裁判和代表都无法确定发生了什么，建议采用额外尝试。
html.en:
Towards the end of an attempt, a competitor dropped their puzzle and went to stop the timer, then realized that the puzzle wasn't yet solved and went to fix the puzzle (by applying one move) and then stopping the timer. The judge was unsure of if the timer was stopped on the competitor's first or second attempt of stopping the timer. A provisional extra was granted.

The WRC ruled to leave this incident up to delegate discretion. If the judge and delegate are both unsure about what had happened, then it is recommended to use an extra.

title.zh: 还原中计时器翻转
title.en: Timer flipped over during an attempt

html.zh:
选手正常开始还原，但计时器松脱，翻转后倒扣在垫子上。选手继续完成还原，再将计时器摆正并停表。选手似乎因器材故障、而非自身过错受损，现场给予了暂定的额外尝试。

提醒，规则 11e 规定：

……为取得额外尝试资格，选手应在事件发生时、原尝试结束前，向裁判和代表口头或书面申诉……

虽然应在事件发生时申诉，但本案发生在速度很快的 Skewb 项目，计时器位移的影响可能直到准备停表时才明显。现场代表最有条件综合判断证据，因此此类情况交由代表酌情处理，并建议给予额外尝试。
html.en:
A competitor started their solve as per usual, but the timer came loose, flipped over and landed upside-down on the mat. The competitor proceeded to finish their solve before placing the timer back in position and stopping it. The competitor seemed to have been disadvantaged by an equipment malfunction through no fault of their own. A provisional extra was given.

As a reminder, from regulation 11e:

11e) ...The competitor should appeal verbally or in writing to the judge and WCA Delegate at the time of the incident, before finishing the original attempt, to be eligible for an extra attempt...

Although competitors should appeal when an incident occurs, the incident happened during Skewb, a quick event, and the impact of the timer movement may not have been apparent until the competitor tried to stop the timer. Competition Delegates are best placed to assess the overall evidence available in this case. Thus, situations like this are left to Delegate discretion, with an extra attempt being the recommendation.

title.zh: 选手认为记录时间比实际更快
title.en: Competitor believed time noted down was faster than actuality

html.zh:
完成 Skewb 平均后，选手告诉代表，第二次记录的 6.52 错了，应为 7.52。成绩单确实写着 6.52，选手和裁判均已签名，没有视频。讨论中，选手开始怀疑自己的记忆，越来越不确定实际时间。现场给予暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 建议不要采用额外尝试，时间究竟为 6.52 还是 7.52，应交由代表酌情判断。这需要评估全部证据，而现场代表通常最适合做此判断。可能不可靠的记忆本身并不是强证据。
html.en:
After a competitor had completed their Skewb average, they approached a delegate and mentioned that their second solve of 6.52 was incorrectly written, and should have instead been a 7.52. The time on the scoresheet was indeed written as 6.52 and was signed off by both the competitor and judge. No video was available of this attempt. During discussion, the competitor began second-guessing their memory and became increasingly unsure of what the actual time was. In the moment, a provisional extra was given.

The WRC advises not to use an extra attempt, and to leave the decision of whether the time should be 6.52 or 7.52 up to delegate discretion. Making such a decision is dependent on assessing all of the available evidence, and competition delegates are often best suited for this. It is worth noting that a potentially unreliable memory is not very strong evidence on its own.

title.zh: WIC 简报：2024 年第三季度
title.en: WIC Digest 2024-Q3

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

作为动议修订的一部分，WCA 诚信委员会（WIC）于 2024 年 8 月 1 日成立。WDC 与 WEC 合并，WIC 承接双方职能并增加职责。详情见近期公告。

WIC 一直在幕后推进合并，同时确保案件及时结案。团队成员来自 WCA 不同岗位，我们仍在适应新流程、学习相互支持，感谢耐心。现任成员完整名单可供查看。

合并后仍将每季度向社群通报纪律案件。上季度 WIC 与 WDC 合计立案 23 件、结案 17 件，作出 4 项禁赛、3 项警告；13 件未采取措施、维持争议中的代表裁定，或交回代表当地处理。部分重要案件如下：

  • 裁判因选手观察中转动叫来代表。选手起初否认故意，后来承认，并列出曾同样行为的比赛和项目。WIC 相信其对起始时间的陈述诚实，给予短期禁赛并取消全部受影响成绩。
  • 选手因不满意成绩，与裁判被发现共同记录不真实时间。两名年轻参与者获警告，成绩取消。
  • 选手提交的最少步解法不符合常见方法，显得不合法。询问后承认用手机找解，且此前部分尝试也如此，但不是全部。WIC 不认可其对开始作弊时间的说法，额外取消了认为受影响的成绩，并给予短期禁赛。
  • 代表报告选手可能欺凌他人，包括种族言论和身体伤害。WIC 得知行为持续已久。实施者不否认行为，但否认严重程度，获短期禁赛。
  • 结束三宗眼罩偷看案件。其中两案证据不足，无法确切证明或排除作弊；最后一案是代表因怀疑作弊取消成绩后遭争议。WIC 审查证据后同意代表结论。
  • 两名选手主动坦白，利用裁判分心或缺乏经验获得不合法成绩。成绩取消，但未采取进一步措施。WIC 感谢诚实。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在 WCA 论坛纪律板块提问，该板块很快将改为诚信板块。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

As of August 1st, 2024, the WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) was established as part of an amendment to the Motions. The WDC and WEC were merged and the WIC has taken on the role of both committees, with additional responsibilities. You can find more details in a recent announcement here.

The WIC has been hard at work behind the scenes merging the two committees while ensuring that cases close in a timely manner. We appreciate your patience as we continue to adapt to the new workflow and learn to support each other with team members coming from various places within the WCA. You can find a full list of current members here.

With this merger, the WIC will continue to update the community on a quarterly basis with disciplinary cases. In the last quarter, the WIC and WDC combined opened 23 disciplinary cases and closed 17. This resulted in four bans and three warnings. Thirteen cases ended with no action, upholding a delegate ruling in a dispute, or otherwise deferred back to delegates to manage locally. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases.

  • A judge called over a delegate regarding a competitor turning their puzzle during inspection. The competitor initially denied doing it intentionally, but later admitted to the delegates that they had turned intentionally and provided a list of competitions and events where they had also turned during inspection. The WIC believed the competitor was honest about when the behavior began. The competitor received a short ban and all affected results were disqualified.
  • A competitor and a judge were seen writing down an illegitimate time after the competitor was dissatisfied with the result. The two young participants were given a warning and the result was disqualified.
  • A competitor submitted a Fewest Moves solution that did not appear legitimate, as it did not follow typical methods. After confrontation, the competitor admitted to using their phone to find a solution and as well as doing so on past attempts, but not all attempts. The WIC disagreed as to when the competitor began cheating, and disqualified additional solves we believed were affected. The competitor received a short ban.
  • A delegate reported a competitor potentially engaging in bullying behavior, including racial remarks and physically harming the other competitor. The WIC learned this behavior has been ongoing for quite some time. The aggressor did not deny the behavior, but denied the severity of their behavior. The competitor received a short ban.
  • The WIC closed three cases involving blindfold peeking. Two cases did not have enough evidence to conclusively prove or disprove cheating. The last case involved a delegate ruling being disputed after the delegate(s) disqualified an attempt under suspicions of cheating. After reviewing the evidence, the WIC agreed with the delegate’s conclusions.
  • Finally, the WIC had two competitors come forward to confess results they achieved illegitimately by taking advantage of distracted or inexperienced judges. The results were disqualified but no further action was taken. The WIC is grateful for these competitor’s honesty.

Do you have questions for the WIC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum (to be updated to Integrity soon!).

title.zh: 选手设置摄像头时碰倒魔方罩
title.en: Competitor knocked over cover while setting up camera

html.zh:
说明：此后规则 A2e2 已更新，更明确地规定此类事件的处理方式。

一名选手设置摄像头时意外碰倒魔方罩。此类情况判为 DNF，而非 DNS，因为选手提前看见自己的魔方是由其自身过错造成。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: This has seen been updated with regulation A2e2, to more clearly define how this kind of incident should be handled

A competitor accidentally knocked over the cube cover while setting up their camera. Incidents like this are ruled as DNFs (not DNS's). The ruling is determined as such because it is the fault of the competitor that they are seeing their cube early.

title.zh: 魔表某个钟面偏离正常位置
title.en: A clock was displaced from usual position

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，新增了 10h1a，明确此类事件的处理方式。

选手魔表的一个钟面偏离正常位置。结束状态中所有指针均指向 12 点，但一个齿轮未与魔表正面完全齐平。由于所有指针方向正确，决定不予处罚。

此事件发生在 5b5f 引入之前。类似事件现在应按 5b5f 处理，将每个钟面视为其最接近的完整状态。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, regulation 10h1a has been introduced to clearly define how these incidents should be handled.

One clock on a competitor's puzzle was displaced from its usual position.

The ending state of the puzzle had all dials pointing to the 12 position, but one of the gears itself was not entirely flush with the puzzle's front. Given the fact that the dials were all pointed correctly, it was decided to not award any penalty to this attempt.

This incident occurred prior to the introduction of 5b5f. Incidents similar to this should now be ruled according to 5b5f, where each dial should be considered to be at its closest intact state.

title.zh: 规则变更后，选手因魔表倒下申请额外尝试
title.en: Competitor requested extra for falling clock after regulation change

html.zh:
裁判揭罩时，选手的魔表倒下。选手似乎不知道 F3 近期变更，请求额外尝试。代表给予了暂定的额外尝试。

选手缺少魔表经验，在本次及规则修改之前，正式还原次数少于 10 次。

鉴于其此前魔表经验不足，最终认为代表酌情给予额外尝试合理。
html.en:
A competitor's clock fell over when it was being uncovered by the judge. The competitor was seemingly unaware of the recent regulations changes with F3 and requested an extra attempt. The delegate provided a provisional extra.

The competitor was unexperienced in clock, having done < 10 official solves before this attempt and before the regulations changed.

The decision was that the extra attempt was considered reasonable with delegate discretion due to the competitor's inexperience with Clock prior to this attempt.

title.zh: 代表无意中更改盲拧轮次时限
title.en: Delegate inadvertently changed time limit for blindfolded round

html.zh:
三阶盲拧某轮开始前，代表向选手演示盲拧流程，期间误称累计时限为 12 分钟，而比赛网站写的是 10 分钟。轮次开始后才意识到错误。

一名选手前两次 DNF，第三次成功，但累计时间超过 10 分钟、少于 12 分钟。

相关规则 A1a3：

各轮时限必须赛前公布，受影响轮次开始后不应更改。变更由代表酌情决定，并须谨慎考虑公平性。

最终依据 A1a3，决定保留 12 分钟累计时限。代表在轮次开始前公布了较高时限，因此使用该时限完全公平。
html.en:
Prior to the start of a round of 3x3 blindfolded, a delegate did a demonstration to competitors showing how blind solving works. During this tutorial, the delegate inadvertently mentioned that the cumulative time limit for the round was 12 minutes whereas the competition website mentioned that it was 10 minutes.

This mistake was only realized after the round had commenced.

One competitor had DNFed their first two attempts but successfully solved their third attempt, but their cumulative time limit was greater than 10 minutes but less than 12 minutes.

The relevant regulation is A1a3:

A1a3) The time limits for all rounds must be announced before the competition, and should not be changed after any affected rounds have begun. Changes must be made at the discretion of the WCA Delegate, who must carefully consider the fairness of the change.

The decision was made to keep the time limit as 12 minutes cumulative, referencing A1a3 to make the decision. Considering the Delegate announced a higher time limit before the round, it is completely fair to use that time limit.

title.zh: 选手忘记抬起口琴架遮挡装置
title.en: Competitor forgot to lift harmonica holder

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，相关规则已更新。B4c3 明确选手有责任放置口琴架。

选手四阶盲拧该轮最后一次还原时，忘记抬起口琴架遮挡魔方视线，已经戴好眼罩并开始还原。代表注意到后，约在盲拧执行阶段开始 30 秒时，将遮挡板放到选手面前。

代表认为选手没有利用这一错误获益，给予了暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 同意接受原尝试而非额外尝试，理由是按当时 B4c，最终确保遮挡板正确放置是裁判责任；另见 B4c++。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the relevant Regulations have been updated. B4c3 indicates that competitors are responsible for placing the harmonica holder.

During the final solve of a competitor's 4x4 Blindfolded round, they forgot to life their harmonica holder to block sight from the cube. The competitor had already donned the blindfold and started to solve the puzzle. A delegate noticed this and was able to get a card in front of the competitor roughly 30 seconds into their solving stage.

The delegate deemed that the competitor was not using their error to their advantage and gave the competitor a provisional extra.

The WRC agreed to accept the original attempt and not the extra, basing the decision on how it is ultimately the judge's responsibility to ensure that the sight blocker is placed appropriately, as per B4c. Additionally, see B4c++.

title.zh: 魔方短暂落到腿上，随后以已还原状态掉到地上
title.en: Puzzle landed in competitor's lap and then on floor in solved state

html.zh:
选手还原结束时，魔方短暂落在腿上，随后以已还原状态掉到地上。

与代表讨论后，WRC 认为魔方很可能立即从选手身上弹开，因此依据 A6e2 的例外，不予处罚。
html.en:
At the end of a competitor's solve, the puzzle landed on the competitor's lap briefly, and then fell onto the floor in a solved state.

Upon discussion with the delegate, the WRC deemed that it was likely that the cube bounced off the competitor right away. Thus, by regulation A6e2's exception, it was concluded to not apply a penalty to this solve.

title.zh: 选手收到部分还原的魔方
title.en: Competitor received partially solved cube

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，11i2b 规定，未给予替代尝试的此类事件应为 DNS。

五魔方项目中，一名选手取得 4 次 DNF 和一次成功成绩。代表查看视频，确认与成绩单时间一致，但视频部分画面被魔方罩遮挡。

后来选手联系代表，说明该次尝试的五魔方未完全打乱。代表怀疑，选手前一次 DNF 是因超过时限，未还原的魔方被送回打乱台，传递员误以为已打乱。

WRC 同意将该次尝试判为 DNF。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, regulation 11i2b indicates that such an incident would be a DNS, since no replacement attempt was provided.

During the megaminx event, a competitor recorded times of 4 DNFs, and one completed solve. The delegate examined video evidence and verified that it aligned with the time written on the scorecard. Of note, the video was partially obstructed by a cube cover.

Later, the competitor contacted the delegate to inform them that the megaminx was not fully scrambled during the attempt. The delegates suspect that the competitor's prior attempt (DNF) was a result of the competitor going over the time limit, and the unsolved cube was sent back to the scramble table, where it was mistakenly perceived as scrambled by a runner.

The WRC agreed that the attempt should be ruled as a DNF.

title.zh: 下一轮开始后才发现不合规魔方
title.en: An illegal cube was discovered after a subsequent round had started

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，3k2 已更新，更明确地规定此类事件处理方式。

第二轮开始时发现，一名选手提交了不合规魔方，前一轮也用过。因此按 3k2，此前成绩改为 DNF。由于这是其第四场比赛，现场依据 A7g 暂时给予重新进行整轮的机会。

WRC 决定第一轮成绩仍为 DNF。第一轮已结束，不能依据 3k2a 发放第一轮额外尝试。第二轮已经开始，且原尝试有效，9l 也阻止以其他理由，例如 A7g，给予额外尝试。WRC 承认 9l 未定义“无效尝试”，会考虑在下一轮规则修订中澄清。

此外，即使能适用 A7g，WRC 也认为本案不应据此给予额外尝试，因为选手已有足够比赛经验（A7g++++）。虽然可能此前未遇到这部分规则，但许多情形都如此，选手应熟悉规则（2t）。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, regulation 3k2 has been updated to better define how an incident like this should be handled.

At the start of round 2 it was noticed that a competitor had submitted an illegal puzzle that had also been used in the previous round. Their previous results were therefore changed to DNF, following 3k2. As this was the competitor's fourth competition they were granted a provisional extra round under A7g.

The WRC decided that the round 1 results should remain DNF. Extra attempts can not be issued for round 1 using 3k2a as the round had finished. As the second round had started and the original attempts were valid, 9l also prevented extras being awarded for another reason, such as A7g. The WRC acknowledges that the concept of an invalid attempt in 9l is not defined and will consider clarifying this in the next regulations cycle.

Additionally, had A7g been available, the WRC's view is that it should not be applied to issue extra attempts in this situation as the competitor had enough competiton experience (A7g++++). While they may not have encountered this aspect of the WCA Regulations before, the same could be said in many situations, and competitors are expected to be familiar with the regulations (2t).

title.zh: 裁判未提示观察时间，选手观察超时
title.en: Judge did not call out inspection times, and competitor overinspected

html.zh:
裁判将选手的一句评论误当成“准备好了”。选手立即叫来代表，并获额外尝试。

后来发现，裁判在前四次还原均未提示 8 秒、12 秒。选手要求第五次更换裁判。

代表观看视频后确认裁判确实未报时；第二、三、四次还原的观察均超过 15 秒但不足 17 秒。

代表和 WRC 一致认定，选手经验足够，也有充分机会察觉裁判未报时。因此，该平均中观察超时的第二、三、四次均加 2 秒。
html.en:
A competitor had a judge who misinterpreted a comment by the competitor as them indicating that they were "ready". The competitor immediately called a delegate and was granted an extra solve.

Later, it was found that the judge was not calling out inspection times (8/12 seconds) for the first four solves. The competitor asked for the judge to be replaced for their fifth solve.

The delegates viewed video footage of the competitor's solves and deemed that the judge indeed did not call out 8/12 seconds. Additionally, the competitor had overinspected (above 15 seconds but below 17 seconds) for the second, third, and fourth solves.

The delegates and WRC agreed on the following ruling: the competitor was experienced enough and had enough chances to recognize that the judge was not calling out inspection times. The second, third, and fourth solves of the average (which had the overinspection) obtained a +2 penalty.

title.zh: 选手意外碰倒魔方罩后发现重复打乱
title.en: Competitor accidentally knocked over cube cover and realized they got a duplicate scramble

html.zh:
选手第一次尝试误收了第二条打乱。因错误尚未发现，第二次仍使用第二条打乱。选手坐下准备第二次尝试时，意外碰倒魔方罩，随后认出并确认与第一次打乱相同。

最终裁定为 DNF。本案同时存在两项错误：

  1. 收到重复打乱；
  2. 意外碰倒魔方罩。

第二项被认定为主要错误，因为选手碰倒罩时并不知道是重复打乱，即使碰倒是意外。

此决定也与历来常见的 DNS 和 DNF 区分一致：选手自愿放弃尝试时为 DNS，其他错误则为 DNF。
html.en:
A competitor was mistakenly given the second scramble for their first attempt. The second attempt was scrambled according to the second scramble (as the mistake was not yet known). Upon sitting down for the second attempt, the competitor accidentally knocked over the cover. The competitor then recognized and confirmed that they had received a duplicate scramble as it had matched the first attempt.

The finalized ruling was for the attempt to be DNFed. In this case, there were two mistakes that occurred simultaneously:

  1. the competitor obtained a repeat scramble
  2. the competitor accidentally knocked over the cube cover.

Here, the predominant mistake was deemed to be 2. as the competitor did not know it was a repeated scramble when knocking it, even if accidentally.

The decision also aligns with the historical and commonplace interpretations of the differences between a DNS and a DNF, where a DNS is given when a competitor voluntarily removes themselves from an attempt, and a DNF is given for other mistakes.

title.zh: 选手在轮次结束后声称收到错误打乱
title.en: Competitors claimed they got misscrambles after round

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，11i 已更新，对错误打乱何时应获额外尝试设定更严格标准。

三阶盲拧决赛后，两名选手告诉代表，第二次还原收到了错误打乱。两人该次均为 DNF，并称实际打乱比原定打乱更不容易处理。视频质量较差，无法明确证实错误打乱。代表决定给予暂定的额外尝试。

最终决定尊重代表的酌情判断，接受其给予的额外尝试。处理此事的代表最了解现场，也最有条件判断选手是否确实收到错误打乱。

此决定与事件 35类似。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated to provide stricter criteria for when a misscramble should receive an extra.

After the final round of 3x3 Blindfolded, a delegate was approached by two competitors who informed the delegate that they had received misscrambled on their second solves. Both competitors had DNFed their second solves, and the scramble they received was said to be less straightforward than the true scramble. Video evidence of the misscramble was inconclusive due to poor quality. The delegate decided to give the competitors provisional extra attempts.

The decision was to use the delegate discretion and accept the extra attempts that the delegates provided. This situation is best understood by the delegates handling the incident as they are the best equipped to determine if the competitor truly received a misscamble.

This decision is similar to the one outlined in incident 35.

title.zh: 赛末发现多盲魔方中心块触感可辨
title.en: Cube was found to have textured center for multiblind attempt at the end of competition

html.zh:
比赛结束后，代表发现一名选手用于多盲的某个魔方中心块触感有异，可以通过触摸与其他中心块区分。依据 3k2b，决定在相关尝试中将该魔方计为未还原，即两次尝试的成功数均减 1。

虽然无法确认该魔方在尝试结束时实际是否已还原，但提交合规魔方是选手责任，将其计为成功并不公平。此外，该魔方已还原的可能性也高于未还原。
html.en: After the competition had ended, delegates noticed that one of the cubes used by a competitor in Multiblind had a centerpiece that was texturally affected. The delegates noted that it was possible to distinguish the center from other centers by touch. The decision was to count the puzzle as unsolved for the attempts per 3k2b. That is, the number of solved puzzles for the two attempts both decreased by 1. Even though we cannot confirm whether or not the cube was actually solved at the end of the attempt, submitting a legal cube is the responsibility of the competitor and it would be unfair to count the puzzle as solved. Additionally, it is more likely that the cube was solved than unsolved.

title.zh: 选手将计时器碰落到腿上
title.en: Competitor knocked timer into lap

html.zh:
还原接近结束时，选手准备停表，却用魔方撞到计时器，使其在停表前掉到腿上。代表给予了暂定的额外尝试，同时保留原成绩。

最终决定保留原成绩、不采用暂定额外尝试，因为碰落计时器被认定为选手自身过错。
html.en:
Towards the end of a solve, when the competitor went to stop the timer, they bumped it with the puzzle and the timer fell into their lap before stopping the timer. The delegates awarded a provisional extra, but kept the original result.

The decision was made to keep the original result (not use the provisional), as it was deemed that it was the competitor's fault for knocking over the timer.

title.zh: 多盲结束停表后秒表被复位
title.en: Stopwatch reset after stopping multi-blind attempt

html.zh:
选手多盲接近结束时，裁判准备停止秒表。尝试结束后，裁判检查并清点魔方，再查看时间时发现秒表已复位为 0:00.00，很可能是意外。裁判和选手似乎都记得复位前完全相同的时间。

最终决定使用双方共同记得的时间，因为复位并非选手造成，且双方记忆一致。

虽然本案看似秒表故障，但也提醒大家：成绩记录并签名之前不得复位计时器。如果选手在时间完整写下前复位，必须记为 DNF（见 A6f1）。
html.en:
Towards the end of a competitor's multi-blind attempt, the judge went to go stop the stopwatch. After the attempt finished, the judge proceeded to check and count the cubes. They then went to reference the time on the stopwatch, but found that the timer had been reset (likely accidentally) to 0:00.00. The judge and competitor both seemed to remember the exact same time that was shown on the stopwatch prior to the accidental reset.

The decision was made to use the time that was shared in memory by the competitor and the judge since the competitor did not cause the reset and since the time remembered was the same by both the competitor and the judge.

While seemingly a malfunction of the stopwatch in this case, it serves as a reminder that timers should not be reset before the result is written down and signed for. If a competitor resets their timer before the time is fully written down, then it must be recorded as DNF (See Regulation A6f1).

title.zh: 选手在最少步开始前翻开打乱纸
title.en: Competitor flipped over FMC scramble before attempt began

html.zh: 一名选手在最少步尝试开始前翻开了打乱纸。代表确认已明确告知不得提前翻开。由于选手因自身过错看到了打乱，决定将该次尝试判为 DNF。
html.en: A competitor flipped over the scramble sheet for an FMC attempt before the attempt started. The delegates assure that they had made it clear not to flip over the paper prior to the attempt. Since the competitor saw the scramble due to their own flaw, it was decided to rule this attempt as a DNF.

title.zh: 赛后数天选手询问魔方是否不合规
title.en: Competitor asked about potentially illegal cube days after competition

html.zh:
赛后数天，一名选手联系代表，询问比赛中使用、并用于创造纪录的一个魔方是否合规。

选手称某个角块所处位置不同时，魔方声音不同；还提到一个中心盖的触感略有差别，因此该魔方可能不符合盲拧项目的规则要求，而该纪录正是在盲拧中取得。

最终决定保留成绩，依据是：

  1. 声音差异微乎其微，需要完全安静的环境才可能察觉，三阶盲拧比赛不太可能如此；
  2. 赛后才注意到声音差异，视频也显示没有获得优势；
  3. 代表在现场已认定触感差异合理。

3j1 允许魔方有合理磨损。鼓励选手向当地代表提出合规疑虑。指导 3j++ 中的图示指南也是良好参考。
html.en:
A few days after a competiton, a competitor contacted a delegate asking if one of the cubes they used at the competition (which was also a cube they used to set a record) was a legal puzzle.

The competitor claimed that the puzzle made different sounds depending on the location of a certain corner piece. They also mentioned that one center cap had a slighly different texture than the others (thus making it potentially invalid for blind solving, which is where the record was set).

The decision was made to keep the result. The following criteria were used in making the decision:

  1. The sound difference was negligible and would require an entirely silent environment for it to be potentially noticeable (which is unlikely the case in 3x3 blindfolded).
  2. The sound difference was only noticed after the competition, and video evidence showed that no advantage was gained.
  3. The delegates had ruled during the competition that the texture difference was reasonable.

As per Regulation 3j1, puzzles are allowed to have reasonable wear. Competitors are encouraged to bring any concerns to their local delegates regarding the legality of their puzzles. The visual guide in Guideline 3j++ is also a good reference for competitors.

title.zh: 裁判开始计时后，选手自行揭罩
title.en: Competitor uncovered puzzle after judge had started the timer

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，A2e2 已明确禁止选手自行揭罩，并规定 DNF 处罚。

选手将一次比赛还原视频发布到网上，视频显示由选手而非裁判揭罩。选手向裁判示意“准备好了”，裁判启动秒表却未揭罩，于是选手自行揭开。

此行为看似违反 A3b2，但该条没有相应处罚。事件赛后才发现，已无法给予额外尝试。

WRC 决定不处罚，保留原成绩，因为事件由裁判错误造成，选手未获优势，且秒表在揭罩前已经启动。

所有选手应注意，遇到类似情况时应立即叫来代表，在现场纠正。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Please note that as of 2025, A2e2 explicitly prohibits the competitor from lifting the cover with associated DNF penalty.

A competitor posted one of their solves from a competition online, and it was seen that the competitor had lifted their own cube cover (as opposed to the judge doing so). The video indicated the competitor signaling they were "ready" to the judge and the judge starting the stopwatch without lifting the cube cover. The competitor then proceeded to lift the cover for themselves.

Though the actions seem in violation with regulation A3b2, this regulation does not have an associated penalty. Additionally, the incident was only discovered after the competition, making the opportunity for an extra attempt unavailable.

The WRC decided to keep the attempt as is with no penalty, because it was deemed that it was the judge's mistake that caused the incident, the competitor gained no advantage, and that the stopwatch was started before the cover was lifted.

All competitors should take note that if a similar incident were to occur to them, they should immediately call a Delegate to rectify the incident on the spot.

title.zh: 裁判提前揭罩，选手申请额外尝试
title.en: The judge lifted the cover early and the competitor requested an extra attempt

html.zh:
一名选手叫来代表申请额外尝试，称自己尚未表示准备好，裁判就揭开了罩。代表给予额外尝试，理由是事件发生时没有代表可立即处理：一位正在比赛，一位监督打乱台，一位在房间外。最初以为选手直到还原结束才提出请求。

代表向 WRC 说明后，WRC 起初决定推翻代表决定，采用原尝试，依据是：

  • 11e：选手应在事件发生时向裁判和代表口头或书面申诉；
  • 11e+++：按代表描述，WRC 认为情况不够特殊；
  • 类似事件。

WRC 不认为代表暂时无法到场构成应获额外尝试的极端情况。代表几乎不可能在观察期间赶到选手面前。事件发生在观察刚开始时，选手应立即停止观察，等代表有空再提出申请。

继续完成还原，会让选手有机会根据原打乱上的结果决定是否要求额外尝试。这正是此情况下给予额外尝试带来的不公平优势，也是 11e+++ 的理由。

该决定被申诉至 WCA 理事会。处理申诉期间出现新证据，证明裁判提前揭罩时，选手确实已向裁判申诉。理事会决定推翻 WRC 决定，恢复额外尝试。理事会声明见此处。
html.en:
A competitor called the WCA Delegate asking for an extra attempt, claiming that the judge lifted the cover without him indicating that he was ready. The WCA Delegate granted an extra attempt with the reasoning that no delegates were available at the moment the incident happened (one was competing, one was supervising the scrambling table, and one was outside the room). It was initially thought that the competitor only asked for an extra attempt after the solve was completed.

The WCA Delegates described their reasoning to the WRC. Initially, the WRC decided to revert the decision of the WCA Delegates and use the original attempt. The WRC based their decision on the following:

  • Regulation 11e: "... The competitor should appeal verbally or in writing to the judge and WCA Delegate at the time of the incident...".
  • Guideline 11e+++: The WRC did not deem the circumstances exceptional enough based on the description of the WCA Delegates.
  • Similar incident.

The WRC does not consider the Delegates being temporarily unavailable as an extreme circumstance that would result in an extra attempt. It would be near impossible for a Delegate to reach a competitor within their inspection period. As the incident happened at the very beginning of the inspection, the competitor should have stopped their inspection right away and waited for one of the Delegates to be available to request an extra attempt.

By following through with the solve, the competitor had the opportunity to decide whether or not they wanted an extra attempt based on their result on the original scramble. This is an unfair advantage that providing an extra attempt in this scenario provides, and this is exactly the reason for 11e+++.

This decision was appealed to the WCA Board. While processing the appeal, new evidence became available - it was found that the competitor did appeal to the judge when the cover was lifted early. The WCA Board decided to overturn the WRC decision, reinstating the extra attempt. The statement from the WCA Board can be found here.

title.zh: 计时器运行时总时间突然减少 10 秒
title.en: Timer deducted 10 seconds off of total time while running

html.zh:
还原中计时器故障，十秒位突然从 1 变为 0，使运行中的总时间减少 10 秒。最终记录与故障计时器显示一致，没有给予额外尝试。

通过逐帧计时分析视频、内部讨论并咨询 WRT 后，WRC 决定在原成绩上加回 10 秒，而非判 DNF。
html.en:
During a solve, a competitor's timer malfunctioned and the tens-place digit of the timer suddenly changed from 1 to 0, thus causing 10 seconds to be deducted from the total time while the timer was running. The final recorded result of the attempt was consistent with the time shown on the malfunctioned timer. No extra attempt was given.

After analyzing the footage utilizing framecounting, and an internal discussion, as well as consulting the WRT, the WRC has decided to add 10 seconds to the original result instead of issuing a DNF.

title.zh: WDC 关于一宗作弊案件的报告
title.en: WDC Report on a Case of Cheating

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

纪律委员会已完成一宗知名选手在 2022、2023 年多场比赛、多个项目中作弊的调查。其被禁止参赛 2 年 6 个月，至 2026 年 6 月 24 日结束。

WDC 允许选手提交录像供审核，凡无法确定有效的成绩均被取消。按规则 9t，若变更导致选手本不应晋级，则删除其相应后续轮次全部成绩。

因该选手在社群知名、仍为纪录保持者，WDC 决定公开报告，以解释决定理由并介绍委员会工作。

鉴于被指控者年龄，报告和视频证据完全匿名化。出于这一原因，WDC 强烈劝阻社群公开其姓名。完整报告见此处。

谨致问候， Shain Longbehn，WDC 负责人 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The Disciplinary Committee has concluded an investigation on a case of cheating by a well-known competitor in multiple events spanning several competitions in 2022 and 2023. As a result, they have been banned for 2-years and 6-months from competing, ending on June 24th, 2026.

The WDC allowed the competitor to submit footage for review. Any result that the WDC could not determine as valid has been disqualified. As specified in Regulation 9t, if there was any change where the competitor would not have advanced to the next round, all results of the competitor for those subsequent rounds were removed.

Since this competitor is well-known in the community and is still a record holder, the WDC decided to make the report for this investigation public. The intention is to explain the reasons behind our decision and provide insight on how the Committee works.

The WDC has elected to fully anonymize this report and the video evidence due to the age of the accused competitor. The WDC strongly discourages the community from publicizing the name of the accused competitor for this reason. The full report can be found here.

Best regards,
Shain Longbehn (WDC Leader)
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 眼罩未完全戴好，虽看不到魔方但能看到裁判
title.en: A competitor did not fully don the blindfond but was not able to see the puzzle

html.zh:
一次三阶盲拧中，选手的眼罩戴法使其能看到裁判，但看不到魔方。裁判表示，盲拧阶段某时刻，选手看着裁判数秒后继续还原。

B4b 规定：

眼罩完全戴好前，不得转动魔方或故意改变其对齐状态，否则该次尝试 DNF。

由于选手能看见裁判和周围环境，WRC 认定眼罩未完全戴好，因此该次尝试应改为 DNF。
html.en:
During 3x3x3 blindfolded attempt, a competitor donned the blindfold in such a way that they were able to see the judge but not the puzzle. The judge said that at some point of the blindfolded phase the competitor looked at them for a few seconds and then continued the execution.

Regulation B4b says:

B4b) The competitor must not apply moves or intentional changes in alignment to the puzzle before they have fully donned the blindfold. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Since the competitor was able to see the judge and other surrounding, the WRC decided that the blindfold was not fully donned, and therefore the attempt should be changed to DNF.

title.zh: WDC 负责人任命公告（2024 年 2 月）
title.en: WDC Leader Announcement (February 2024)

html.zh:
很高兴宣布，Shain Longbehn 将成为 **WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）**新任负责人。他此前已是 WDC 成员。

根据委员会与团队动议第 4 节，由理事会选出，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Sebastiano Tronto 过去 3 年领导 WDC 的重要工作，祝 Shain 履行新职责顺利。

Shain 是唯一申请人，获选申请文件见此处。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Shain Longbehn will become the new Leader of the WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC). Shain was already working as a member of the WDC.

Shain was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

We would like to thank Sebastiano Tronto for the significant work he has done in leading the WDC for the past 3 years. We wish Shain all the best as he takes on his new responsibilities.

Shain was the only applicant for the role and his successful candidacy document can be seen here.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年第四季度
title.en: WDC Digest 2023-Q4

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

过去 3 个月，纪律委员会处理了许多作弊和不当行为案件，也接纳了新成员，使工作更易分担。较大团队的多样性也有助于从不同角度分析事件。

2023 年新开 77 项调查，其中少数仍在进行。本年度最后一期简报讨论两个近期案件。

第一案始于 2020 年，一名选手因偷窃他人魔方被禁赛。禁赛未设固定结束日，解除条件为归还魔方并回答 WDC 问题。

2022 年，其试图通过新 WCA 账号报名逃避禁赛。代表直到提交成绩、网站提示两个账号可能身份冲突时才发现。该选手未回复相关问题。

2023 年秋，选手告知已就被盗魔方与受害者达成协议，WDC 核实了这一点。但逃避禁赛仍应受罚，因此将结束日定为选手主动联系我们之日起 6 个月后。

第二案涉及一名纪录保持者，被发现多个项目观察期间转动作弊。我们证实行为至少持续一年。

选手总体不配合，直至提供完整视频才不再否认。因无法信任其对违规开始时间的说法，我们取消全部成绩，但提供机会：若提交充分视频，可恢复部分成绩。计划近期公布报告。

遗憾的是，公众讨论可能妨碍调查。例如，若提醒选手其 YouTube 视频含作弊证据，选手可能在纪律委员会观看或下载前删除。请社群成员不要干预已知纪律调查，将事件报告 WDC 即可，不要转为公众讨论。

最后，我想以负责人身份作告别寄语。我的第二任期将在二月结束，此后不再续任，新负责人遴选已开始。

我的负责人任期开始于疫情期间，这是工作极不寻常的阶段。即使不考虑疫情，WCA 也一直变化，仅社群规模就显著增加。这意味着整个 WCA，尤其 WDC，过去和未来都必须持续适应。我相信我们能够做到。

多年不变的是社群成员愿意贡献精力和技能。我在任期内两次招募中有幸见证。这不是理所当然的，我很高兴属于 WCA 这样成功的志愿者组织。感谢大家！

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last 3 months the Disciplinary Committee has worked on many cases of cheating and inappropriate behavior. We have also onboarded some new members, enabling us to spread this work with more ease among the team. At the same time, the diversity provided by a large team helps analyze all the incidents from different points of view.

During 2023 we have opened 77 new investigations, a handful of which are still ongoing. In this last digest of the year we would like to discuss two of the cases that we have recently worked on.

The first of these two cases is related to events that happened back in 2020, when a competitor was banned for stealing a cube from a fellow cuber. The ban did not have a set end date, but was conditional on returning the stolen cube and responding to the questions posed by the WDC.

In 2022, the thief tried to evade the ban by signing up with a new WCA account. The delegates of the competition realized this only at the time of submitting the results, as the WCA website informed them of a possible clash of identities between the two accounts. The competitor did not reply to our questions about this incident.

Finally, in the fall of 2023 the competitor communicated to us that they had come to an agreement with the victim of the theft about the stolen cube. The WDC was able to confirm this, but we decided that the attempt of evading the ban deserved some punishment. Therefore, we set the end date of the ban to 6 months after the time the competitor came forward to us.

The second case is about a record-holding competitor being caught cheating by making moves in inspection in multiple events. We have been able to prove that this behavior has been going on for at least one year.

The competitor has been generally uncooperative, denying any wrongdoing until we provided them with complete video evidence. As such, we decided it was not possible to trust the competitor when they claimed the illicit behavior started, and we opted for disqualifying all of their results. However, we offered them the option of reinstating some of the results if sufficient video evidence is provided. We plan to share a public report of the incident in the near future.

In relation to the last incident discussed above, we unfortunately have to remark that there has been some public discussion on this case that may have had a negative effect on our investigation. For example, if a competitor is alerted that some of their YouTube videos contain proof of their cheating, they may be able to remove them from their channel before the Disciplinary Committee can watch them or download them. We would like to ask all community members not to interfere with any disciplinary investigation that they are aware of, and to limit themselves to reporting any incident to the WDC rather than bringing it to public attention.

To conclude this digest, I would like to give a final message as the leader of the Disciplinary Committee. In fact, my second mandate will be ending in February and I am not going to continue in this role after that time - the selection process for a new leader has already started.

My time as a WDC leader started during the COVID times, which was definitely an unusual period for our activities. But even ignoring this, the WCA has gone through constant change during this time - the size of the cubing community alone has increased considerably. This means that we - the WCA in general, and the WDC in particular - had and will have to keep adapting to these changes. I am confident we will be successful in this.

One thing that has not changed throughout the years is the desire of community members to step up and help the WCA with their energy and skills - something I had the pleasure to witness in the two calls for applicants that opened during my leadership. This is not something to be taken for granted, and I am delighted to be part of a volunteer-based organization as successful as the WCA. Thank you all for your help!

Best regards,
Sebastiano Tronto
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 招募 WDC 负责人（2023 年 12 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WDC Leader (December 2023)

html.zh:
Sebastiano Tronto 的 WCA 纪律委员会负责人任期即将结束，将任命新的负责人。WCA 感谢 Sebastiano 过去 3 年对 WDC 的领导。

候选人应履行 24 个月任期，平均每周投入至少 7 小时。期望素质包括：强领导力；独立调查经验；出色的分析与解决问题能力；保密和遵守伦理的承诺；良好判断与决策；熟悉 WCA 活动；出色沟通能力。

申请期为即日起至 2024 年 1 月 7 日 23:59 UTC。请私下发送至执行助理团队 assistants@worldcubeassociation.org，抄送理事会 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

申请必须为 PDF，包括简短自我介绍、为 WCA 所做活动、担任 WDC 负责人的目标。另请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的副本。

WDC 权利与职责见动议 10.2022.3。申请期结束后，理事会投票遴选，并经高级代表及在任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后宣布新负责人，流程见动议 10.2022.0第 4 节。

感谢申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Disciplinary Committee Leader, as Sebastiano Tronto’s term is ending as the Leader of the WCA Disciplinary Committee Team. The WCA would like to take this opportunity to thank Sebastiano for leading the WDC for the last 3 years.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Experience in conducting independent investigations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and ethical conduct
  • Good judgment and decision-making skills
  • Familiarity with WCA activities
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until January 7th, 2024, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WDC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WDC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2022.3.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2022.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年第三季度
title.en: WDC Digest 2023-Q3

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

过去三个月，纪律委员会努力确保选手遵守 WCA 规则，使比赛对所有人都安全、愉快。我们也启动新一轮招募，目前正在遴选。

WDC 编写了帮助代表处理常见比赛纪律问题的指导。《纪律事件指导》现为正式 WCA 文件，代表可通过官网面板查看，仅工作人员可访问。我们计划持续更新并补充案例，欢迎建议。

过去 3 个月结案 27 件，其中 6 件导致禁赛，9 件导致正式警告，包括多起试图偷窃魔方、欺凌等人际问题，以及盲拧偷看、提前停表、篡改成绩单等作弊尝试。

我们注意到提前停表案件增加，有时是意外，有时意在取得更好成绩。担任裁判时须始终关注选手，发现可疑情况就叫代表。第五代计时器停表时会闪两次；若还原尚未结束就闪灯，或结束时没有闪灯，很可能已提前停表。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害，发现可疑行为或感到不适，请立即联系最近的代表，或向 WDC 报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last three months the Disciplinary Committee has worked hard to make sure that every competitor complies with the WCA regulations and that competitions remain a safe and pleasant environment for everyone. We have also opened a new round of applications to select a few new members, and we are currently in the selection process.

The WDC has also worked on writing some guidelines to help WCA Delegates handle common disciplinary issues that arise during competitions. These Guidelines for Disciplinary Incidents are now an official WCA document, available to all delegates via the panel on the WCA website (link accessible to WCA Staff members only). We plan to keep this document updated and add some examples in the future, so if you have any advice for us related to this do let us know.

In the last 3 months the WDC has closed 27 investigations, including 6 that resulted in a ban and 9 that resulted in an official warning. These cases included:

  • Multiple attempted cube thefts.
  • Various interpersonal issues, e.g. bullying.
  • Multiple attempts of cheating, for example by peeking in blindfolded events, stopping the timer early or manipulating the results on the scorecard.

To expand on this last point, we have noticed more cases of competitors stopping the timer early, sometimes by accident and sometimes in an attempt to get better results. We would like to remind everyone that, when acting as a judge, you should always pay attention to the competitor and call a delegate if you notice anything suspicious. Moreover, keep in mind that gen5 timers flash twice when the competitor stops: if you notice this happening early during the solve, or if you do not notice this at the end of the attempt, this likely means that the timer was stopped early.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior or feel uncomfortable at a competition, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and/or contact the WDC to report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask on the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Best Regards,
Sebastiano Tronto
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

title.zh: 最少步裁判提供错误规则信息（代表无法提供协助）
title.en: Fewest Moves judge provided wrong information about the WCA Regulations (Delegate unavailable)

html.zh:
一次最少步尝试中，唯一列名的代表依据 1c，将部分职责交给裁判，并让选手向裁判提问。因此，两名选手询问整体转动记号，均得到了错误信息。其中一人最初因错误整体转动被判 DNF，另一人无论如何解释整体转动都是 DNF。

**最终决定将选手所写的整体转动按其原意视为正确。**例如，若他们写了 z，则按 z' 处理，因为若得到正确信息，他们本来就会这样写。WRC 公开给出的理由如下，另有部分理由私下说明：

  1. 虽然 2t 要求选手熟悉规则，但在这一特殊情况下，代表（本案为代表授权的裁判）提供了错误信息，WRC 认为这一因素优先于该要求。
  2. 最少步中，代表和裁判可以解释规则（见 E5）。如果认为问题合理且自己知道答案，从而决定作出解释，解释就必须正确。
html.en:
During a FMC attempt, the only listed WCA Delegate assigned some of his responsibilities to the judge (the Delegate asked competitors to make questions to the judge), as per Regulation 1c. For this reason, two competitors asked the judge about rotations during the attempt, and both received wrong information. One of the competitors initially got a DNF because of the wrong rotation, and the other one got a DNF regardless of the rotation.

The final decision was to consider the rotations wrote by the competitors as if they were correct. Therefore, if the involved competitors wrote z, then the rotation was considered as z', because that is what the competitors would have written if they had received the correct information. The decision from the WCA Regulations Committee had the following reasons (among others explained privately):

  1. Although competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations as per Regulation 2t, the WRC considers that a WCA Delegate (in this case the judge representing the authority of the Delegate) telling wrong information overrides this regulation, in this particular situation.
  2. In FMC attempts, delegates and judges may give clarifications about the Regulations (see Regulation E5). If they decide to give clarifications (because they consider that the question is reasonable and they know the answer to the question), the clarification must be correct.

title.zh: 盲拧中裁判未能停表，选手自行停止官方秒表
title.en: A competitor stopped the official stopwatch in a BLD attempt (judge unavailable to stop it)

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，A6a1 已更新，允许裁判未停表时由选手自行停止秒表。

选手完成尝试后示意裁判停止官方秒表，但裁判离比赛台太远，无法操作，选手便自行停表，违反了指导 2i+。

尽管按 2i+ 应判 DNF，WRC 同意保留成绩，依据如下：

  • 代表或裁判亲眼见到此情况，这是最终决定的关键因素。
  • 裁判没有遵守 B5b；
  • 选手无意作弊，也无意取得不公平优势；
  • 对高阶盲拧和多盲，额外尝试过于严苛，且会造成不必要的精神消耗。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, regulation A6a1 has been updated, to allow competitors to stop the stopwatch themselves if their judge does not do so.

A competitor finished their attempt and made the signal for the judge to stop the official stopwatch. However, as the judge was unavailable (i.e. too far from the station), the competitor decided to stop the stopwatch themselves (in violation of Guideline 2i+).

Despite the fact that Guideline 2i+ would make this a DNF, the WCA Regulations Committee agreed to keep the result, based on the following points:

  • Either the Delegate or the judge saw this situation (key point of consideration for the final decision).
  • Regulation B5b was not followed by the judge.
  • The competitor had no intention to cheat nor gain an unfair advantage.
  • An extra is unnecessarily harsh and mentally draining for Big BLD and MBLD attempts.

title.zh: 三阶盲拧轮次发现多个错误打乱
title.en: A 3x3x3 Blindfolded round was found to have several misscrambles

html.zh:
有人报告，三阶盲拧第一轮发出了多个错误打乱。鉴于受影响次数很多，WRC 认为最一致、公平的处理是删除该轮全部成绩。该轮成绩失效后，无法再确定决赛晋级条件，因此后续轮次成绩也无效并被删除。

更多先例见 #53 和 #88。
html.en:
It was reported that several misscrambles were issued during the first round of the 3x3x3 Blindfolded event. Given the substantial amount of affected attempts, the WRC deemed that the most consistent and fair decision was to remove all the results from the round. As the results were invalidated, it was no longer possible to determine the advancement conditions for the final round. Therefore, the results for any subsequent round were also invalid (and removed).

For more precedents, see the following incident logs: #53 and #88.

title.zh: 招募 WDC 成员（2023 年 8 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WDC Members (August 2023)

html.zh:
WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）正在招募新成员！任何人均可申请，也鼓励目前不是 WCA 工作人员的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

主要调查比赛中的纪律事件，如作弊尝试或不当行为，必要时发出警告或禁赛。我们也向代表提供比赛现场处理意见，并积极改进相关 WCA 动议和政策。

权利与职责详见动议 10.2022.3—纪律委员会、动议 15.2022.1—暂停资格及其他处分和行为准则。纪律日志包含以往公告、重要事件报告和定期简报，欢迎在论坛纪律板块提问。

要求

硬性要求仅为书面英语沟通能力、熟悉 WCA 比赛环境，参加过几场比赛即可。我们还重视与队友讨论推理和想法的能力、逻辑和分析能力、保密意识、沟通能力。以下有帮助但非必需：精通一个以上速拧项目；流利掌握英语以外语言；处理人际冲突或其他不愉快情境的经验。

成员多样性十分有益，尤其鼓励文化背景、国籍、年龄和性别与现有成员不同的人申请。

申请

请在 2023 年 9 月 10 日星期日 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 发送至 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org，包含简短自我介绍、为 WCA 及魔方社群所做活动、相关个人技能、申请动机。

全部材料须在同一个 PDF 中，预计 24 小时内确认收件。申请期后开始遴选，可能包括面试或其他评估。有问题可联系 WDC 负责人。
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is looking for new members! Everyone can apply, and we encourage community members who are not part of the WCA Staff to send their application.

What does the WDC do?

Most of our work consists of investigating disciplinary incidents at competitions, such as cheating attempts or inappropriate behavior. If the circumstances require it, we may issue warnings or bans. We also give feedback to WCA Delegates on how to handle certain situations during WCA competitions, and we actively work to improve the WCA Motions and policies related to these topics.

If you are interested in the details of our rights and duties, check out the Motions 10.2022.3 - Disciplinary Committee and 15.2022.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions, as well as the Code of Conduct. The Disciplinary Log contains public announcements made by the WDC in the past, including public reports for some important incidents and periodic WDC digests. Feel free to ask questions about any of this in the Disciplinary section of the WCA Forum.

Requirements

The only strict requirements for WDC members are:

  • Ability to communicate in English (written)
  • Familiarity with the WCA competition environment (having attend a few competitions is enough)

Other qualities we look for are:

  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas with team members
  • Logical and analytical reasoning
  • Confidentiality
  • Communication skills

The following qualities are useful, but not necessary:

  • Expertise in one or more speedcubing events
  • Fluency in a language other than English
  • Experience in dealing with interpersonal conflict or other unpleasant situations

The committee would greatly benefit from the diversity of their members. We therefore especially encourage applications from community members with a different cultural background, nationality, age and gender from the current members.

Applications

Applicants can send their application as a PDF document to stronto@worldcubeassociation.org before Sunday, September 10, 2023, 23:59 UTC. The application document should contain:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA and for the cubing community
  • Overview of the personal skills relevant to the role
  • Motivation for applying to the WDC

Everything should be contained in a single PDF file. Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application within 24 hours. The selection process will start after the application period is over, and it might include an interview or other kinds of assessment.

If you have any questions feel free to contact the WDC Leader at stronto@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年第二季度
title.en: WDC Digest 2023-Q2

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

全球比赛数量快速增加，不幸也伴随纪律案件大幅增长。过去 3 个月，WDC 新开 20 项调查，结案 17 件。部分重要案件如下：

  1. 上次简报后，我们公布了 3 项调查声明，涉及选手在线行为、反复错误打乱，以及一名代表实施性骚扰的调查，见官网纪律板块。
  2. 年初接报双方因魔方被盗发生冲突。被指控方在 WDC 联系后很快承认偷窃，似乎有悔意，被禁赛 5 个月。提醒此类情况应立即联系代表，避免直接与他人对峙。
  3. 选手被发现观察时在桌下转动，涉及两场比赛至少 8 次。其被禁赛，相关成绩被取消。之后道歉并请求重新考虑期限，WDC 考虑其年龄较小，接受了重新考虑的请求。
  4. 代表报告，两名选手互为裁判时串通记录虚假时间。显示屏与成绩单不符引起注意。两人起初称计时器故障，视频排除该说法，随后承认互相记录更快时间。因年龄较小，两人各禁赛 3 个月，互为裁判的成绩被取消。
  5. 代表发现成绩单时间被划去，换成更快成绩。裁判称原本写的是较慢时间，下一次的打乱员也称见到较慢时间。选手否认修改，但笔迹分析结合证词，认定其改了成绩，给予 9 个月禁赛。
  6. 一名组织者修改尚未公布的比赛页面，试图发布针对另一选手的冒犯性言论。修改未正式保存，但截图被传播。该选手获正式警告。调查期间，比赛代表独立决定撤去其组织者职务。

另谈社群调查结果。2022 年底，我们通过匿名问卷收到反馈，归纳如下：

  1. 社群和工作人员总体满意 WDC 工作，平均评价适度正面。我们很高兴，并将继续改进。
  2. 简报受欢迎，尤其在工作人员中。它有助于社群了解工作，将继续定期发布。
  3. 许多代表希望有文档或常见问题，帮助其不必求助 WDC 就能处理常见纪律事件。我们正在准备。
  4. 约五分之一选手称曾至少一次在比赛中被他人弄得不舒服；工作人员中接近二分之一。即使我们以友善、包容自豪，也并非人人在比赛中始终自在。请尊重身边的人，并留意他们与你相处时的感受。

最后提醒大家充分理解 WCA 规则及比赛流程。如有疑问或不清楚如何操作，请询问代表。若认为成绩受到任何损害，看到可疑行为或感到不适，请立即找最近的代表，或联系 WDC 报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

谨致问候， WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

As the number of competitions around the world continues to increase rapidly, this unfortunately has meant that there has also been a dramatic rise in the number of disciplinary cases. In the last 3 months, the WDC has opened 20 new investigations, and has closed 17. Below you can find a summary of some notable cases from this period.

  1. Since our last digest, we have published 3 public statements detailing the outcome of some investigations. These include an investigation into a competitor’s online behavior, a case of repeated misscrambling, and an investigation regarding sexual harassment from a delegate. You can view these statements on the Disciplinary section of the WCA site.
  2. Earlier in the year, the WDC was contacted regarding an altercation between two parties due to a stolen cube. After being contacted by the WDC, the party accused quickly admitted to stealing the cube, and seemed remorseful for doing so. The competitor in question was given a 5 month ban. We would also like to remind everyone that in cases like this, it is best to immediately contact the competition’s delegate, and refrain from confronting others directly.
  3. A competitor was caught making moves beneath the table during the inspection phase of their solve. This was discovered to have occurred at least 8 times across two competitions. The competitor was given a ban from WCA competitions, and the affected solves were disqualified. The competitor later requested for their ban duration to be reconsidered after providing an apology. The WDC honored this request, taking into account the competitor’s young age as part of the decision.
  4. The WDC was informed by a delegate of a case of two competitors colluding to write down false times on their scorecard when judging each other. This was caught after discrepancies were noticed between the times shown on the display and those written down. The competitors initially claimed that this was due to a timer malfunction, however after reviewing available video evidence, this was determined not to be the case. Shortly after, the competitors admitted to cheating by writing down faster times when judging each other. Due to their young age, both competitors were given 3 month bans. The solves which they had judged each other for were disqualified.
  5. A delegate contacted the WDC after noticing that a result on a scorecard was scratched out and replaced by a faster time. The judge stated that they had written the original, slower time on the scorecard, and the scrambler for the subsequent attempt also claims they saw the slower attempt written down as well. The competitor denied modifying their scorecard, however, after analyzing the handwriting of the competitor, in addition with the earlier testimonies, it was determined that the competitor had altered time on their scorecard. The competitor was issued a 9 month ban.
  6. An organizer was caught making edits to an unannounced competition page in order to post offensive remarks about another competitor. While the changes were never officially saved, screenshots of the edits were distributed. The competitor was given an official warning form the WDC. The competition’s delegates independently decided to remove the organizer from their role during the course of this investigation.

Another topic we would like to discuss is the result of the community survey. At the end of 2022, we received feedback from the WCA Community in the form of an anonymous survey. Here are some facts that we have extrapolated from the results:

  1. The community and the staff are generally satisfied with the work of the WDC and have, on average, a moderately positive opinion of us. We are happy about this, and will do our best to improve even further.
  2. The WDC digest is quite popular, especially among staff members. We find it is a nice way to keep the community informed about our work, so we will keep publishing it regularly.
  3. Many delegates have asked for us to prepare some documents or an F.A.Q. to help them handle common disciplinary incidents without our assistance. We are working on it!
  4. About 1 out of 5 competitors reported that someone else has made them feel uncomfortable at least once during a competition. This number goes up to almost 1 in 2 among our fellow staff members. This shows that, even though we take pride in being a welcoming and friendly community, not everyone always feels comfortable at WCA competitions. We would like to take this chance to remind you to always be respectful of people around you and mindful of how they feel around you.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior or feel uncomfortable at a competition, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and/or contact the WDC to report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask on the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Best Regards,
The WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 某次尝试被发现打乱错了一步
title.en: An attempt was found to be misscrambled by one move

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，11i 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但规则现已明确处理方式。

比赛期间，某轮结束后因选手打破纪录而核查打乱：

  • Hanoi Super Brain Zyo 2023 的一次三阶尝试，打乱第一步错误，仅影响解法最后一步；
  • Michigan Speedcubing Spring 2023 的一次金字塔尝试，一个小角打乱错误，仅影响解法一步。

虽然两案的解法几乎未受影响，难度相近，但 WRC 成员投票决定遵循错误打乱的标准流程，保留额外尝试成绩。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations.

During the competition, after the round was completed, scrambles were verified as a competitor broke a record.

  • At Hanoi Super Brain Zyo 2023, one of the attempts in 3x3x3 Cube was found to be misscrambled by the first move of the scramble, affecting only the last move of the solution.
  • At Michigan Speedcubing Spring 2023, one of the attempts in Pyraminx was found to be misscrambled by a tip affecting only one move of the solution.

Although the solution was barely affected, and it was similar in difficulty in both cases, the voting among WRC members resulted in a decision to keep the extra solve following the standard misscrambles procedure.

title.zh: 赛后发现错误打乱（无额外尝试）
title.en: Attempt was found to be misscrambled after a competition (extra not available)

html.zh:
说明：本事件最初公布后，WCA 关于错误打乱的规则和指导已更新。自 2025 年 1 月 1 日起，不应再采用下述方式。

赛后发现，多名选手的部分尝试使用了错误打乱。WRC 按以下标准逐次调查是否保留：

  • 错误打乱带来显著优势：改为 DNF；
  • 与原打乱难度相近：保留原成绩；
  • 无法分析错误打乱，例如无视频：保留原成绩。

请注意，若在比赛期间发现错误打乱，必须以额外尝试替代（见日志）。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: The WCA Regulations and Guidelines relating to misscrambles have been updated since this incident was originally published. The approach described below should no longer be followed from January 1st, 2025.

After a competition, attempts from several competitors were found to be misscrambled. The WRC investigated each of those attempts to determine if they should stay based on the following criteria:

  • If the misscramble gives the competitor a significant advantage, the attempt should be changed to DNF.
  • If the misscramble is similar in difficulty to the original scramble, the attempt should be left as is.
  • If the misscramble cannot be analyzed (e.g. the video of the attempt is not available), the attempt should be left as is.

Please note that in case the misscramble is found during a competition, it must always be replaced with an extra attempt (see the Incident Log entry here).

title.zh: 多个轮次发现大量错误打乱
title.en: Several rounds were found to have several misscrambles

html.zh:
赛后发现，多个项目的部分轮次发出了大量错误打乱，尤其是三阶决赛、金字塔决赛和三阶单手决赛。

虽然这些轮次中许多尝试使用了正确打乱，本身有效，但由于错误数量很大，WRC 内部投票决定删除所有受影响轮次。因此删除了三阶单手项目，金字塔从两轮改为一轮，三阶从三轮改为两轮。类似事件见此处。
html.en:
After a competition, a large number of misscrambles was found to be sent out during certain rounds of several events. In particular, a lot of misscrambles happened during 3x3x3 Cube Final, Pyraminx Final, and 3x3x3 One-Handed Final.

Altghough many attempts during the mentioned rounds were done using correct scrambles, and therefore were valid, the outcome of the internal WRC voting was to remove all affected rounds as the number of misscrambles was large. The decision resulted in the removal of 3x3x3 One-Handed event, change in Pyraminx event format from two rounds to one round, and in the change in 3x3x3 Cube event format from three rounds to two rounds. See similar Incident Log entry here.

title.zh: 已结束组别的打乱组被重复使用
title.en: Scramble set from the finished group was re-used

html.zh:
赛后，一名选手报告自己的平均中既有前一组打乱，也有本组打乱。该选手还是前一组的打乱员。代表也确认，自己可能同时打开了相邻两组打乱。

由于打乱保密性遭到破坏，WRC 同意删除受影响轮次的成绩，同时也删除了决赛轮次。
html.en:
After the competition, a competitor reported that they had both the scrambles from the previous group and from their (current) group in their average. The competitor was also a scrambler for the previous group. The WCA Delegate also confirmed they could have left two consecutive scramble sets open at the same time.

Since the scramble secrecy was violated, the WRC agreed that the results from the affected round should be removed (also resulting in the removal of the final round).

title.zh: 比赛使用的魔方罩半透明
title.en: Cube covers used for the competition were translucent

html.zh:
WRC 收到的照片显示，薄白色塑料罩在某些角度可能泄露打乱状态信息。不过，代表向 WRC 展示，他们将两个罩叠放以确保不透光，且部分单层罩本身也足够不透明，能保障打乱保密。

WRC 审查公开视频后，同意保留成绩。虽然这不是最稳妥的遮盖方法，但主办方和代表通过叠放确实保障了打乱保密。

给社群和主办方的建议：打乱保密极其重要，也需谨慎处理。比赛中如有任何相关疑虑，最安全的做法是向比赛代表提出。破坏打乱保密可能导致相关轮次或尝试成绩被删除。
html.en:
WRC received some pictures that showed a cover made of thin white plastic that at some angles could provide some information about the scrambled states of puzzles. However, the WCA Delegates showed the WRC that they had stacked two covers one above the other in order to make them non-translucent and that some single covers were opaque enough to ensure scramble secrecy.

WRC reviewed the video evidence from the public resources and agreed that the results should be kept. While this is not the safest way to cover the puzzles, the organizers and the WCA Delegates did ensure scramble secrecy by double stacking the covers.

Advice for the Community and Organizers:

Scramble secrecy is an extremely important and delicate matter. If you ever have any concern regarding scramble secrecy during a competition, the safest thing to do is to address the issue with the WCA Delegates of the competition. Breaches in the scramble secrecy may result in the removal of the affected rounds/attempts.

title.zh: 观察期间发生两起事件
title.en: Two incidents happened during inspection

html.zh:
观察时，选手报告计时器处于四触点模式。后来发现，在报告计时器问题之前，选手已在观察期间触碰摄像头，违反 2i2b：

2i2b：不得与正在工作的摄像头互动，例如操作、手持、佩戴。例外是可佩戴在头部、处于视线之外，且除佩戴外明显没有互动的摄像头。

代表给予暂定的额外尝试，但 WRC 同意保留 DNF，因为选手在报告计时器问题之前已触碰摄像头。一般而言，WRC 根据事件先后顺序确定结果；例如若先报告计时器问题，则会采用额外尝试。
html.en:
During inspection, a competitor reported that their timer was in 4-pad mode. As later discovered, the competitor touched their camera during the inspection violating Regulation 2i2b, before reporting the timer issue:

2i2b) The competitor must not interact with (e.g. operate, hold, wear) any active camera. Exception: the competitor may wear a camera mounted on their head, as long as it is out of their sight and it is clear that they are not interacting with it (apart from wearing it).

The WCA Delegates granted a provisional extra attempt, but the WRC agreed to keep the DNF since the competitor touched the camera before reporting the issue with the timer. In general, WRC considers the order in which incidents happen to determine the attempt's result (for example, if the competitor had reported the timer issue first, the extra attempt would have been used).

title.zh: WDC 关于一宗骚扰案件的报告
title.en: WDC report on a case of harassment

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

纪律委员会近期处理完一宗选手行为不当事件。该人曾为 WCA 代表，因此我们的调查之前，伦理委员会已决定将其从正式职务降职。我们已准备公开调查报告，希望与大家分享。

报告讨论性骚扰，可能不适合所有读者。虽然话题令人不快，但社群应知道 WCA 会坚决回应此类行为。

我们支持所有遭受骚扰或其他不当行为的人。若曾在 WCA 活动中处于不舒服的境地，鼓励向当地社群代表或 WDC 讲述。

上述调查报告见此处。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA community,

The Disciplinary Committee has recently concluded an incident involving the misconduct of a competitor. Since this person used to be a WCA delegate, our investigation has been preceded by the decision of the Ethics Committee to demote them from their official position. We have prepared a public report of our investigation and we would like to share it with you.

The report discusses the topic of sexual harassment, therefore it may not be suitable for all readers. Although it is unpleasant to bring up such a topic, we think it is important for the community to know that the WCA reacts firmly to these kind of actions.

We support everyone who has been the victim of harassment or other improper behavior. If you have ever been in an uncomfortable position during a WCA event, we encourage you to talk about it with your local community representatives or with the WDC.

You can find the report of the aforementioned investigation here.

Best,
On behalf of the disciplinary committee,
Sebastiano Tronto

title.zh: WDC 对一宗错误打乱事件采取的措施
title.en: WDC action on a misscrambling incident

html.zh:
亲爱的速拧社群：

WCA 纪律委员会近期完成了 Singapore Championship 2023 一系列错误打乱的调查。鉴于事件受到高度关注，WDC 希望公开部分细节。

多名高水平选手在错误打乱上取得极好成绩后，比赛代表联系 WDC，促成调查。代表确认这些打乱出自同一人，并报告该人无视停止打乱的要求；还列出了可能受其影响的其他尝试。WDC 使用多名选手提供的视频，核查了其中若干次。

审查后，WDC 认定该人在确保打乱正确方面极度疏忽，也无视比赛期间代表的要求。WDC 未能发现其具有恶意，但无论意图如何，出现如此广泛的错误打乱都极令人担忧。

基于以上原因，WDC 对其作出 6 个月禁止参赛的处分。

提醒大家，确保每人收到正确打乱（4g1例外除外）及遵从代表要求十分重要。虽打乱等许多职责由志愿者承担，但 WCA 认为打乱准确性是保证所有比赛公平、平等条件不可或缺的一环。

谨致问候， Nicholas McKee 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear speedcubing community,

The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) has recently concluded an investigation regarding a series of misscrambles which occurred at Singapore Championship 2023. Due to the high profile nature of this incident, and the public attention that it has received, the WDC would like to publish some details publicly.

The WDC opened an investigation into this matter after being contacted by the Delegates of the competition, following several high-level cubers achieving extremely good times on incorrect scrambles. The Delegates were able to match these scrambles as coming from the same individual, whom they also reported was ignoring requests to not scramble, and were able to create a list of other attempts that may have been potentially affected by this individual. After using video evidence provided by several competitors, the WDC was able to check several of these attempts.

After reviewing these attempts, the WDC has come to the conclusion that the individual responsible for these misscrambles displayed extreme negligence in regard to ensuring that the scrambles were correct, and also ignored the requests of the delegates during the competition. The WDC was not able to identify any malicious intent from this individual, but regardless of intent the WDC finds it extremely concerning that such widespread misscrambling occurred.

Due to the reasons above, the WDC has issued a 6 month ban from competing for this individual.

The WDC would like to remind everyone of the importance of ensuring that everyone receives correct scrambles (with the exceptions of 4g1) as well as following the requests of WCA Delegates at competitions. While we realize many competition duties such as scrambling are carried out by volunteers, the WCA also recognizes that scramble accuracy is an integral part of ensuring fair and equal conditions at all WCA competitions.

Best regards
Nicholas McKee
On Behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 选手在还原中抓住话筒以防掉落
title.en: A competitor grabbed a microphone during an attempt, to prevent it from falling

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，2i 已更新，更清楚地说明电子设备使用的允许与禁止范围。

一名选手携带了比赛播报用的手持话筒。还原时话筒放在桌上并开始滚动，他抓住话筒以免掉下桌。2i 规定：

观察或还原时，不得使用 Stackmat 计时器或秒表以外的电子或音频设备，例如手机、MP3 播放器、录音机、额外照明；处罚为 DNF。

由于选手没有在使用话筒，因此未违反该规则，成绩被判定有效。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 2i has been updated to provide more insight on what is permitted and not permitted regarding electronic usage.

A competitor was carrying a handheld microphone which was used for announcements during the competition. During a solve he had it lying on the table where it started to roll. He grabbed the microphone to make sure it did not fall off the table. Regulation 2i states:

2i) While inspecting or solving, competitors must not use electronics or audio equipment (e.g. cell phones, MP3 players, dictaphones, additional lighting) apart from the Stackmat timer or stopwatch. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Given that the competitor was not using the microphone, he did not break this regulation. The solve was therefore ruled as OK.

title.zh: 裁判未揭罩，选手自行揭开魔方罩
title.en: A competitor uncovered their own puzzle, as the judge failed to do so

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，A2e2 已明确禁止选手自行揭罩，并规定 DNF 处罚。

A3b2：选手确认准备好后开始尝试，由裁判揭开魔方罩并开始计量观察时间。

选手在观察前对裁判说“准备好了”，但裁判未揭罩。视频显示，选手明显困惑、紧张，随后自行揭罩，不久后开始还原。赛后才发现此事，无法提供额外尝试。WRC 同意不处罚并保留原成绩，理由是：流程错误在裁判，视频显示选手被情况打乱了节奏，且观察在 15 秒内，没有取得优势。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Please note that as of 2025, A2e2 explicitly prohibits the competitor from lifting the cover with associated DNF penalty.

A3b2) The competitor starts the attempt by confirming that they are ready, and the judge uncovers the puzzle and starts timing the inspection.

The competitor said "ready" to the judge before inspection, but the judge did not uncover the puzzle. From a video of the incident, it can be seen that the competitor looks visibly confused and stressed after the judge did not uncover the cube. The competitor then lifted the cover themselves and began the solve shortly after. This was only discovered after the competition, meaning no extras were available. The WRC agreed to keep the original result without penalties, for the following reasons: The procedural error was the judge's fault, the video of the competitor showing he was thrown off by the situation, and no advantage gained (as the inspection time was within 15 seconds).

title.zh: 观众在选手观察时与其交谈
title.en: A spectator communicated with a competitor during the competitor's inspection

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，A5a 已更新，为未从交流中获益的选手提供例外。

选手观察魔方时，一名观众询问能否帮忙还原自己的魔方。选手回答“可以，但要等会儿”。选手未在尝试中申请额外尝试。从字面上看，他在尝试中与代表、裁判以外的人交流，违反了 A5a。

截至 2023 年 2 月 15 日，该规则规定：

A5a：观察或还原时，选手不得与裁判或 WCA 代表以外的人交流，否则 DNF。

WRC 同意保留成绩，因为选手只是在友善回应年轻观众，判 DNF 过于严厉，且交流未带来优势。WRC 也提议下一轮规则修订应更宽缓，以体现这一决定。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, regulation A5a has been updated, giving an exception to competitors who do not gain any advantage from their communication.

While the competitor was inspecting the puzzle, a person from the audience asked if they (the competitor) could solve their (the spectator's) puzzle. The competitor responded with "yes, but later". The competitor did not ask for an extra during the attempt. Technically, they communicated with someone other than the delegate and the judge during his attempt, which would be a violation of Regulation A5a.

The regulation, as of February 15th 2023 stated the following:

A5a) While inspecting or solving the puzzle, the competitor must not communicate with anyone other than the judge or the WCA Delegate. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).
