The WRC agreed to keep the result as it would be too harsh to DNF it, given that the competitor was just being kind with the young spectator. Furthermore, no advantage was gained from the communication. The regulation was also proposed to be more lenient for the next regulation cycle, to reflect this decision.

title.zh: 选手在最少步尝试中去洗手间
title.en: A competitor went to the bathroom during a Fewest Moves attempt

html.zh:
一名选手在最少步尝试中途去洗手间，几分钟后返回。

该次成绩无论如何都是 DNF。不过，WRC 同意，只要代表能确保选手不会试图作弊，就可以允许选手在尝试中去洗手间。
html.en:
During a Fewest Moves attempt, a competitor went to the bathroom in the middle of their attempt and returned a few minutes later.

The result was a DNF either way. However, the WRC agreed that it is fine to allow competitors to go to the bathroom during the attempt, as long as the WCA Delegate can ensure that the competitor will not attempt to cheat.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年 3 月
title.en: WDC Digest (March 2023)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

希望大家 2023 年开局顺利。以下是过去三个月的部分重要案件。

  1. 年初调查一名知名选手在三阶多盲中从眼罩下偷看作弊。WDC 认定其作弊，并延伸到此前数场比赛。完整公开报告已发布。
  2. 类似盲拧作弊中，选手利用裁判遮挡板位置不当偷看魔方、修正多处错误，涉及该比赛多次尝试，包括两个国家纪录平均。多次沟通后，选手承认并道歉，被禁赛 9 个月，相关还原改为 DNF。
  3. 发现选手腿上写有四阶 O 特（OLL 奇偶）公式。其很快承认没有记住公式，且不知道这样违反规则。相关成绩改为 DNF，给予正式警告，并提醒熟悉规则。
  4. 一名年轻选手取得数次异常快成绩，被怀疑观察时在桌下转动。监护人最初承认存在这一行为，但 WDC 怀疑实际是在桌下换成预先设定打乱的另一个魔方。联系选手后，其很快确认这一推断并道歉，获正式警告，相关成绩判 DNF。
  5. 近期收到多个国家的骚扰案件，部分涉及 WCA 工作人员。请尊重他人，遵守 WCA 行为准则。

也提醒裁判全神贯注履职，尤其正确举盲拧遮挡板，不要让自己或选手分心。有疑问或发现可疑行为时，应及时询问代表。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We hope that the beginning of 2023 is going well for you. Below you can find a summary of some notable WDC cases from the past three months.

  1. Earlier in the year, the WDC investigated a case of a high profile competitor cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind by peeking under the blindfold. The WDC concluded that the competitor had cheated, and that this cheating extends to several prior competitions as well. A full public report on this case has been made available, which can be found here.
  2. A similar case of blind cheating was caught where a competitor took advantage of their judge’s poorly placed sight blocker, in order to peek at their cube and fix several mistakes. This cheating extended to several attempts at the competition in question, including two national record averages. After several exchanges with the WDC, the competitor admitted to cheating, and apologized for their behavior. The competitor was issued a 9 month ban, and the affected solves have been changed to DNF.
  3. A competitor was caught with the 4x4 OLL parity algorithm written down on their leg. After being confronted, the competitor quickly admitted they had not memorized the algorithm, and that they didn’t know doing so was against regulations. The affected results were changed to DNF and a formal warning was given to the competitor, along with a reminder to be familiar with the WCA regulations.
  4. A young competitor who achieved several unusually fast times was suspected to be making turns to their cube underneath the table cube during inspection. The guardian of the competitor initially admitted that they had done this, however the WDC doubted that claim, instead believing that the competitor had switched the cube they were using under the table for one with a predetermined scramble. After reaching out to the competitor, they were quick to confirm the WDC’s theory and apologized for their mistakes. The competitor was issued a formal warning and the results in question were DNFed.
  5. Recently, the WDC has received a number of harassment cases from several different countries, some of which involving WCA staff. We would like to remind everyone to be respectful of others, and ensure that you are upholding the WCA Code of Conduct.

The WDC would also like to remind all judges to give their full attention to performing their duties as a judge, particularly holding the blindfolded sight blocker correctly, and not distracting themselves or the competitor. We would also like to remind all judges to not hesitate in speaking to their competition’s delegate if they have questions or notice any suspicious behavior.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

title.zh: 严重的打乱保密与还原流程问题
title.en: Major scramble secrecy and solving procedure issues

html.zh:
2013—2022 年间，越南多场比赛违反了多项规则和指导，包括：

  • 使用不合规计时器，违反原 8a7、现 7f1a；
  • 用成绩单替代魔方罩，违反 A2c1 和 A2c1+；
  • Stackmat 计时器未固定在垫子上，违反 7f2；
  • 缺少秒表，未计量观察时间，违反 A3b2；
  • 成绩单选手签名栏空白，按 A7c4 应改为 DNF；
  • 观众紧贴比赛台，违反 7b；
  • 打乱区完全没有隔离。

逐场依据代表报告和公开证据调查后，WRC 同意按以下标准保留或删除成绩；符合删除条件时，优先删除：

  • 垫子未固定或缺失：保留成绩；
  • 使用不合规计时器：删除受影响比赛的全部成绩；
  • 用成绩单遮盖：2013 年之前保留全部成绩；自 2013 年起，删除受影响轮次全部成绩。

此决定获 WCA 理事会批准。

详情见调查报告和公告，另见相关事件。
html.en:
Through the years (2013-2022), several Regulations and Guidelines were violated in many competitions in Vietnam. This included:

  • Using illegal timers (previous Regulation 8a7, now Regulation 7f1a violated)
  • Using score sheets instead of cube covers (Regulation A2c1 and Guideline A2c1+ violated)
  • Using Stackmat timers that are not attached to mats (Regulation 7f2 violated)
  • Inspection not measured due to missing stopwatches (Regulation A3b2 violated)
  • Blank competitor's fields in score sheets (Regulation A7c4 should lead these attempts to be changed to DNF)
  • Spectators staying right up against the solving stations (Regulation 7b violated)
  • Scrambling area not isolated at all

After investigating each competition based on the delegate reports and publicly available evidence, the WRC agreed to keep/remove the results based on the following criteria, where removing results supersedes keeping them:

  • Competitions using unattached/missing mats - keep results.
  • Illegal timers: remove all results from affected competitions.
  • Score sheets instead of covers:
    • Prior to 2013, keep all results.
    • 2013 onwards, remove all results from affected rounds.

The decision was approved by the WCA Board of Directors.

For more details, see this investigation report and this announcement. See this related incident.

title.zh: WDC 关于一宗三阶多盲作弊案件的报告
title.en: WDC report on a case of cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

纪律委员会刚结束一宗三阶多盲作弊调查。认定选手作弊，并确信行为也延伸至此前比赛。因此禁赛 2 年，部分成绩改为 DNF。

该选手在社群较知名，仍保持多项未受本调查影响的国家纪录。因此 WDC 决定公开报告，以解释决定理由并介绍委员会工作。

报告见此处。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA community,

The Disciplinary Committee has just concluded an investigation on a case of cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. The competitor was found guilty and we are convinced that this behavior extends to prior competitions as well. As a result, they have been banned for 2 years and some of their results have been changed to DNF.

Since this competitor is relatively well-known in the community, still holding multiple national records (unaffected by our investigation), the WDC decided to make the report for this investigation public. The intention is to explain the reasons behind our decision and give you some insight on how the Committee works.

The report can be found here.

Best regards,
Sebastiano Tronto,
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 使用了不被允许的计时器
title.en: Non-permitted timers were used

html.zh:
Vancouver Island 2019 的多个正式项目使用了裕鑫计时器。WRC 决定取消使用该计时器的轮次成绩，涉及三阶、四阶、五阶、三阶单手和五魔方。

按 2018-01-01 版 WCA 规则 8a7（现 7f1a），正式比赛只允许使用 Speed Stacks Stackmat 计时器：

8a：正式 WCA 比赛必须…… 8a7：使用正版 Speed Stacks Stackmat 计时器（第二代、第三代 Pro Timer 或第四代 Pro Timer）计量时间。

不允许裕鑫计时器的主要原因是质量问题，尤其是有时计时速度不同，造成不准确测时，且可能难以察觉，特别是在快速项目中。
html.en:
At Vancouver Island 2019, a Yuxin timer was used during official attempts of several events. The WRC decided to disqualify the rounds where it was used, namely, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, and Megaminx.

Per Regulation 8a7 (2018-01-01 WCA Regulations version; now declared by Regulation 7f1a) only Speed Stacks Stackmat timers were allowed to be used at official competitions.

8a) An official WCA competition must: ... 8a7) Use the authentic Speed Stacks Stackmat timer (Generation 2, Generation 3 Pro Timer, or Generation 4 Pro Timer) for time measurement.

The main reason for disallowing Yuxin timers is their quality, in particular they sometimes can run with a different speed and measure times incorrectly, which might be not noticeable, especially during fast events.

title.zh: 三阶盲拧中裁判长时间忘记举遮挡板
title.en: A judge forgot to hold a sight blocker for a significant amount of time in a 3x3x3 Blindfolded attempt

html.zh:
Please Be Solved Vancouver 2022（2022 年 7 月 24 日）和 Silver Spring Summer 2022（2022 年 8 月 13 日）均发生了裁判在三阶盲拧中长时间忘记举遮挡板的情况。

两案中，WCA 规则委员会均决定采用额外尝试。但后一案被 WCA 理事会推翻，改为保留原尝试。

理事会给出的理由是：

  1. 执行速度和头部位置没有变化，未显示选手起初在看魔方；
  2. 速度与选手此前没有发生事件的比赛能力一致；
  3. 这是裁判而非选手的过错。选手没有任何行为令人认为其作弊，或甚至试图利用这种情况取得优势。
html.en:
During Please Be Solved Vancouver 2022 (Jul 24, 2022) and Silver Spring Summer 2022 (Aug 13, 2022), a judge forgot to hold a sight blocker for a significant amount of time in a 3BLD attempt.

In both cases, the decision from the WCA Regulations Committee was to keep the extra attempt. However, in the latter, the decision was overturned by the WCA Board of Directors, thus keeping the original attempt.

The WCA Board of Directors provided the following reasons:

  1. No change in the execution speed or positioning of the competitor's head to indicate that they were looking at the cube initially.
  2. The speed is in line with the competitor's abilities per previous competitions which were without incidents.
  3. It is not the fault of the competitor, but the judge. No actions from the competitor lead to the impression of cheating or even trying to gain an advantage from the situation.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2022 年 12 月
title.en: WDC Digest - December 2022

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

2022 年即将结束，希望大家这一年顺利，来年有更多魔方活动、纪录与乐趣！

WDC 分享过去三个月的工作。首先，完成了以下可能令人关注的调查：

  1. 一名被禁赛选手新建账号报名。代表提交成绩时发现，其成绩已删除。试图规避 WDC 决定这一行为，已计入最终禁赛期限的考量。
  2. 巧合的是，同一周末不同国家发生两起几乎相同的盲拧作弊案。看到证据后，两名选手立即承认并道歉，相关成绩被取消。鉴于年龄较小、立即承认，两案均以警告结案。我们相信其已理解错误，无需禁赛。
  3. 近月魔方偷窃案件增加，即将结束两项相关调查。提醒选手看管随身物品，不要在比赛中让魔方无人照看。

你可能已注意到委员会新成员。过去三个月，高级成员审阅 29 人申请，多数都有潜力成为优秀成员；16 人获选面试，最终 8 人加入。

新成员充满热情和活力，已开展一些调查。他们将帮助 WDC 更好地确保规则被遵守、比赛对所有人安全。

最后提醒充分理解规则和流程，有问题时询问代表；若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即联系最近的代表报告。

如有问题，可发邮件或在论坛纪律板块提问。

Sebastiano Tronto WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The end of 2022 is approaching. We hope that this was a successful year for you, and hope that the upcoming year will be full of even more cubing, records, and fun!

The WDC would like to share with you some insight on the work we have done in the last three months. Firstly, we have concluded a few investigations that could be of interest for you:

  1. A competitor signed up with a new account and registered for a competition despite being banned. This was caught by the Delegates when submitting the results of the competition, and the results of the competitor were removed. This attempt to circumvent a WDC decision has been taken into account to determine the final duration of the ban.
  2. As an unusual coincidence, we had two nearly identical cases of cheating in a blindfolded event on the same weekend, but in two different countries. When confronted with the evidence, the competitors immediately owned up to their mistakes and apologized. The affected results have been disqualified. Given the relatively young age of these competitors, and the fact that they immediately confessed, we concluded both cases with a warning. We believe that they understood their mistake and that bans were not necessary in these cases.
  3. In the past few months there has also been an increase in cases of cube stealing, and we are about to close two investigations related to this. We take this chance to remind all competitors to keep an eye on their belongings at all times and not to leave their puzzles unattended at competitions.

On a different note, you may have noticed that some new members have joined our committee. Indeed, during the past three months the senior members have gone through the applications of 29 candidates, most of whom were potentially excellent WDC members. Of these, 16 candidates were selected for an interview, and finally 8 of the interviewed candidates have been selected to join the Disciplinary Committee.

The new members have taken up their role with great enthusiasm and energy, and have already carried out a few investigations. With their help, the WDC will be better equipped to make sure that the WCA Regulations are followed, and that competitions remain a safe environment for everyone.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Sebastiano Tronto
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 选手停表后请求额外尝试
title.en: A competitor asked for an extra after stopping the timer

html.zh:
一名选手在四阶盲拧还原结束、结果为 DNF 后，但在签署成绩单、结束该次尝试之前，声称受到干扰。代表依据 11e 给予了额外尝试。

WRC 进一步讨论后，同意保留原尝试成绩。

尝试中发生事件时，选手有三种选择，各有收益与风险：

  1. 立即停止尝试并申请额外尝试；
  2. 按指导 11e+，保持尝试进行，同时申诉请求额外尝试；
  3. 完成尝试后再提出请求。

WRC 强烈建议选择前两种方式，因为这样代表更容易判断申诉是否公平，也能排除选手根据还原结果决定是否提出请求的可能。
html.en:
A competitor claimed to be distracted in a 4x4x4 Blindfolded attempt with a DNF result, after finishing the solve, but before finishing the attempt (before signing the score sheet). Delegates granted the competitor an extra attempt as per Regulation 11e.

WRC further discussed this incident and agreed that the original attempt should stay.

When an incident occurs during the attempt, a competitor has three options, each with their own benefits and risks:

  1. Immediately stop the attempt and request the extra.
  2. Keep the attempt running and appeal for an extra, as per Guideline 11e+.
  3. Finish the attempt and then try to request the extra.

WRC highly recommends the competitors to choose the first or the second option as the WCA Delegate will be able to better determine the fairness of the appeal and exclude the possibility that the competitor based their request on the result of their solve.

title.zh: 比赛部分项目使用成绩单遮盖魔方
title.en: Score sheets were used as cube covers in some events of a competition

html.zh:
Hanoi Open 2022 的魔表、金字塔和五魔方用成绩单替代合适的魔方罩，违反 A2c1：

A2c1 打乱员须遮盖打乱后的魔方，使任何选手或观众都无法看见任何部分，并保持遮盖至尝试开始。

A2c1+ 也明确禁止此做法：

A2c1+ 提醒：过去曾用成绩单遮盖魔方，却仍暴露部分侧面。这种做法现已禁止。

虽然没有证据表明任何人主动试图作弊，WRC 认为这严重违反打乱保密要求，因此删除了魔表、金字塔和五魔方的全部成绩。此决定也遵循 Cavite Open 2 2018 的先例（见日志）。
html.en:
At Hanoi Open 2022, score sheets were used instead of appropriate cube covers for certain events (Clock, Pyraminx, and Megaminx) in violation of Regulation A2c1:

A2c1) The scrambler places a cover over the scrambled puzzle that makes it impossible for any competitors or spectators to see any part of the puzzle. The cover remains over the puzzle until the start of the attempt.

Guideline A2c1+ also explicitly prohibits the use of score sheets as covers:

A2c1+) REMINDER In the past, score sheets have been used to cover puzzles while leaving some sides exposed. This is no longer permitted.

Although there is no evidence that anyone actively tried to cheat, the WRC agreed that this is a serious violation of scramble secrecy, therefore all the results from Clock, Pyraminx, and Megaminx had been removed. This decision also follows the precedent from Cavite Open 2 2018 (see this incident log).

title.zh: 发现录入错误后，选手原本不应晋级
title.en: A competitor should not have advanced to the next round upon the data entry error was found

html.zh:
一名选手晋级某项目决赛。决赛后、比赛结束前核对录入时发现错误，纠正后该选手名次比原晋级范围低两位。

代表暂定修改晋级条件，增加决赛晋级人数，使受影响选手仍能参赛。由于此决定符合 9p1，WRC 依据 9p2a 同意代表的决定。
html.en:
A competitor qualified for the final round of an event. Upon checking data entry after the final round, but before the competition was over, an error was found which placed this competitor two positions beyond the original advancement conditions.

The Delegates provisionally decided to change the advancement conditions, increasing the number of competitors qualifying for the final round. Therefore, the competitors affected by this mistake could still compete. The WRC agreed with delegates' decision as per Regulation 9p2a because the decision was in compliance with Regulation 9p1.

title.zh: 记录成绩前计时器复位，仅有显示屏视频证据
title.en: Timer was reset before the result was recorded (only video evidence showing the display was available)

html.zh:
选手还原结束后，在成绩完整写入成绩单前，计时器被裁判复位（Montpellier Open 2022），或自行复位（Bay Area Speedcubin' 29 PM 2022、Rose City 2022）。视频只拍到显示屏，没有拍到计时器。

由于视频中显示屏清晰可见，且整个还原过程工作正常，WRC 同意保留显示屏上的原成绩。

请注意，A7b1 要求始终从计时器而非显示屏记录成绩：

A7b1 若有处罚，裁判记录计时器显示的原始时间及所有处罚……

无法取得计时器时间时，仅在特定情况下可接受显示屏时间（见事件日志）。
html.en:
After a competitor finished their solve, the timer was reset by either the judge (Montpellier Open 2022) or by the timer itself (Bay Area Speedcubin' 29 PM 2022 and Rose City 2022) before the result was fully recorded on the score sheet. The video evidence showed the display but not the timer.

Since the display was clearly shown in the evidence and it was working fine through the solve, WRC agreed that the original result shown on the display may stand.

Please note that as per Regulation A7b1 the result must always be recorded from the timer, but not from the display:

A7b1) If penalties are assigned, the judge records the original recorded time displayed on the timer, along with any penalties...

The time from the display may be accepted when the one from the timer is unavailable only under certain circumstances (see the following incident log).

title.zh: 多盲达到时限时，选手仍握着已还原魔方
title.en: A competitor was stopped at the time limit holding a solved puzzle in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，新增了 A6e++，明确此类事件的处理方式。

一名选手在三阶多盲恰好达到 60 分钟时限时被叫停，手中仍握着已还原魔方。裁判停表时选手仍握着魔方，因此按 A6c 加 2 秒：

A6c 选手须完全松开魔方后停表，否则 DNF。例外：若停表后至松开魔方前没有转动，裁判可酌情改判加 2 秒。

此时选手也在停表后触碰魔方而未转动，因此按 A6e2 本应再加 2 秒：

A6e2 停表后触碰魔方但未转动，处罚为加 2 秒……

不过，WRC 认为上述规则未清楚说明如何正确叠加处罚；规则本意是防止停表时及停表后继续转动。因此，本案仅按 A6c 处罚。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since resolution of this incident, clarification A6e++ was introduced, which provides clarity on how to resolve such an incident.

A competitor was stopped right at the 60 minute time limit in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind holding a solved puzzle. In other words, the competitor was holding the puzzle when the judge stopped the timer, so a time penalty (+2 seconds) was applied following Regulation A6c:

A6c) The competitor must fully release the puzzle before stopping the timer. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF). Exception: If no moves have been applied after stopping the timer and before releasing the puzzle, a time penalty (+2 seconds) may be assigned instead, at the discretion of the judge.

In this case, the competitor was also touching the puzzle after stopping the timer without applying any moves, so another time penalty (+2 seconds) should have been applied as per Regulation A6e2:

A6e2) Penalty for touching the puzzle after stopping the timer without applying any moves: time penalty (+2 seconds)...

However, the WRC agreed that: the regulations cited above are unclear regarding the correct way to apply the penalties and the spirit of these regulations is to prevent the competitor from applying moves upon and/or after stopping the timer. Therefore, the attempt was penalized following Regulation A6c only.

title.zh: 赛后发现魔方部件略可辨别
title.en: One piece of the puzzle was found slightly distinguishable after the competition

html.zh:
赛后数天，一名选手联系代表，报告其魔方的一个部件声音与其他部件略有差别，另一个部件涂层也不同。两点均在赛后发现，选手提供视频展示差异。该魔方曾用于三阶盲拧。

WRC 同意保留原成绩，理由是：

  1. 即使安静环境下，声音差异也很轻微；比赛环境，包括盲拧项目，并非完全安静；
  2. 选手只在赛后分析声音差异，比赛中不存在明确优势。还原视频也显示，其速度不允许根据声音或触感实施转动；
  3. 现场代表认为该触感差异合理。3j1 允许合理磨损：

3j2 魔方可有合理磨损，由 WCA 代表判断。
html.en:
A competitor contacted the WCA Delegate several days after the competition reporting that one piece of their puzzle had a sound slightly distinguishable from other pieces and that another piece coating was different from other pieces. Both things were found after the competition. The competitor provided video evidence to show the difference. They used this puzzle during their 3x3x3 Blindfolded attempts.

The WRC agreed that the results should be kept as is for the following reasons:

  1. The sound is very lightly distinguishable even in silence, which is not the case in a competitive environment, even during Blindfolded Solving events.
  2. The competitor analyzed the sound difference only after the competition, so there was no defined advantage during the competition. The video of the attempts also showed that the competitor's solving speed could not allow to apply the moves based on the sound and/or texture.
  3. The texture was considered reasonable by the WCA Delegate at the competition. Regulation 3j1 allows it:

3j2) Puzzles are permitted to have reasonable wear, at the discretion of the WCA Delegate.

title.zh: 意外重复使用打乱
title.en: Scrambles were accidentally reused

html.zh:
一名比赛工作人员在项目举行前一天参加了五阶盲拧。他使用的打乱被误用于后续某组。这些打乱此前已被两名工作人员及一名不参加该组的选手看过。

按 4b4，打乱应在最长 2 小时内使用：

4b4 每条打乱序列应在最长 2 小时内使用，时间从首次应用该打乱开始计算。

代表给予选手暂定的额外尝试。

此处无法保证打乱保密性；即使 4b4 的用词为“应”，也必须严肃对待打乱保密。基于以上理由，WRC 同意保留额外尝试成绩。
html.en:
A competition staff member competed in 5x5x5 Blindfolded one day prior to the event. Mistakenly, the scrambles that were used for their attempts were reused for one of the next groups. The scrambles were seen by two competition staff members and one competitor who was not competing in that group.

As per Regulation 4b4, the scrambles should be applied during a maximum time frame of 2 hours:

4b4) Each scramble sequence should be applied during a maximum time frame of 2 hours. This time frame starts when the scramble sequence is applied for the first time.

The WCA Delegates granted the competitors provisional extra attempts.

Since scramble secrecy is not guaranteed here and even though Regulation 4b4 wording is "should'', scramble secrecy must be treated seriously. Due to the reasons above, WRC agreed that the extra attempts should be kept.

title.zh: 选手在最少步中关闭闹钟
title.en: A competitor turned off an alarm during a Fewest Moves attempt

html.zh:
最少步尝试中，一名选手手机闹钟响起，选手拿出手机将其关闭。代表确认手机仅用于关闹钟。

规则规定：

2i 观察或还原时，选手不得使用 Stackmat 计时器或秒表以外的电子或音频设备，例如手机、MP3 播放器、录音机、额外照明。 2i4 比赛时，选手应关闭所有手机通知，避免干扰比赛。

严格适用规则，因选手操作了手机这一电子设备，该次尝试应为 DNF。但 WRC 同意保留成绩，理由是：

  1. 选手只关闭闹钟，没有取得优势；
  2. 若继续响铃，可能干扰其他选手并导致严重后果。

WRC 建议选手和代表更谨慎对待电子设备，将其关闭以避免类似情况。
html.en:
During a Fewest Moves attempt a competitor's phone alarm went off. The competitor took out their phone and turned off the alarm. The WCA Delegate confirmed that the competitor used their phone only to turn it off.

Regulation 2i states:

2i) While inspecting or solving, competitors must not use electronics or audio equipment (e.g. cell phones, MP3 players, dictaphones, additional lighting) apart from the Stackmat timer or stopwatch.

Additionally, Regulation 2i4 states:

2i4) Competitors should turn off all cell phone notifications while competing to avoid disturbing the competition.

Strictly applying the Regulations, the competitor's attempt must have been disqualified (DNF) as they interacted with their phone (an electronic device). However, the WRC agreed that the attempt should stay for the following reasons:

  1. The competitor only turned off the alarm, no advantage was gained.
  2. If the alarm continued to be on, other competitors may have been disturbed, which could lead to serious consequences.

The WRC recommends competitors and WCA Delegates to be more careful with electronic devices and to turn them off to avoid similar situations.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2022 年 9 月
title.en: WDC Digest - September 2022

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

经历数年疫情导致 WCA 活动稀少后，全球多数地区比赛终于逐步恢复！这令人振奋，希望情况持续改善，让各地有更多比赛和乐趣。

不幸的是，随比赛恢复，欺诈、作弊及其他不当行为也增加。纪律委员会决定就今年部分调查发布简短匿名报告，帮助大家了解幕后工作：

  1. 今年早些时候一场比赛，三名年轻选手无视代表禁止，进入场馆限制区域。在本应锁住的房间内，两人打开水龙头后未关闭便返回比赛。数日后才被发现，积水已严重损坏建筑。监控确认了三人身份。面对证据，他们承认，家长赔偿损失。鉴于行为及后果严重，三人均因进入限制区域被禁赛，其中造成水灾的两人期限更长。
  2. 一人用假名、假邮箱报名，并在备注中留下冒犯性言论。成绩团队 Sam Spendla 协助查明其为已注册选手，而且不是第一次。面对询问，其立即承认并道歉，获正式警告。使用 WCA 官方资源戏弄代表和主办方以自娱，并不可接受。
  3. 选手称其某次时间因把 1 看成 7 而在 WCA Live 录得更慢，并向当地社群分享编辑过的成绩单图片。详细调查认定首次录入正确，选手试图欺骗我们和代表，以得到更快时间，本案中也是国家纪录。因此给予禁赛。
  4. 一名选手报告遭受其所称的骚扰：另一选手通过 WCA 官方社交媒体的社群投稿分享了其个人信息。后者明确无悔意，承认故意拖延回复以免在国内重大比赛前被禁赛。调查还发现其针对举报者持续欺凌、骚扰和嘲弄，因此禁赛。我们对欺凌，以及故意造成他人精神或身体伤害的行为零容忍。
  5. 最后是一则积极消息：一名有过错的选手弥补了错误。2014 年，Carlos Miguel Pérez（2014）以出售魔方为由收取多名选手钱款，却不交货，原公开公告见此处。近 8 年后，Carlos 证明已联系被骗选手、退款或交付魔方。诈骗和盗窃案件通常永久禁赛，除非归还全部财物。因此本案解除其禁赛，他可再次参加 WCA 比赛。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

Sebastiano Tronto WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

After a couple of years of little WCA activity due to the COVID-19 pandemic, we are finally seeing a gradual return of competitions in most regions around the world! This is exciting, and we hope that things continue to improve so that we can have more competitions and more fun all around the world.

Unfortunately, as competitions are returning, we have also seen an increase in the number of attempts of fraud, cheating and other kinds of misbehavior. The Disciplinary Committee has decided to publish a short and anonymized report for some of the cases that we have investigated this year. We hope that this can give you an insight into the work that the WDC carries out behind the scenes:

  1. At a competition earlier this year, three young competitors entered restricted areas of the building where the competition was hosted, despite being told not to by the delegates. Whilst in a room that was meant to be locked, two of them turned the taps on and left them on as they returned to the competition. This was not discovered until a few days later, when the water had already caused significant damage to the building. The competitors were caught and identified thanks to the surveillance cameras. When confronted with the evidence, they confessed, and their parents paid for the damage done to the building. Given the severity of these actions and their consequences, we gave all three competitors a ban for entering restricted areas, and the two of them responsible for the flooding received a longer ban.
  2. A person signed up for a competition with a fake name, a fake email address and left offensive remarks in the registration comments. With the help of Sam Spendla from the Results Team we were able to identify this person as a registered speedcuber, and we noticed that it was not the first time they did this. When we confronted this person they immediately confessed and apologized. We gave this competitor a formal warning. We would like to take this chance to remind everyone that using official WCA resources to make fun of delegates and organizers for your own amusement is not acceptable behavior.
  3. A competitor claimed that one of the times they obtained was faster than what was entered on WCA live, due to a 1 being mistaken for a 7. To support this claim, they shared an edited picture of the scorecard with the local community. After a detailed investigation we determined that the time had been entered correctly the first time, and that this competitor was trying to deceive us and the delegates in order to obtain a faster time, and in this case a national record result. The competitor was issued a ban.
  4. A competitor reported being the victim of what they described as harassment: some personal information was shared by another competitor as a community contribution via official WCA social media. The competitor made it clear that they had no remorse for their actions and admitted to delaying his response in order to avoid being banned before a major competition in their country. In our investigation we have also discovered a pattern of bullying, harassment and mockery against the competitor who reported the case to us. With all of this in mind, after our investigation we decided to issue a ban. We would like to take this chance to remind competitors that we have a zero tolerance stance on bullying and any actions that are taken in a deliberate effort to cause others emotional or physical harm.
  5. Ending with a positive note, we have a guilty competitor who redeemed himself. Back in 2014, Carlos Miguel Pérez (2014) defrauded multiple fellow speedcubers by promising to sell them cubes, taking their money and never delivering the cubes. You can read the original public announcement here. After almost 8 years Carlos was able to prove to us that he had contacted the defrauded competitors and returned their money or given them their cubes. As is standard in cases of fraud and theft, bans remain permanent unless the competitor responsible returns all stolen property and/or funds, so in this case we have lifted Carlos’ ban and he is once again able to compete in WCA competitions.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Sebastiano Tronto
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 招募 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）成员（2022 年 9 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) Members (September 2022)

html.zh:
WCA 纪律委员会正在招募新成员！任何人都可申请，也鼓励目前不属于 WCA 工作人员的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

主要工作是调查比赛中的纪律事件，例如作弊尝试或不当行为。必要时，我们可能发出警告或禁赛，也向 WCA 代表提供比赛现场处理特定情况的意见。

权利与职责详见动议 10.2022.3—纪律委员会、15.2022.1—暂停资格及其他处分及行为准则。纪律日志载有以往公开公告。欢迎在 WCA 论坛纪律板块提问。

要求

硬性要求仅有：能以书面英语沟通；熟悉 WCA 比赛环境，参加过几场比赛即可。其他重视的素质包括：能与队友讨论推理及想法；逻辑和分析能力；保密意识；沟通能力。精通一个或多个速拧项目、熟练掌握英语以外语言有帮助，但并非必需。

成员多样性将使委员会受益，因此尤其鼓励文化背景、国籍、年龄、性别与现有成员不同的社群成员申请。

申请

请于 2022 年 10 月 14 日星期五 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 申请发送至 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org，包括简短自我介绍、为 WCA 和魔方社群所做活动、相关个人技能、加入 WDC 的动机。

全部材料应在同一个 PDF 中。申请人预计将在 24 小时内收到确认收件回复。申请期结束后开始遴选，可能包括面试或其他评估。如有问题，可联系 WDC 负责人 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is looking for new members! Everyone can apply, and we encourage community members who are not part of the WCA staff to send their application.

What does the WDC do?

Most of our work consists of investigating disciplinary incidents at competitions, such as cheating attempts or inappropriate behavior. If the circumstances require it, we may issue warnings or bans. We also give feedback to WCA delegates on how to handle certain situations during WCA competitions.

If you are interested in the details of our rights and duties, check out the motions 10.2022.3 - Disciplinary Committee and 15.2022.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions, as well as the Code of Conduct. The Disciplinary Log contains public announcements made by the WDC in the past. Feel free to ask questions about any of this in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Requirements

The only strict requirements for WDC members are:

  • Ability to communicate in English (written)
  • Familiarity with the WCA competition environment (having attend a few competitions is enough)

Other qualities we look for are:

  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas with team members
  • Logical and analytical reasoning
  • Confidentiality
  • Communication skills

The following qualities are useful, but not necessary:

  • Expertise in one or more speedcubing events
  • Fluency in a language other than English

The committee would greatly benefit from the diversity of their members. We therefore especially encourage applications from community members with a different cultural background, nationality, age and gender from the current members.

Applications

Applicants can send their application as a PDF document to stronto@worldcubeassociation.org before Friday, October 14, 2022, 23:59 UTC. The application document should contain:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA and for the cubing community
  • Overview of the personal skills relevant to the role
  • Motivation for applying to the WDC

Everything should be contained in a single PDF file. Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application within 24 hours. The selection process will start after the application period is over, and it might include an interview or other kinds of assessment.

If you have any questions feel free to contact the WDC leader at stronto@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: 盲拧中使用低头戴眼罩技巧（无额外尝试）
title.en: The "Nod-don" technique was used for Blindfolded Solving (extra not available)

html.zh:
一名使用低头戴眼罩技巧的选手在赛后联系代表，认为自己第一步转动可能接近眼罩尚未完全戴好的时刻，可能违反 B4a 和 B4b。

B4a：选手戴上眼罩，开始盲拧阶段。 B4b：眼罩完全戴好前不得转动魔方，否则该次尝试 DNF。

以正常速度分析视频后，WRC 认为选手不太可能取得优势，因此允许该成绩保持有效。
html.en:
A competitor who used the nod-don technique contacted the delegate after the competition because he thought he may have been close to starting the first turn before the blindfold was fully donned (possibly against regulations B4a and B4b).

B4a) The competitor dons the blindfold to start the blindfolded phase.

B4b) The competitor must not apply moves to the puzzle before they have fully donned the blindfold. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

After analyzing video evidence at full speed, the WRC came to the conclusion that the competitor is not likely to have gained an advantage, thus allowing the solve to remain valid.

title.zh: 选手使用侧面带标志贴纸的魔表
title.en: A competitor used a Clock with a sticker (logo) placed on the side

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，专门规则 3h4d 已允许在魔表任何位置放置标志，只要不遮挡内部钟面。

一名选手使用的魔表在侧边贴有标志贴纸，而非贴在平坦的正反面。

该魔表被认定可用于比赛，理由是：

  1. 没有规则明确禁止魔表标志，只要代表判断标志不带来任何优势；
  2. WRC 认为选手不太可能因标志而获得优势。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, there is now a specific regulation, regulation 3h4d, allowing logos to be placed anywhere on the clock, so long as it doesn't obstruct the inner clock faces

A competitor used a Clock with a sticker (logo) placed on the side (different from the flat surfaces of the puzzle).

The puzzle was determined to be competition-legal as per the following arguments:

  1. There are no regulations explicitly forbidding logos for Clock puzzles (as long as the logo does not provide any advantage, at delegate's discretion).
  2. The WRC concluded that the competitor is not likely to have gained an advantage because of the logo.

title.zh: Square-1 被认定使用错误打乱（无额外尝试）
title.en: Square-1 attempt was identified as misscramble (extra not available)

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，11i 已更新，对错误打乱何时应获额外尝试设定了更严格的标准。

赛后发现，某次 Square-1 尝试使用了错误打乱。由于无法提供额外尝试，且该错误打乱比正式打乱简单，WRC 决定将该次尝试判为 DNF。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated to provide stricter criteria for when a misscramble should receive an extra.

After the competition, a Square-1 attempt was identified as misscramble. As an extra was not available and due to the fact that the misscramble was easier than the official scramble, the WRC decided to DNF the attempt.

title.zh: 选手在五魔方观察时意外造成错位
title.en: A competitor unintentionally caused a misalignment during Megaminx inspection

html.zh:
一名选手在五魔方观察时意外使魔方错位，可能违反 A3c1。

依据 11f仔细审查视频后，WRC 决定不判 DNF。分析的各帧均未显示该面转动超过允许的 36º（10f2）。
html.en:
During the inspection of a Megaminx attempt, the competitor caused an unintentional misalignment to the puzzle, possibly against regulation A3c1.

After careful review of the video footage (11f), the WRC has decided not to DNF the attempt. None of the frames analyzed point to the face having moved beyond the allowed 36º (10f2).

title.zh: 选手询问特定魔方状态能否结束尝试，得到非确定答复
title.en: A competitor asked whether ending an attempt with a certain cube state was legal and got an indefinite response

html.zh:
一名选手在七阶还原末尾掉了两个中心盖。裁判询问代表，结束前是否必须装回中心盖。代表认为可以不装，但表示将查规则确认。当代表意识到初步说法错误时，选手已经在未装回中心盖的情况下停表。

虽然现场给予了暂定的额外尝试，但由于代表最初并未给出确定答复，该次还原仍被判为 DNF。
html.en:
The competitor had two center caps fall off at the end of a 7x7x7 solve. The judge then asked a WCA Delegate whether the competitor had to place the caps on before finishing the attempt, and the WCA Delegate believed that it was fine, but was going to check with the WCA Regulations just to be sure. After the WCA Delegate realized that they were wrong about their initial claim, the competitor had already stopped the timer without the caps on.

While a provisional extra was provided to the competitor, the solve was deemed a DNF because the WCA Delegate initially did not have a definitive answer.

title.zh: 选手还原时，传递员拾起掉出的部件
title.en: A runner picked up a popped piece during a competitor's attempt

html.zh:
三阶某轮中，选手的魔方掉出一个部件。一名首次担任传递员的工作人员将其捡起并递给选手，不符合指导 A5b++。代表给予额外尝试，因为选手未请求帮助，传递员是自行这样做的，错误应由传递员而非选手承担。

WRC 认为本案判 DNF 过于严厉，因此应采用额外尝试，理由是：

  1. 额外尝试遵循了正确流程；
  2. 并非选手的错；
  3. 选手没有试图取得不公平优势。

若原时间仍可获得，则应采用原成绩。这样是在 DNF 与额外尝试之间折中：对选手未请求的帮助判 DNF 过重，而给予额外尝试又过于宽厚，因为发生掉块的那次还原推测并不理想。
html.en:
During a 3x3 round, a piece popped out of a competitor's cube and a first-time runner picked it up and handed it to the competitor, which is not what Guideline A5b++ calls for. An extra attempt was provided by the WCA Delegates because this was the runner's fault and not the competitor's since the competitor did not ask the runner to pick it up and the runner did this by themselves.

The WRC found a DNF to be too harsh for this particular case. As a result, the extra attempt should be used for the following reasons:

  1. The extra follows the correct procedure.
  2. It was not competitor's fault.
  3. The competitor did not attempt to gain an unfair advantage.

In case the original time was available, that original result should have been used. The reasoning for using the original time is to find a compromise between a DNF (which too harsh for something the competitor did not ask for) and an extra (which too kind because the solve with a pop was presumably bad).

title.zh: 视频显示观察超时，且裁判没有按时提示
title.en: A competitor's video showed an over-inspected solve without any time callouts by the judge

html.zh:
一名选手的三阶还原视频显示，观察约 17.1 秒，但视频中没有在正确时点听到“8 秒”或“12 秒”提示。

最初决定判 DNF，申诉后由 WCA 理事会推翻。理事会认为保留原成绩更公平，理由是：

  1. 错误由裁判造成，观察超时并非选手过错；
  2. 选手可能获得了优势，也可能没有。选手听到“8 秒”提示就开始还原并不少见，本案选手也是如此；
  3. 既然是裁判出错，本应给予额外尝试，但已无法提供，因此保留原时间；
  4. 本案判 DNF 过于严厉，接受实际取得的时间更公平。
html.en:
In a competitor's video for a 3x3x3 Cube attempt, the competitor over-inspected (around 17.1s), but no call outs of 8 or 12 seconds at the correct timestamp were heard in the video.

The initial decision was to DNF this solve, but the decision was overturned by the WCA Board after an appeal. The WCA Board decided that it was more fair to let the result stand.

This was done because of the following:

  1. The error was made by the judge and the competitor is not at fault for overinspecting.
  2. The competitor may have gained an advantage, but potentially may not have. This is because it is not uncommon for competitors to begin solving when they hear the "8 second" warning, as this competitor did.
  3. Because the mistake was made by the judge, an extra should have been provided. However, since an extra was not available, the original time shall stand.
  4. A DNF is overly harsh for this situation and accepting the time achieved is more fair.

title.zh: 最少步中使用乐高积木替代贴纸作为三阶魔方上的标记
title.en: Use of a 3x3x3 Cube with LEGO Pieces instead of stickers in Fewest Moves Solving

html.zh:
按当时规定，最少步中可以用贴纸在魔方上作标记：

E3 选手可在尝试中使用以下物品；使用未授权物品的处罚为 DNF。 E3c 贴纸，自备。

其他形式的标记，只要不违反其他 WCA 规则，也可使用。例如，三阶魔方的色片可像贴纸一样装上积木（如乐高），只要不违反其他规则便合法。通过拼装而非粘贴将积木作为标记件放在表面，是允许的。

但依据 E3e，魔方和标记件在最少步中使用前须获得代表批准。代表应确认魔方及积木不违规，例如不含电子辅助功能，也不会带来不公平优势。
html.en:
Currently, in Fewest Moves Solving, the stickers can be used as indicators on a puzzle:

E3) The competitor may use the following objects during the attempt. Penalty for using unauthorized objects: disqualification of the attempt (DNF). E3c) Stickers (self-supplied).

Other forms of indicator are allowed as long as the indicators does not break other WCA Regulations. For example, using a 3x3x3 Cube that has tiles that allow blocks (e.g. LEGO blocks) to be placed on them like stickers, is legal as long as it does not break other WCA Regulations. It is okay to use these blocks as indicating pieces by assembling instead of sticking to the puzzle surfaces.

However, due to Regulation E3e, the puzzle and the indication pieces should be approved by the WCA Delegates before being used in the Fewest Moves. The WCA Delegate should make sure the puzzles and the blocks are not illegal (e.g. contain electronic aids or might give an unfair advantage).

title.zh: WDC 负责人任命公告（2021 年 2 月）
title.en: WDC Leader Announcement (February 2021)

html.zh:
很高兴宣布新的委员会负责人 Sebastiano Tronto。他将担任 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）负责人，此前已是委员会成员。

根据委员会与团队动议第 4 节，由理事会选出，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票批准。

祝 Sebastiano 顺利履行新职责。理事会还收到 Alaqmaar Gandhi 的申请。感谢 Alaqmaar 申请，两份申请均可在此处查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader, Sebastiano Tronto. He will become the new Leader of the WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) and was already working as a Member of the Committee.

Sebastiano was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Sebastiano best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

  • Alaqmaar Gandhi

We thank Alaqmaar for applying and both applications can be found here.

title.zh: 招募 WDC 负责人（2021 年 1 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WDC Leader (January 2021)

html.zh:
将任命新的 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）负责人。申请向所有 WCA 成员开放，申请人无需目前在 WCA 任职。

候选人应履行 24 个月任期，平均每周投入至少 5 小时。期望具备强领导力、注重细节、能够讨论推理和想法、熟悉 WCA 活动、出色沟通能力。

申请期为即日起至 2021 年 1 月 18 日 23:59 UTC。请私下发送至理事会 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

文件必须为 PDF，包括简短自我介绍、为 WCA 所做活动、担任 WDC 负责人的目标。另请提供可在申请期结束后公开的副本。

权利与职责见动议 10.2019.2。申请期后，理事会投票遴选，经高级代表及在任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后宣布新负责人，流程见动议 10.2020.0第 4 节。

感谢申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) Leader. The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
  • Familiarity with WCA activities
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until January 18th, 2021, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WDC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WDC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2019.2.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2020.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: WDC 负责人申请情况（2020 年 12 月）
title.en: WDC Leader Application (December 2020)

html.zh: 由于未收到任何 WCA 纪律委员会负责人申请，WCA 理事会即日起代任 WDC 负责人，直至找到新负责人。
html.en: Since we didn’t receive any applications for the position of WCA Disciplinary Committee Leader, the WCA Board has stepped in as the WDC Leader effective immediately. The Board will continue in this position until a new leader is found.

title.zh: 招募 WDC 负责人（2020 年 10 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WDC Leader (October 2020)

html.zh:
Lorenzo Vigani Poli 的任期即将结束，将任命新的 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）负责人。感谢 Lorenzo 在此岗位的工作。

候选人应履行 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 4–6 小时。期望素质为保密、客观思考、公平、周全细致。

申请期为即日起至 2020 年 11 月 23 日 23:59 UTC。请私下发送至理事会 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

申请必须为 PDF，包括简短自我介绍、为 WCA 所做活动、担任 WDC 负责人的目标；另需一份可在申请期结束后公开的副本。

权利与职责见动议 10.2019.2。申请期后，理事会投票遴选，经高级代表及在任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后宣布，流程见动议 10.2020.0第 4 节。

感谢申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) Leader, as Lorenzo Vigani Poli's term is ending as the Leader of the Committee. We would like to thank Lorenzo for the work he has done in this position.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 4-6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Secrecy
  • Objective thinking
  • Fairness
  • Thoroughness

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until November 23rd, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WDC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WDC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2019.2.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2020.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 选手在开始尝试前被取消资格
title.en: A competitor was disqualified before their attempts

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，2j1a 已修改。如果选手在被取消资格的轮次中尚未成功完成一次还原，现允许记录为 DNS，而非 DNF。

一名选手因未履行裁判任务，被代表取消某轮资格。按 2j1a，本应记录为 DNF：

2j1 因任何原因被取消某项目资格后，选手不得再进行该项目的任何尝试。 2j1a 该项目所有剩余尝试均记录为 DNF。

但 WRC 认为，选手在任何尝试开始前已被取消资格，符合 9f5 和 9f5+ 的定义：

9f5 选手有资格进行一次尝试但选择放弃时，记为 DNS（未开始）。 9f5+（……）若选手不具备某次尝试资格，例如未通过及格线，则该次尝试没有成绩。

依据 BCM Arya Cubing Challenge 2019 事件的理由（日志）及 9f5+，WRC 同意删除选手成绩。规则将更新以明确此点。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, regulation 2j1a has been changed and now allows for results to be entered as DNS rather than DNF, if the competitor has not yet succesfully completed a solve in the round he is disqualified for.

A competitor was disqualified from a round by the WCA Delegate for not doing their judging tasks. Following Regulation 2j1a, the results should be recorded as a DNF:

2j1) If a competitor is disqualified from an event for any reason, they are not eligible for any more attempts in the event. 2j1a) The results of all remaining attempts in the event are recorded as DNF.

However, the WRC found that because the competitor was disqualified before any of their attempts, this fits the definitions of Regulation 9f5 and Guideline 9f5+:

9f5) The result of an attempt is recorded as DNS (Did Not Start) if the competitor is eligible for an attempt but declines it. 9f5+) (...). If the competitor did not qualify for an attempt (e.g. in a cutoff round), they have no result for the attempt.

Following the reasoning of BCM Arya Cubing Challenge 2019 incident (see Incident Log) and according to Guideline 9f5+, the WRC agreed that the competitor's result should be removed. The Regulations will be updated to clarify this.

title.zh: 魔表轮次未使用合适的遮盖物
title.en: Proper puzzle covers were not used for a Clock round

html.zh:
由于沟通失误，Kharkiv Open 2019 未备有魔表罩，部分裁判在魔表轮次改用成绩单遮盖。

视频证实，多名裁判使用了成绩单，违反 A2c1：

A2c1 打乱员须遮盖打乱后的魔方，使任何选手或观众都看不到任何部分，并保持遮盖至尝试开始。

A2c1+ 明确说明纸张或成绩单不能替代：

A2c1+ 提醒：过去曾用成绩单遮盖魔方，却仍暴露部分侧面。这种做法现已禁止。

虽然没有证据表明任何人明确意图作弊，但此事严重破坏了打乱保密性。依据 Cavite Open 2 2018 的先例（事件日志），WRC 同意删除该魔表轮次。
html.en:
Due to a miscommunication, Kharkiv Open 2019 did not have puzzle covers for Clocks on hand. Because of the lack of covers, some judges used a score sheet for the Clock round.

Video evidence confirms that different judges used score sheets during the Clock round. This violates Regulation A2c1:

A2c1) The scrambler places a cover over the scrambled puzzle that makes it impossible for any competitors or spectators to see any part of the puzzle. The cover remains over the puzzle until the start of the attempt.

In addition, Guideline A2c1+ explicitly clarifies that paper or score sheets are not an acceptable substitute:

A2c1+) REMINDER In the past, score sheets have been used to cover puzzles while leaving some sides exposed. This is no longer permitted.

Although there is no evidence anyone specifically intended to cheat, this is a serious violation of scramble secrecy. Following the Cavite Open 2 2018 precedent (see Incident Log), the WRC agreed that the Clock round should be removed.

title.zh: WDC 决定影响选手多个轮次的成绩
title.en: A WDC decision affected a competitor's results on multiple rounds

html.zh:
WCA 纪律委员会调查认定，一名选手在某场 WCA 比赛多个轮次中作弊，该选手被取消资格。按 2j1a，其第一轮成绩应改为 DNF。

WRC 决定，选手参加的后续轮次成绩应删除，而非判为取消资格。9p2 规定，晋级下一轮的选手必须根据前一轮排名或成绩确定。

由于该选手在第一轮没有有效成绩，不符合晋级要求，本不应参加后续轮次。

WRC 认为，这最能保持规则一致性。这些成绩应删除，因为它们从一开始就不满足产生条件，属于自始无效，而非事后可撤销。

这也符合这条事件日志：选手因自己前一轮的错误而参加了本不应参加的轮次，WRC 决定删除其该轮成绩，而非判为取消资格。

这一立场可能产生附带影响：依据 9p1，后续轮次可晋级人数可能减少：

9p1 同一项目相邻轮次之间，至少须淘汰 25% 的选手。

因此，某些选手在理论上可能不应晋级，成绩本应被删除；过去曾发生过这种情况。

为避免无辜选手因与自己无关的另一选手成绩被取消而受损，WRC 同意保留他们的成绩，不论前一轮实际可晋级人数是多少。

这也符合已有先例：

对错误录入导致误晋级：

  • 因他人成绩错误而晋级，保留成绩；
  • 因自己成绩错误而晋级，删除成绩。

此类事件已反复发生，规则将更新，体现上述特殊情形下对 9p1 的灵活解释。

此外，这是 WRC 首次采用此立场，因此不追溯适用，只用于此后发生的事件。
html.en:
A competitor had been disqualified after an investigation by the WCA Disciplinary Committee found they were guilty of cheating in a WCA Competition over multiple rounds. Applying Regulation 2j1a), the results of the first round of the competitor should be changed to DNF.

The WRC has decided that the results of the following rounds the competitor participated in should be removed, and not disqualified. Regulation 9p2 states that the competitors who advance to the next round must be determined by ranking or by result in the preceding round.

Therefore, as the competitor does not have a valid result in the first round, he doesn't meet the requirements for advancing to the next round and should not have competed in it.

The WRC understands that this decision is the best for maintaining consistency of the Regulations. The results should be removed because they were null and void, and not voidable, as they didn't meet the requirements to have happened in the first place.

This is also consistent with the decision taken on this Incident Log, in which the WRC decided to remove, and not disqualify, the results of a competitor in a round of an event they shouldn't have competed in due to a mistake they made in a previous round.

As a side effect, this stance could reduce the number of possible competitors that are able to advance to the subsequent rounds due to the Regulation 9p1:

9p1) At least 25% of competitors must be eliminated between consecutive rounds of the same event.

As a consequence, some competitors, as has happened in the past, could hypothetically not have advanced to the following round and their results should have been removed.

To prevent those innocent competitors from being harmed by the disqualification of the results of a competitor in an incident they were not involved in, the WRC has agreed to preserve their results, regardless of the number of competitors being able to advance in a previous round.

This is also consistent with the precedent set on this Incident Log, as follows:

More generally, this is what WRC decided to apply when results were wrongly entered, and someone mistakenly proceeded to the next round:

  • Keep the results if the competitor proceeded thanks to an error in someone else's results
  • Remove the results if the competitor proceeded thanks to an error in their own result

As this has become a reoccurring incident, the Regulations will be updated to reflect this understanding of a flexible interpretation of Regulation 9p1 in the special circumstances here described.

Additionally, as this is the first time the WRC has adopted this stance, this understanding should not be applied retroactively, but only on incidents that happen from now on.

title.zh: 选手签错尝试栏
title.en: A competitor signed for the wrong attempt

html.zh:
一名选手在错误的尝试栏签名。根据 A7c2，这视为 DNS：

A7c2 如果选手在开始一次尝试前签名或作其他标记，视为放弃该次尝试，成绩记为 DNS。

该选手已有足够经验，A7g 不适用，因此 WRC 同意将原尝试改为 DNS。

对于 Altona Algorithms Attempt 2 2021 的事件，WRC 认为存在实质差别：

  1. 选手并非故意；
  2. 一发现错误便立即通知代表；
  3. 显然理解第 A 章流程和签名的重要性，没有试图故意违反标准流程或获取不公平优势。

因此，WRC 同意保留该事件的原成绩。

WRC 鼓励选手熟悉速拧流程（第 A 章）。签名并非随意设置，而是用于识别打乱员和裁判，并确认选手是否认可成绩。
html.en:
A competitor signed for the wrong solve attempt. This is considered a DNS according to Regulation A7c2):

A7c2) If the competitor signs (or otherwise marks) an attempt before they have begun it, they forfeit the attempt and the result will be considered DNS.

As the competitor was experienced enough, the Regulation A7g is not applicable. Therefore the WRC agreed to changed the original attempt to DNS.

For the Altona Algorithms Attempt 2 2021 incident, the WRC agreed that this case is substantially different because:

  1. The competitor did not do it on purpose.
  2. The competitor notified the mistake to the WCA Delegate right after realizing it.
  3. It is clear that the competitor knows Article A's procedure and the importance of the signature. The competitor did not attempt to intentionally break the standard procedure not gain an unfair advantage.

Because of this, the WRC agreed to accept the original result for this incident.

The WRC would like encourage competitors to be familiar with the procedure of speedsolving (Article A). It is important to understand that the use of the signatures is not arbitrary but rather serves to identify the scramblers and judges and if the competitor agrees with the result.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2020 年初
title.en: WDC Digest - Beginning of 2020

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会在 2020 年前三个月的重要动态。

主要调查案件对土耳其社群影响重大。İzmir Open 2020 发生不幸事件：激烈争论后，一名 WCA 工作人员对选手实施身体攻击。因此，WCA 代表 İskender Aznavur 被 WEC 降职，并被 WDC 禁止参加 WCA 比赛 5 年。禁赛自 2 月 6 日开始；不久后其向理事会申诉。理事会最终认定 WDC 与 WEC 的调查过程和结论适当。

涉事选手 Ahmet Güzel 因不尊重 İskender 对规则问题的正式裁定，以及对 WCA 官员使用的言语，被禁赛 3 个月。处分于 2 月 9 日正式通知本人，其接受裁定。

鉴于 WEC 和 WDC 所作决定的重要性，我们决定公布调查报告。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或发现可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

也提醒大家，代表在正式比赛中代表 WCA 和规则，选手应接受决定、遵从指示，不应现场抗议。若认为代表未按 WCA 使命、精神或规则行事，应向伦理委员会（WEC）报告；在比赛中闹事并非适当处理方式。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the first three months of 2020.

The main case we investigated greatly affects the Turkish Community. An unfortunate situation occurred during İzmir Open 2020, where a WCA Staff Member physically assaulted a competitor as a consequence of a heated discussion. Because of this, WCA Delegate İskender Aznavur has been demoted by the WEC and banned from WCA Competitions for 5 years by the WDC. İskender’s ban began on the 6th of February and he decided to appeal the ruling shortly after, contacting the WCA Board. In the end, the Board concluded that the investigation by the WDC and WEC was appropriately conducted and concluded.

The competitor involved in this incident, Ahmet Güzel, has been banned for 3 months for failing to respect İskender’s official ruling on a Regulations issue and for the language he used towards a WCA Official. Ahmet’s ban was made official and communicated to him on the 9th of February and he accepted the ruling.

Given the importance of the decisions taken by the WEC and WDC, we have decided to publish the report of the investigation. The document can be found here.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

We would also like to remember that Delegates represent the WCA and the Regulations during official competitions, and every competitor should accept their decisions and follow their instructions without protesting. If you believe a Delegate is not acting in accordance with the Mission, Spirit, and Regulations of the WCA you should report them to the Ethics Committee (WEC). Creating a scene at the competition is not an appropriate way to handle the situation.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 五阶盲拧成绩缺少秒表备用计时
title.en: 5x5x5 Blindfolded result without a backup stopwatch timing

html.zh:
一名选手在五阶盲拧中用时超过 10 分钟。由于沟通失误，裁判以为无需秒表，没有使用秒表计时。

分析视频后，WRC 同意使用原时间，理由是：

  1. 用时接近 10 分钟，可从视频中估算；
  2. 根据规则 9f2，成绩应四舍五入到整秒。

Nacional Perubik 2016 也接受过类似成绩（见事件日志）：

一名选手成功完成五阶盲拧，成绩未写入成绩单，但选手录下了还原，因此从视频中恢复用时，并接受为正式成绩。
html.en:
A competitor solved over 10 minutes in the 5x5x5 Blindfolded event. Due to a miscommunication, the judge did not use a stopwatch assuming that the competitor did not need it.

After analyzing the video evidence, the WRC agreed to use the original time because:

  1. The time was near to 10 minutes so it was possible to estimate the time from the video.
  2. According to Regulation 9f2, the result should be rounded to the nearest second.

In addition, a similar result was accepted at Nacional Perubik 2016 (see Incident Log):

A competitor got a succesful 5x5x5 Blindfolded solve. The result wasn't written on the score sheet, but the competitor had recorded the solve, so the time was retrieved from the video and the result accepted as official.

title.zh: Skewb 一轮中出现多个错误打乱
title.en: A Skewb round was found to have several misscrambles

html.zh:
因组织失误，Skewb 决赛中发现多个错误打乱。一名打乱员不熟悉 Skewb 记号，意外将部分魔方打乱错误。

分析视频后，WRC 认定错误打乱的数量对决赛产生了显著影响，同意将该项目由三轮改为两轮，理由是：

  1. 超过一半的尝试使用了错误打乱；
  2. 因组织错误而任意取消部分选手成绩、保留其他人成绩，处理不一致；
  3. 错误打乱与原定打乱明显不同。

原文接着称，此决定意味着追溯删除所有“第二次尝试”。因此，最终排名以前一轮成绩确定。
html.en:
A skewb final was found to have several misscrambles because of an organizational mistake. One scrambler was not familiar with skewb notation and accidentally scrambled wrongly some puzzles.

After analyzing the video evidence, the WRC has concluded the amount of misscrambles significantly affected the final. The WRC agreed to change the round format from three rounds to two rounds, because:

  1. More than half of the attempts were found to be misscrambled.
  2. It is not consistent to disqualify some competitors and not others arbitrarily for an organizational mistake.
  3. The misscrambles were found to be noticeably different from the original scrambles.

This decision involves retroactively removing all second attempts. Therefore, the classification was decided with the results from the previous round.

title.zh: 多盲某次尝试出现多个错误打乱
title.en: A Multi-Blind attempt was found to have several misscrambles

html.zh:
因组织失误，安排的多盲第二次尝试中发现多个重复打乱。代表暂将一些确定收到重复打乱的成绩改为 DNF。

WRC 同意将赛制从“两次取最佳”改为“一次取最佳”，理由是：

  1. 所有第二次尝试均被发现使用了重复打乱；
  2. 因组织错误而任意取消部分选手成绩、保留其他人成绩，处理不一致。

此决定意味着追溯删除全部第二次尝试成绩。
html.en:
A Multi-Blind scheduled second attempt was found to have several duplicate scrambles because of an organizational mistake. The WCA Delegate provisionally changed some certain results to DNF that were surely duplicate scrambles.

The WRC agreed to change the round format from "Best of 2" to "Best of 1", because:

  1. All second attempts were found to be duplicate scrambles.
  2. It is not consistent to disqualify some competitors and not others arbitrarily for an organizational mistake.

This decision involves retroactively removing all second attempts.

title.zh: 大屏显示成绩与成绩单记录不同
title.en: A tournament display showed a different result from the one recorded on the scorecard

html.zh:
比赛中发现，成绩单与比赛显示屏的成绩不同；此时选手和裁判均已签名。代表联系双方后判断，时间很可能记录错误。

A7b1 规定：

A7b1 若有处罚，裁判须记录计时器显示的原始时间及所有处罚。（……）

不过，WRC 同意将受影响成绩改为显示屏上的时间，两者仅小数部分不同，例如 XX.X6 改为 XX.X7。

一般而言，关于从比赛显示屏恢复成绩的事件按以下条件处理：

  1. 还原过程中相当一段时间能看见显示屏，且其似乎正常工作；
  2. 显示屏在可信的时间停止，即选手停表后略有延迟；
  3. 记录错误可以合理解释。例如准确时间为 10.507，裁判写成 10.57；但若显示屏停在 10.507，裁判写成 10.53，则更可能是显示屏出错，应采用成绩单记录。

请注意，这不是普遍适用的裁定。WRC 强烈建议直接从 Speed Stacks Stackmat 计时器记录成绩。比赛显示屏未获 WCA 规则认可，有时与计时器时间不一致。
html.en:
During the competitions, results on the scorecards were found to not match the results on the tournament displays. This was found after both the competitor and the judge signed the attempt. The WCA Delegate contacted with the competitor and the judge and concluded that the time was likely recorded incorrectly.

The Regulations A7b1) states that:

A7b1) If penalties are assigned, the judge records the original recorded time displayed on the timer, along with any penalties. (...)

However, the WRC agreed to change the affected attempt to the one that was shown in the tournament display and that only varies in decimal (e.g. XX.X6 to XX.X7).

Generally, incidents regarding recording results from the tournament display follow this policy:

  1. The display is visible during a good part of the solve and seems to be working fine.
  2. It stops at a believable time (when the competitor stops the timer, + a little delay).
  3. The scoretaking mistake is understandable (e.g. The exact time is 10.507 and the judge wrote 10.57. If the display stops at 10.507 and the judge writes 10.53, there is most likely a display error and the recorded time on the scorecard is used).

Please notice that this is not a general ruling and the WRC strongly recommends to write the result directly from the Speed Stacks Stackmat timer. Tournament Displays are not recognized in the WCA Regulations and sometimes, do not match the time of the Speed Stacks Stackmat timer.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 12 月
title.en: WDC Monthly Digest - December 2019

html.zh:

html.en:

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 最少步使用了不合适的房间
title.en: An inproper room was used for Fewest Moves Solving

html.zh:
组织团队用一间小房间容纳大量选手进行最少步，选手彼此距离很近。这可能使人通过看他人的答题纸作弊。

不过，WRC 决定接受成绩，理由是：

  1. 代表检查了解答纸，没有选手的解法相同；
  2. 代表在该轮仔细监督了选手；
  3. 没有证据表明任何选手利用此情况取得不公平优势。
html.en:
The Organization Team used a small room for Fewest Moves Solving for a large number of competitors. This caused competitors to be very close to each other. This could have been used by competitors to cheat and look off another competitor's paper.

However, the WRC has decided to accept the results because:

  1. The WCA Delegates checked the solution sheets and saw that no competitors had the same solution.
  2. The WCA Delegates carefully oversaw the competitors during the round.
  3. There is no evidence that any competitors abused the situation to gain an unfair advantage.

title.zh: 选手某次尝试未签名，且未晋级决赛
title.en: A competitor did not sign for an attempt and did not qualify for the finals

html.zh:
一名选手在第二轮某次尝试中未签名，且未晋级决赛；赛后才发现此事。这违反了 A7c4：

A7c4 裁判记录并签署成绩前，选手不应签名。选手最终有责任确保自己和裁判均已签名。如果裁判将成绩单交给录入员后（见 A7f）发现缺少一方或双方签名，该次尝试将被视为未完成（DNF）。

虽然指导 A7c4+允许在录入员发现漏签时由选手补签，但本案在赛后才发现，因此不适用。

WRC 同意将原尝试判为 DNF，并删除其决赛成绩。已有事件日志采用了类似理由。

更一般地，针对错误录入导致选手误晋级，WRC 决定：

  • 因他人成绩错误而晋级，保留其成绩；
  • 因自己成绩错误而晋级，删除其成绩。
html.en:
A competitor did not sign for an attempt in R2 and did not qualify for the final round. This was discovered after the competition. This violates Regulation A7c4:

A7c4) The competitor should not sign an attempt before the judge has recorded and signed the attempt. The competitor is ultimately responsible for ensuring that they and the judge have signed an attempt. If an attempt is found to be missing one or both signatures after the judge delivered the score sheet to the score taker (see Regulation A7f), it will be considered unfinished (DNF).

Although the Guideline A7c4+ allows a competitor to add a missing signature if it is found by the score taker. The missing signature was found after the competition and thus, the guideline does not apply here.

The WRC agreed that the original attempt should be a DNF and therefore the attempts from the finals should be removed. In addition, there is an existing Incident Log that followed a similar reasoning.

More generally, this is what WRC decided to apply when results were wrongly entered, and someone mistakenly proceeded to the next round:

  • Keep the results if the competitor proceeded thanks to an error in someone else's results
  • Remove the results if the competitor proceeded thanks to an error in their own results

title.zh: 盲拧中使用低头戴眼罩技巧
title.en: The "Nod-don" technique was used for Blindfolded Solving

html.zh:
三阶盲拧第二轮中，一名选手使用了低头戴上眼罩的 ‘nod-don’ 技巧。还原结束后，他立即告诉代表，自己认为第一步转动可能接近眼罩尚未完全戴好的时刻。代表在征询 WRC 意见前给予了暂定的额外尝试。这可能违反 B4a 和 B4b：

B4a 选手戴上眼罩，开始盲拧阶段。 B4b 眼罩完全戴好前，选手不得转动魔方，否则该次尝试 DNF。

视频证据不足以判断戴眼罩动作是否合规，因此 WRC 同意将暂定的额外尝试作为有效成绩。
html.en:
During 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, a competitor was using the nod-don technique. Immediately after the solve, he informed the WCA Delegates that he thought it might be a bit close to starting the first turn before the blindfold was fully donned. The WCA Delegates granted a provisional extra before asking the WRC for feedback. This might violate Regulations B4a) and B4b):

B4a) The competitor dons the blindfold to start the blindfolded phase.

B4b) The competitor must not apply moves to the puzzle before they have fully donned the blindfold. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).

Since the video evidence was not enough to know if the don is legit or not, the WRC agreed to accept the provisional extra as the valid result.

title.zh: 仅逐帧分析才能看出的手刀停表
title.en: A competitor stopped the timer with a "karate chop", only visible with video analysis

html.zh:
一名选手的停表方式看起来可能违反规则，即以“手刀”方式停表。这违反了 A6d：

A6d 选手须双手掌心朝下，平放于感应区停表。处罚为加 2 秒。

分析视频后，WRC 认定只有逐帧查看才能看出停表不当。因此，WRC 同意原成绩不应受罚。WRC 还提出了关于代表使用视频证据判断潜在处罚的新政策。

2024 年 9 月 27 日，WRC 更新了逐帧分析的处理方式，明确了其他使用情形。这不影响此前决定，更多信息见此处。
html.en:
A competitor stopped the timer in a way that looked like it potentially violated the regulations (ie, with a "karate chop"). This violates Regulation A6d):

A6d) The competitor must stop the timer using both hands, placed flat on the sensors with palms down. Penalty: time penalty (+2 seconds).

However, after analyzing the video evidence, the WRC has concluded that the bad timer stop is only visible if the video was analyzed frame-by-frame. Therefore, the WRC agrees that the original time should not be penalized. The WRC is also proposed a new policy for delegates using video evidence to apply potential penalites to solves.

The WRC updated their approach on frame-by-frame analysis on September 27th, 2024, clarifying other use cases. Whilst this does not affect this previous decision, more information can be found here.

title.zh: 选手称成绩单记录有误
title.en: A competitor claimed an incorrect result was written down on the score sheet

html.zh:
一名选手称某次成绩记录错误，请求更改。唯一可用的视频为直播录像，其中显示屏或计时器上的时间均无法清晰辨认。

最终接受成绩单原记录，因为裁判和选手均已签名，且没有可靠视频证据支持修改。
html.en:
A competitor claimed a attempt's result was incorrectly written and requested a result change. The only video evidence available was a live stream video, which did not show a readable time on the display or the timer.

The original time written on the score sheet was accepted, because the result was both signed by the judge and the competitor and there was no reliable video evidence to support the result change.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 11 月
