title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 10 月
title.en: WDC Monthly Digest - October 2019

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 10 月的重要动态。

10 月新开四项正式调查。一件很直接，数日内完成；另三件中的两件在 10 月底或 11 月初结案。

主要工作是遴选新成员，流程耗时，分以下阶段：

  1. 初评：分析申请文件；16 人全部进入下一阶段。
  2. 中期评估：填写 Google 表单，回答问题并模拟 WDC 常见情景，起草正式沟通并解释推理；16 人中 9 人晋级。
  3. 终评：与负责人面试，平均 30 分钟，讨论各类 WCA/WDC 话题；9 人中 6 人入选。

新成员为 Arthur Garcin（2014GARC27）、Christopher Morris（2013MORR03）、Chris Tabar（2017TABA02）、Jules Desjardin（2010DESJ01）、Martin Vædele Egdal（2013EGDA02）、Sebastiano Tronto（2011TRON02）。欢迎他们，也感谢所有申请人。遴选很有启发，最终抉择困难，说明整体水平很高。

同时还准备新成员入职：编写一些文件，确定内部沟通事项。我们考虑公开其中一份，以介绍委员会运作。

遴选期间，Anuj Menta 因个人原因决定卸任。公开感谢他过去两年的工作和贡献，祝未来顺利！

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of October 2019.

During October, four new official investigations were opened. One was very straightforward and took only a few days to be completed and two out of the other three were closed at the end of October/beginning of November.

The bulk of the activity during October was the selection process for the new WDC members. This took a while to complete, as the process followed the below steps.

1. Initial evaluation
- Conducted on the analysis of the candidacy documents;
- 16 out of 16 candidates proceeded to the next step;

2. Intermediate evaluation
- Candidates were asked to complete a Google form with questions and simulations of scenarios regularly faced by the WDC. Candidates were asked to draft official communication and to explain their reasoning;
- 9 out of 16 candidates proceeded to the next step;

3. Final evaluation
- The last step of the process was an interview with the WDC Leader. Calls lasted for 30 minutes on average, focusing on various WCA/WDC topics;
- 6 out of 9 candidates were selected to become WDC members.

The new WDC members are: Arthur Garcin (2014GARC27), Christopher Morris (2013MORR03), Chris Tabar (2017TABA02), Jules Desjardin (2010DESJ01), Martin Vædele Egdal (2013EGDA02) and Sebastiano Tronto (2011TRON02).
I would like to welcome them to the Committee and thank everyone who submitted a candidacy: the selection process was very stimulating and I had a hard time making the final choices, meaning that the overall quality of candidates was very high.

At the same time, some procedural work was carried out behind the scenes to prepare the onboarding of the new members: a few documents were prepared and some decisions were made about internal communication. We are considering sharing one of these documents, since it could give an interesting insight on how the Committee operates.

During the selection process, Anuj Menta decided to step down from his role in the WDC for personal reasons. I would like to publicly thank him for his work and contribution in the Committee over the past two years, as well as wishing him all the best for his future endeavors!

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 选手停表后立即明显触碰魔方
title.en: A competitor noticeably touched the puzzle immediately after stopping the timer

html.zh:
Skewb 项目中，一名选手在停表后立即触碰了魔方。松手后，魔方落到选手腿上，又弹回垫子。

这违反了 A6e：

A6e 松开魔方后，在裁判检查之前，选手不得触碰或移动魔方。处罚为该次尝试 DNF。例外：若未发生转动，裁判可酌情改判加 2 秒。

指导 A6e+ 明确指出，这种情况属于触碰：

A6e+ 澄清：停表后魔方掉到选手腿上，视为触碰魔方。

复核视频后，WRC 认为本案不能与另一事件相比，因为本案选手明显触碰了魔方。WRC 认定应对该次尝试给予 +2 秒处罚。
html.en:
In Skewb, a competitor touched the puzzle immediately after stopping the timer. When releasing the puzzle, it fell into the lap of the competitor and then it jumped back to the mat.

This violates Regulation A6e):

A6e) After releasing the puzzle, the competitor must not touch or move the puzzle until the judge has inspected the puzzle. Penalty: disqualification of the attempt (DNF). Exception: If no moves have been applied, a time penalty (+2 seconds) may be assigned instead, at the discretion of the judge.

In addition, Guideline A6e+) explicitly clarifies that this case is considered touching the puzzle:

A6e+) CLARIFICATION If the puzzle falls into the lap of the competitor after stopping the timer, this is considered touching the puzzle.

By reviewing video evidences, the WRC determined that this case is not comparable with this other as the competitor in this incident noticeably touched the puzzle. The WRC concluded that it is appropriate to apply a +2 penalty to the affected attempt.

title.zh: 选手在多盲中提交了错误数量的魔方
title.en: A competitor submitted a wrong number of puzzles for Multi-Blind

html.zh:
多盲中，一名选手提交魔方供打乱，却没有写明申报数量。打乱员将全部魔方打乱，并把数量写在成绩单上。选手来到比赛台后告诉裁判，希望尝试的数量少于提交数量。裁判本想按选手所述数量提供魔方，但数错了，给了提交的全部魔方。

代表允许选手尝试其口头声称的数量，而非原提交数量。由于工作人员计数失误，代表给予了一次暂定的额外尝试。

虽然选手后来报出了不同数量，但最初提交了全部魔方，且未在成绩单上作任何标记。这违反了 H1a：

H1a 尝试前，选手须向组织团队提交希望尝试的魔方数量，至少为 2 个。

H1a1 还明确规定不得更改数量：

H1a1 向组织团队提交数量后，选手不得更改魔方数量。

因此，WRC 决定以选手最初提交的数量作为该次尝试的魔方总数。
html.en:
During Multi-BLD, a competitor submitted his puzzles to be scrambled, without writing down a declared number of cubes. The scramblers scrambled all the puzzles and wrote down it on the scorecard. When the competitor came to solve, he told the judge that he wanted to attempt a number of cubes lower than the amount submitted. The judge intended to give the competitor the amount that he said he wanted to attempt, but miscounted and gave the competitor the full amount of cubes that were sumbitted.

The WCA Delegate allowed the competitor to attempt the amount that he had claimed, rather than the amount that he had submitted. Due to the staff's mistake in counting the attempt, the delegate gave a provisional extra.

Although the competitor said a different number later, he initially submitted all the puzzles and did not mark anything on the scoresheet. This violates Regulation H1a):

H1a) Before an attempt, the competitor must submit to the organization team the number of puzzles (at least 2) they wish to attempt.

In addition, Regulation H1a1) explicitly clarifies that changing the number of puzzles is not allowed:

H1a1) A competitor is not permitted to change the number of puzzles after submitting their number to the organization team.

Therefore, the WRC decision was to consider the total amount of cubes attempted as the original amount the competitor had submitted.

title.zh: A1c 和 2i1 适用于最少步
title.en: A1c and 2i1 apply in Fewest Moves Solving

html.zh:
说明：WRC 获悉此问题后，新增了规则 2k6，要求选手满足所参加全部项目的要求，例如知道如何还原相应魔方。

近期有人向 WRC 指出，按当时 WCA 规则的结构，A1c 或许不适用于最少步，因为第 E 章没有引用第 A 章。

然而，制定 A1c 的初衷之一，就是允许代表将其用于最少步。自其引入以来，WRC 一直支持这种预期用途。

规则将更新以体现这一点，并明确 2i1 所列允许使用的辅助用品也可用于最少步。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since this was brought to the WRC's attention, regulation 2k6 has been created, which makes it required for competitors to fullfill the requirements (e.g. knowing how to solve the puzzle) of all events they are competing in.

It was recently brought to the WRC's attention that Regulation A1c) arguably does not apply to Fewest Moves under the current structure of the WCA Regulations, because Article E does not refer to Article A.

However, one of the original motivations for Regulation A1c) was to allow Delegates to apply it to Fewest Moves, and the WRC has supported this intended use of A1c since its introduction.

The Regulations will be updated to reflect this, as well as clarifying that the allowed aids specified under Regulation 2i1) are also allowed in Fewest Moves Solving.

title.zh: 无贴纸魔方上的 PVC 涂层
title.en: PVC coating on a stickerless cube

html.zh:
一名选手使用了每个有色部件上都有“PVC 涂层”的无贴纸魔方，比赛现场允许使用。

此前曾允许贴有不透明黑色贴纸的类似魔方。WRC 认定，这些 PVC 涂层不会带来规则 3d和规则 3h意在防止的优势。

因此，WRC 决定允许此类魔方是合理的。WCA 规则将更新以明确这一点。
html.en:
A competitor used a stickerless cube with a "PVC coating" on each colored part. The puzzle was accepted at the competition.

Similar cubes with non-transparent (black) stickers have previously been allowed, and the WRC has concluded that the PVC coatings do not give the competitor an advantage that Regulation 3d) and Regulation 3h) are meant to prevent.

Therefore, the WRC has decided that it is reasonable for these puzzles to be permitted.

The WCA Regulations will be updated to clarify this.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 8 月和 9 月
title.en: WDC Monthly Digest - August & September 2019

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 8、9 月的重要动态。

目前积极处理 5 件案件；8 月下半月结案 4 件，9 月结案 5 件。2019 年调查及案件总数现为 45。

主要调查涉及 2017SHIR03 在 Udmurtia Open 2019 的三阶单手正式成绩。调查认定其在第一轮和决赛多次用还原手臂提前停表作弊，视频证实了证人举报。其被禁赛 2 年，该比赛全部三阶单手成绩被取消。

如上期预告，WDC 原定公布初夏影响乌克兰社群案件的报告。但近几个月，我们调查了比平常更多的利用裁判缺乏经验谋利案件：例如观察期间转动，以及故意不复位计时器，使成绩单记录更快时间。现场无人察觉，后来依视频解决；选手被禁赛，相关成绩取消。鉴于这一令人担忧的趋势，上述报告正在修订，改为说明哪些流程未正确执行，以及如何预防容易被利用的情况。

另一方面，我想公开感谢 JP Bulman 近两年来为 WDC 作出的出色贡献。JP 即将离任，我们正在寻找新成员。遴选进展良好，候选人水平很高，计划月底前确定“新”WDC。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或发现可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢大家支持 WCA 精神与使命。感谢 JP 的宝贵贡献，祝未来顺利！

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the months of August and September 2019.

The Committee is actively working on 5 cases. The WDC was also able to close 4 cases over the second half of August and 5 during September. The total number of investigations/cases in 2019 is now 45.

The main case the WDC was called to investigate during this time is the one concerning the official results in 3x3 One-Handed of 2017SHIR03 at Udmurtia Open 2019. The competitor has been found guilty of cheating in the event by prematurely stopping the timer with his solving arm during various attempts, both in the First and Final rounds. Video evidence was available and it confirmed what witnesses denounced. The competitor is banned from WCA Competitions for 2 years and all of the results achieved in 3x3 One-Handed at Udmurtia Open 2019 have been disqualified.

As anticipated in the last Monthly Digest, the WDC decided to publish the report for the case that affected the Ukrainian Community at the beginning of the summer. Over the last couple of months, though, the WDC has conducted more investigations than usual where we saw competitors exploiting the lack of experience of judges to gain a personal advantage: for example, a competitor was caught applying moves during inspection, while another one was caught not resetting the timer intentionally, which resulted in a faster result getting registered on the scorecards. These cases were resolved using video evidence, when nobody noticed anything during the competition. As a consequence of their actions, these competitors were banned from WCA Competitions and the affected results were disqualified. Because of this worrisome trend, the aforementioned report is currently under revision and it will be reshaped to show which WCA processes were not properly followed and how it’s possible to prevent easily exploitable situations during competitions.

Now, on a more pleasant note, I would like to use this space to publicly thank JP Bulman for his outstanding work for the WDC over the last (almost) 2 years. JP will shortly leave the Committee and we are currently working on finding new members. The selection process is going pretty well and I’m very pleased to see such a high level of candidates; the plan is to have the “new” WDC defined by the end of the month.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Thank you, JP, for your very valuable contribution and best of luck for your future!

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 选手使用不合规魔方完成多次尝试并拒绝额外尝试
title.en: A competitor did several attempts with an illegal puzzle without accepting the extra attempts

html.zh:
一名选手使用的魔方红面有一张贴纸，色调与其他贴纸明显不同，违反了 3d2：

3d2 有色部件必须为纯色，每个面的颜色须统一，各种颜色之间须清楚可辨。

选手使用该魔方完成了 4 次尝试，最后一次改用合规魔方。代表依据 3k2a 询问是否愿意用额外尝试替代前 4 次，选手拒绝。

该轮设有及格线，依据 11e2，选手在前两次后未达到及格线，因此 WRC 决定将成绩记为 DNS、DNS。由于其所有尝试均视为 DNS，选手被视为没有开始任何一次尝试，因此应删除其成绩。
html.en:
A competitor competed with a cube where one of the stickers on the red face was a distinguishable shade from the others. This violates Regulation 3d2):

3d2) The colors of the colored parts must be solid, with one uniform color per face. Each color must be clearly distinct from the other colors.

The competitor did 4 attempts with this cube, and then did the last attempt with a legal cube. When the WCA Delegate asked if the competitor wanted to replace the 4 solves with extras (using Regulation 3k2a), the competitor declined.

As the round had a cutoff, the competitor did not make the cutoff after his first two solves (as stated by 11e2), so the WRC has decided to record the results as DNS, DNS. Because all competitor's attempts are considered DNS, the competitor has not started any attempt. Therefore, the competitor's result should be removed.

title.zh: 选手获准提前参加三阶决赛并使用不同打乱
title.en: A competitor was allowed to compete early in the 3×3×3 final and with different scrambles

html.zh:
一名晋级三阶决赛的选手因需赶飞机，请求提前完成平均。由于比赛晚点，决赛将远晚于原定时间开始，WCA 代表同意了请求。五魔方第二组进行期间，该选手使用三阶单手决赛尚未使用的备用打乱完成了平均。

其他选手也因需离开而错过决赛，但代表直到决赛开始、这些人已经离开后才得知。由于有人缺席，代表邀请仍在场的前 20 名选手参赛。

指导 1h++ 建议决赛使用相同打乱：

1h++ 建议：某项目决赛的所有尝试，以及全部三阶最少步尝试，所有选手应使用相同打乱序列，即只有一组。

WRC 建议按上述指导在决赛使用相同打乱；若有提前参赛的机会，应告知所有可能需要提前离场的选手。WRC 也鼓励因正当理由需要提前离场的选手主动联系 WCA 代表。

由于 TNoodle 生成三阶与三阶单手打乱的方式相同，WRC 决定允许所有这些尝试成绩。
html.en:
A competitor who had made it to the 3×3×3 final asked that he do his average early, as the competitor had to leave for a flight. The WCA Delegates decided to accomodate his request as the competition wasn't running on time and the final was going to start well after it was scheduled to. While the second group of Megaminx was ongoing, the competitor did his average using the spare scrambles from 3×3×3 One Handed finals which had not been used.

Other competitors missed the final as they had to leave too, however the WCA Delegates weren't made aware of this until finals were underway and the competitors had already left. Due to absent competitors, the WCA Delegates asked anyone remaining in the top 20 to compete.

The Guideline 1h++) recommends to use the same scrambles for finals:

1h++) RECOMMENDATION All attempts in the final round of an event, as well as all 3x3x3 Fewest Moves attempts, should have the same scramble sequences for all competitors (i.e. only 1 group).

The WRC recommend to use the same scramble for finals (as cited before) and to warn all competitors that may need to leave the venue early if there is an opportunity to compete earlier. The WRC would also like to encourage competitors to reach out to the WCA Delegate in case they need to leave the venue early by justified causes.

As TNoodle generates 3×3×3 and 3×3×3 One Handed the same, the WRC decided to allow all these attempts.

title.zh: 招募 WDC 成员（2019 年 9 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WDC Members (September 2019)

html.zh:
**WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）**正在招募新成员协助履行使命！人人可申请，鼓励目前未在 WCA 任职的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

  • 就特殊个案向理事会提供意见，例如涉嫌违反 WCA 规则；
  • WCA 成员遇到有关比赛的重要个人事务时可联系 WDC。

更多工作信息见纪律日志。暂停资格及其他处分见动议 15.2019.1，正式权利和职责见动议 10.2019.2。

**期望素质与要求：**清白的背景、个人时间管理能力、讨论推理和想法的能力、熟悉 WCA 活动。

申请期为即日起至 2019 年 9 月 23 日 23:59 UTC，请发送至 Lorenzo Vigani Poli（lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请文件必须为 PDF，应包含简短自我介绍、在魔方社群中所做活动、加入 WDC 的动机。非 PDF 文件将自动弃置。

申请人会收到收件确认，之后可能获邀面试。有疑问可联系 Lorenzo Vigani Poli。申请期后由 WDC 负责人遴选，在申请人接受职位后公布新成员。

感谢愿意协助 WDC 和 WCA！
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

What does the WDC do?
- Advises the WCA Board in special cases, like alleged violations of WCA Regulations
- May be contacted by WCA members in case of important personal matters regarding WCA competitions.

If you want to get more insight about the work of the Committee, you can check the Disciplinary Log on the WCA website. Suspensions and other Sanctions are defined in Motion 15.2019.1. The official rights and duties of the WDC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2019.2.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:
- Clear background
- Personal time management skills
- Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
- Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until September 23rd, 2019, 23:59 UTC to Lorenzo Vigani Poli (lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org).

The application document must be in PDF format, and should include the following:
- A brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done within the cubing community
- Motivation for applying to join the WDC

Application documents not in PDF format will be automatically discarded.

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Lorenzo Vigani Poli (lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WDC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WDC, and the WCA!

title.zh: 金字塔还原被认定使用了错误打乱
title.en: Pyraminx attempt was identified as misscramble

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，规则 11i 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但现在规则已明确规定处理方式。

一名选手在金字塔决赛打破阿尔及利亚国家纪录。WDC 发现魔方打乱错误，且错误打乱明显比正式打乱简单。现场给予了暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 决定用额外尝试替代原尝试。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations.

A competitor broke the Algerian National Record in the final round of Pyraminx. The WDC found out that the puzzle was not scrambled correctly and the misscrable was clearly easier than the official scramble. The competitor was granted a provisional extra attempt at the competition.

The WRC decided to replace the original attempt with the extra attempt.

title.zh: 选手交给代表前拍摄了最少步解答纸
title.en: A competitor took a photo of his Fewest Moves solution sheet before giving it to the Delegate

html.zh:
一名选手在将最少步解答纸交给代表前，短暂使用手机拍照。虽然选手没有试图以此作弊，但这明确违反了规则 2i。

2i 比赛时，选手不得使用 Stackmat 计时器或秒表以外的电子或音频设备，例如手机、MP3 播放器、录音机和额外照明。

因此，WRC 决定将该次尝试改为 DNF。
html.en:
A competitor briefly used his phone to take a photo of his Fewest Moves solution sheet just before giving it to the Delegate. Although the competitor didn't try to use it for cheating; it's a clear violation of regulation 2i).

2i) While competing, competitors must not use electronics or audio equipment (e.g. cell phones, MP3 players, dictaphones, additional lighting) apart from the Stackmat timer or stopwatch.

Therefore the WRC decision is to change the affected attempt into DNF.

title.zh: 选手还原结束后才发现拿到了他人的 Skewb
title.en: A competitor received another competitor's skewb and did not notice until the solve was done

html.zh:
由于两名选手姓名相似，一名选手收到了另一人的成绩单和 Skewb。还原结束后，选手发现成绩单姓名与自己不符，才意识到问题。现场给予了额外尝试。

WRC 决定用额外尝试替代原尝试。
html.en:
A competitor was given the scoresheet and skewb of another competitor's due to the competitors having similar names. The competitor did not notice until after the solve was done, as the name on the scorecard did not match the competitor's. This competitor was given an Extra.

The WRC decided to replace the original attempt with the extra attempt.

title.zh: 两名选手试图协助调查重复打乱
title.en: Two competitors attempted to help investigate a duplicate scramble situation

html.zh:
四阶盲拧中，一名选手称收到了重复打乱。另两名选手来到比赛台查看打乱，但这本应仅由代表进行。他们因此看到了自己尚未收到的打乱。

选手不得试图获取未来打乱的信息，但在本案中，显然他们是因想帮忙而犯错，并非试图通过查看打乱作弊。

WRC 决定维持代表的处理，为这两名选手生成额外打乱。
html.en:
During 4x4 Blindfolded, a competitor claimed that a duplicate scramble is given. Two other competitors went to check the scramble at the solving station, which is something only the Delegate should do. The other two competitors saw the scramble, which they hadn't received yet.

Although competitors must not attempt to gain information about future scrambles, it was clear in this situation that the competitors made a mistake in trying to be helpful, and were not attempting to cheat by trying to check the scramble.

The WRC decided to uphold the Delegate's decision, which was to generate extra scrambles for these competitors.

title.zh: 选手在多盲中使用耳机
title.en: A competitor used headphones for Multi-Blind

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，WRC 重新考虑了对收到代表错误指示的选手的处罚立场。较新的事件体现了对此类情况更宽缓的处理。

由于沟通失误，WCA 代表允许一名选手在前两次多盲中使用未连接的耳机，而非耳塞或隔音耳罩。

这违反了规则 2i：

2i 比赛时，选手不得使用 Stackmat 计时器或秒表以外的电子或音频设备，例如手机、MP3 播放器、录音机和额外照明。

指导 2i1b+ 还明确指出，关闭的设备也不允许：

2i1b+ 澄清：这也包括已关闭或断开连接的相关设备。

此外，2t 要求选手熟悉规则。因此，WRC 决定将受影响的尝试改为 DNF。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since resolution of this incident, the WRC has reconsidered it's stance on penalties given to competitors who received wrong information from a delegate. This more recent incident takes into account that more lenient stance in situations like this.

Due to a miscommunication, a WCA Delegate allowed a competitor to use unplugged headphones for his first two Multi-BLD attempts instead of earplugs/earmuffs.

This violates Regulation 2i):

2i) While competing, competitors must not use electronics or audio equipment (e.g. cell phones, MP3 players, dictaphones, additional lighting) apart from the Stackmat timer or stopwatch.

In addition, Guideline 2i1b+) explicitly clarifies that switched off devices are not allowed:

2i1b+) CLARIFICATION This includes relevant devices which are switched off or disconnected.

In addition, Regulation 2t) requieres the competitor to be familiar with the Regulations. Therefore the WRC decision is to change the affected attempts into DNF.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 7 月
title.en: WDC Monthly Digest - July 2019

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 7 月的重要动态。

目前积极处理 9 件案件。7 月底至 8 月初也完成了一些案件，包括六月初 Ukrainian Open 2019 期间对乌克兰及国际社群影响重大的案件。调查报告将随下期简报公布；结果已可在官网看到，因此先作简述。

WDC 最终决定，因无法确认成绩合法性，取消 2017LENY01 在 WCA 比赛取得的全部正式成绩，并给予附条件禁赛：在其开始配合 WDC、澄清作弊情况前，不得参加任何 WCA 正式活动。WDC 给了两个月说明事件、回答问题，但其未作答。

视频是启动调查的关键，调查也高度依赖乌克兰社群成员及当地 WCA 官员证词。这些因素使 WDC 认定：视频中用前臂动作在还原中提前停表的情况并非偶发，而是其练习形成的习惯。感谢参与调查、支持 WCA 精神与使命的所有人。

另一个值得公开讨论的案件涉及前理事会成员 Olivér Perge。他近期主动联系 WDC，承认 2007 年、正式参与 WCA 工作前的一次作弊。WDC 请他直接向社群说明，以下为来信：

亲爱的 WCA 社群：

我想承认，在 Swedish Cube Day 2007 的多盲中作弊。我从眼罩下偷看，每还原一个就检查一个。这是一次性事件，我立即后悔，至今仍非常难受。当时刚开始竞技速拧，太害怕坦白，后来又不想让这一错误损害自己的正式职位。但现在我认为应站出来，尽管已过去近十年。我深感抱歉，希望能够挽回，却无法做到。诚实与诚信是 WCA 的核心价值，希望我的教训至少能作为一个例子。

谨致问候， Olivér Perge

WDC 感谢其诚实坦白。相关尝试当然已被取消，匈牙利多盲国家纪录历史也因此改变。虽时隔很久，坦白仍重要，因为终于纠正了事情。人会犯错，重要的是承认并学习。

约在内部讨论此案的同时，另一名选手在 Facebook 公开类似坦白：2017HEIS02 承认一年多前的金字塔正式单次成绩来自重复打乱。WDC 联系并感谢其诚实，如许多人已公开表达的那样，并告知无需进一步措施。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of July 2019.

The Committee is actively working on 9 cases. The WDC was also able to close a few cases between the end of July and the beginning of August. One of these cases is the one that greatly affected the Ukrainian and international community at the beginning of June, during Ukrainian Open 2019. The report of this investigation will be published with the next WDC Monthly Digest. In the meantime, since the result of the investigation can be seen on the WCA website, a quick overview of the case is necessary.

The final decision of the WDC was to disqualify all of the official results obtained by 2017LENY01 in WCA competitions because of the impossibility to determine the legitimacy of these results. The WDC also administered a conditional ban to the competitor, which means that 2017LENY01 will not be allowed to participate in any WCA official event until he starts cooperating with the WDC to clarify the circumstances of his cheating. 2017LENY01 was given two months to offer his version of the events and to reply to the question of the WDC, but he has failed to do so.
Video evidence was key in opening the investigation, which greatly relied on the testimony of different members of the Ukrainian community and local WCA officials. These factors helped the WDC reach the conclusion about the circumstances that can be seen in the video evidence, specifically 2017LENY01 stopping the timer early with a movement of his forearms during the solve, were not isolated instances but a practiced habit for the competitor.

The WDC would like to thank all the people involved in the investigation for their help and efforts in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Another case that deserves public discussion involves former WCA Board member Olivér Perge. Olivér recently contacted the WDC to confess an episode of cheating that happened in 2007, before Olivér’s official involvement with the WCA. The WDC asked Olivér to directly address the Community and explain his actions. This is the letter he wrote:

Dear WCA Community,

I would like to admit that I cheated at multi blind during the Swedish Cube Day 2007 competition. I peeked under the blindfold and checked the cubes after I solved them one by one. This was a one time incident, I regretted it immediately and I still feel horrible about it to this day. I was just starting competitive speedcubing and was too scared to come clean back then, and later on I didn't want my official positions to be damaged by this mistake, but I felt important now to come forward, even though it was almost a decade ago. I am deeply sorry and wish I could undo it somehow, but I cannot. Honesty and integrity are key values within the WCA, and I just hope that my lesson can serve as an example at least.

Kind Regards,
Olivér Perge

The WDC would like to thank Olivér for his honesty in confessing. The affected attempt was of course disqualified, changing the history of Hungarian multi-blind National Records.

Even though a lot of time has passed, Olivér’s confession is important, since it finally makes things right. Mistakes can happen, but it’s important to recognize and learn from them.
Around the same time when the WDC was discussing Olivér’s case internally, a similar confession was published on Facebook by another competitor. 2017HEIS02 confessed that his official single in Pyraminx was achieved on a duplicate scramble, more than a year ago. The WDC contacted the competitor and thanked him for his honesty, as many others had already done publicly, communicating that no further action by the Committee was deemed necessary.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 错误的 Square-1 打乱呈正方体形状
title.en: Incorrect Square-1 scramble (cube shape)

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，规则 11i 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但现在规则已明确规定处理方式。

至少一名选手收到了呈正方体形状的错误 Square-1 打乱。分析显示，与该次尝试任何可能的规定打乱相比，这给选手带来了明显优势。

WRC 认定，此类尝试应取消资格，理由是：

  1. 与需要多步才能回到正方体形状的打乱相比，直接以正方体形状开始，几乎对所有选手都具有显著优势。
  2. 这严重破坏了打乱核验责任。合格的打乱员不会意外发出此类打乱，因为正方体形状打乱极其罕见，而且核对打乱图便能明显看出错误。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations.

At least one competitor received an incorrect Square-1 scramble which started with a "cube shape". Analysis shows that this provided the competitor a clear advantage for the attempt compared to any possible scramble for the attempt.

The WRC has concluded that such attempts should be disqualified, since:

  1. Starting with cube shape provides a significant advantage for virtually all competitors (vs. receiving a scramble several moves away from cube shape).
  2. This is a significant breach of scramble accountability. A qualified scrambler would never send out such a scramble by accident, since cube shape scrambles are conspicuously uncommon and a check against the scramble image would have clearly shown that the scramble was incorrect.

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 2 月的重要动态。

本月积极处理 8 项调查：4 件始于 2018 年 12 月，2 件始于 1 月，2 件始于 2 月。其中 7 件结案，2018 年立案的所有案件现已结案。

已结调查公开通报

  • 两项调查由现任或前任 WCA 工作人员行为引起。两案当事人均充分配合，迅速得出结论，结果积极，WDC 未采取纪律措施。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of February 2019.

In the second month of 2019, the WDC has actively worked on 8 investigations: 4 were opened in December 2018, 2 in January and 2 in February 2019. 7 of these cases were closed. The WDC has now closed all the cases that were opened in 2018.

Public announcements about closed investigations

  • Two investigations were opened as consequence of the actions of WCA Staff or former Staff. In both cases, the person under investigation fully cooperated with the WDC and a conclusion of the case was reached in short time, with positive outcome. No disciplinary action was taken by the WDC.

  • Blindsolving had been the topic of 3 investigations. In the first case, a young and inexperienced competitor was caught, during the competition, solving with a sighting method (CFOP). The competitor was confronted by the Delegate at the competition and it was determined that the competitor is not able to solve the cube blindfolded. The WDC confirmed the validity of the analysis of the Delegate and officially warned the competitor. In the second case, an experienced competitor was caught, during the competition, trying to peek under the blindfold in 5x5x5 blindfolded. The judge noticed that the competitor had donned the blindfold wrongly and it did not fully cover the competitor’s face. The competitor misplaced the harmonica holder as well and was caught by the judge and the Delegate trying to look at the cube whilst solving. When a paper was correctly placed, the competitor stopped his solution abruptly and then DNFed the attempt. The WDC confirmed the Delegate’s evaluation of this issue and decided to ban the competitor for 6 months from WCA competitions. In the third case, a competitor was caught cheating during 3x3 blindfolded at two different competitions. During the thorough investigation, the competitor confessed and admitted they are not able to solve the cube blindfolded at this time. The WDC decided to ban the competitor for 9 months from WCA competitions.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

title.zh: 比赛未使用合适的魔方遮盖物
title.en: Competition did not use proper covers for puzzles

html.zh:
由于沟通失误，Cavite Open 2 2018 未备有魔方罩，主办方决定改用信纸尺寸的纸张和成绩单。

视频证实，尝试开始前，选手和观众可以看见魔方的很大一部分。这违反了 A2c1：

A2c1 打乱员须用遮盖物盖住打乱后的魔方，使任何选手或观众都看不到魔方任何部分。遮盖物须保留至尝试开始。

指导 A2c1+ 还明确说明，纸张或成绩单不能作为替代品：

A2c1+ 提醒：过去曾用成绩单遮盖魔方，但仍暴露部分侧面。这种做法现已禁止。

虽然没有证据表明任何人明确意图作弊，但此事严重破坏了打乱保密性。根据动议 04.2019.1 第 2.8 节及规则 8f，Cavite Open 2 2018 的全部成绩已被删除。
html.en:
Due to a miscommunication, Cavite Open 2 2018 did not have puzzle covers on hand. The organizers decided to use letter-sized paper and score sheets instead.

Video evidence confirms that significant portions of puzzles were visible to competitors and spectators before attempts. This violates Regulation A2c1:

A2c1) The scrambler places a cover over the scrambled puzzle that makes it impossible for any competitors or spectators to see any part of the puzzle. The cover remains over the puzzle until the start of the attempt.

In addition, Guideline A2c1+) explicitly clarifies that paper or score sheets are not an acceptable substitute:

A2c1+) REMINDER In the past, score sheets have been used to cover puzzles while leaving some sides exposed. This is no longer permitted.

Although there is no evidence anyone specifically intended to cheat, this is a serious violation of scramble secrecy. Per Motion 04.2019.1 2.8 and Regulation 8f, all results from Cavite Open 2 2018 have been removed.

title.zh: 裁判忘记放置遮挡板（无额外尝试）
title.en: A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle (extra not available)

html.zh:
裁判忘记在选手脸部与魔方之间放置遮挡板。比赛结束后才发现问题，没有给予额外尝试。

WRC 决定接受该成绩，因为视频没有显示选手利用这一情况的迹象，且错误并非由选手造成。
html.en:
A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle. This was found after the end of the competition and no extra was granted.

The WRC decided to accept the result as the video showed no sign of the competitor abusing the situation and it was not his fault.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 1 月
title.en: WDC Monthly Digest - January 2019

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

自 2019 年 1 月起，WDC 将每月公开工作概览，帮助社群更了解委员会。我们的工作大多在幕后，基于保密，容易引发虚假传闻和混乱。因此，希望建立常规沟通，避免误解和不实信息，并介绍工作。

本月积极处理 11 项调查：3 件于 1 月立案，8 件由 2018 年延续；其中 5 件结案。

已结调查公开通报

  1. WDC 近期完成一名不具名未成年选手在不同盲拧项目中试图谋取优势的调查。视频显示，比赛中该选手使用依赖视力的方法还原，原因是裁判忘记在选手与魔方之间放置遮挡板。WDC 与其长时间讨论，尤其询问盲拧时所用方法。最终未获得证明其实际盲拧能力的证据，关于“创新”方法的问题仍无回答。因此给予六个月禁赛，将全部受影响成绩改为 DNF。
  2. 两名未成年选手因采取行动试图互相帮助取得更好成绩，各被禁赛六个月。一人担任另一人裁判，在显示屏关闭时记录不真实时间；另一人在前者执裁时观察中转动。两人互相掩护违规，分别在不同项目取得国家纪录。现场代表询问时，两人无法复盘并重现声称达到的时间，也无法可靠地回答 WDC 问题，以推翻代表及证人的证词。
  3. WDC 完成对 2016DERO04不同盲拧项目成绩的第二次调查，第二次认定其作弊，禁赛总期限增至 2 年。

调查细节见公开报告。

我们不计划经常公开报告，但 2018 年末首次调查结束后争议很大，因此认为这是展示委员会正式调查方式的机会，也希望防止 2018 年 12 月已出现过的不实信息传播。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Starting from January 2019, the WDC will issue a public overview of its activities every month, in order to give a better perception of the work of the Committee to the Community.
We realize that our work is mostly behind the scenes and that it’s based on confidentiality, which is something that can easily lead to the spreading of false rumors and confusion. The WDC would like to establish a routine in its communication towards the WCA Community, to avoid misunderstanding and disinformation and to provide some insight about its activities.

First, a bit of data. In the first month of 2019, the WDC has actively worked on 11 investigations: 3 were opened in January and 8 were still ongoing from 2018. 5 of these cases were closed.

Public announcements about closed investigations

  1. The WDC has recently concluded an investigation regarding an underage competitor, who shall remain nameless, because of their attempt to gain a personal advantage in different blindfolded events. A video provided to the WDC shows the competitor using a sight based method to solve their cubes during one of these events at a WCA Competition. This was possible because the judge of this attempt had forgot to administer a blocker between the competitor and their cube. The WDC discussed at length the case with the accused competitor, especially focusing on the method used to solve the cube whilst blindfolded by them. In the end, no proof has been provided to the WDC about the actual ability of the competitor with regards to solving the cube blindfolded. All the questions about their “innovative” method remain unanswered. The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to the competitor and to DNF all of the affected results.

  2. The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to two underage competitors because of their actions taken in an attempt to help each other get better results. One of the competitors was found to be judging the other and record illegitimate times while the display was off, while the other competitor was found performing moves during inspection, while the first competitor was judging him. Both of them went on to make National Records in two different events, because of their cooperation in cover each others violations of the WCA Regulations. They were both questioned by the Delegate at the competition and were unable to reconstruct their solves and obtaining on these reconstructions the same times as they just allegedly had. They were also not able to answer to the WDC’s questions in a way that could reliably contradict the testimonies of the Delegate of the competition and of the witnesses that contacted the Disciplinary Committee.

  3. The WDC has also concluded its second investigation about 2016DERO04 and his results in different Blindsolving events. The competitor has been found guilty of cheating for the second time by the Committee. Consequently, the length of the ban has been increased to a total of 2 years.

The details of this investigation, contained in this report, are shared with the Community.

We don’t plan on publicly sharing reports on a regular basis, but great controversy arose at the end of 2018, after the conclusion of the first investigation. Therefore, the WDC thinks that this can be the right chance of showing how the Committee operates and acts during official investigations. Obviously, we also want to prevent the spreading of false information, which is something that already happened during the month of December 2018.

Finally, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 选手两次启动计时器
title.en: A competitor started his timer twice

html.zh:
观察结束后，一名选手启动计时器，随后复位，又再次启动；此时尚未转动魔方。规则 A4d 规定，双手离开计时器并启动计时即开始还原；第一次启动时这一步已经发生。因此，选手在魔方尚未还原时复位计时器，成绩应为 DNF。

对于 China Championship 2017 的这起事件，WRC 也考虑了计时器指示灯被胶带遮住的情况。不过，由于这是选手在同一计时器上的第五次还原，WRC 决定将成绩改为 DNF。
html.en:
After their inspection, a competitor started their timer, then reset it, then started it again before making any move. Regulation A4d states that the competitor starts the solve by removing their hands from the timer (thus starting the timer), which happened during the first time they started the timer. Therefore the competitor reset the timer before the puzzle was solved and the result should be DNF.

For the case which occurred during China Championship 2017, the WRC also considered that the timer lights were covered by tape. However since it was the competitor's fifth solve on the exact same timer, the WRC decided to change the result to DNF.

title.zh: WDC 公告：盲拧事件
title.en: WDC Announcement: Blindsolving Incidents

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

WCA 纪律委员会面对越来越多调查，涉及选手在盲拧中通过作弊或试图作弊谋取个人优势。

我们对此担忧，尤其是选手常在比赛现场未被发现，不合规成绩被 WCA 接受后，WDC 才不得不开展困难的调查。

WDC 决定对一名保持匿名的选手禁赛六个月，因为其试图取得个人优势。调查发现，其在三阶盲拧中故意从眼罩下偷看，用明拧方法完成还原。这直接违反规则，也违背 WCA 使命和精神，比赛中不允许这种行为。若看到此类行为，请立即报告比赛代表。

WDC 还决定追溯将另一名选手的特定成绩改为 DNF，该人在不明情况下取得异常优异成绩。由于其不配合调查，表现极度防御且可疑，未提供任何证据或可接受解释，WDC 认为这些成绩不可能在遵守规则的情况下取得。因此禁止其参加任何 WCA 比赛一年。WDC 进行了全面调查，参考顶尖选手意见，并与多名证人合作。不过，该禁赛附有条件：如果选手愿意配合并提供所请求证据，我们愿意重启调查。

谢谢， WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) has been facing a rise in the number of investigations concerning competitors trying to achieve a personal advantage by cheating (or attempting to cheat) during blindfolded events.

We are concerned about this phenomenon, especially because competitors often have been able to get away with it during competitions. The WDC had to step in and conduct difficult investigations after illegal results had been accepted by the WCA.

The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to a competitor, who shall remain anonymous, because of their actions taken in an attempt to gain a personal advantage. The competitor was found to be intentionally cheating while competing in 3x3x3 Blindfolded by looking under their blindfold and using a sight-solving method to finish the cube. We would like to remind everyone that this kind of behavior is not allowed at WCA Competitions because it is in direct violation of the Regulations and contravenes both the Mission and Spirit of the WCA. If you or anyone else sees this kind of activity happening, please report it to the WCA Delegate of the competition immediately.

The WDC has also decided to retroactively DNF specific results of another competitor, who obtained exceptionally good results under unclear circumstances. Since the competitor in question failed to cooperate with the WCA Disciplinary Committee during the investigation, acted in an extremely defensive and suspicious way, and failed to present any sort of evidence or acceptable explanation, the WDC deemed impossible for these results to have been achieved in compliance with the WCA Regulations. The competitor has consequently been banned from any WCA Competition for one year. The WDC conducted a thorough investigation in this case, considering the opinion of top level speedcubers and cooperating with multiple witnesses. The ban is conditional, though, since we are willing to reopen the investigation if the competitor decides to cooperate and provides the evidence that we requested.

Thank you,
WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.4 及更早版本中的 Skewb 打乱截断问题
title.en: Truncated Skewb scrambles in versions of TNoodle version 0.13.4 and earlier

html.zh:
TNoodle 0.13.4 及更早版本的一个漏洞，导致正式比赛的 86 个 Skewb 打乱意外被截断，生成方式不符合规则 4b3。其中 73 个用于 CubingUSA Nationals 2018。WRC 决定保留这些成绩。

TNoodle 0.13.5 公告说明：

根据 WCA 规则，Skewb 正式打乱必须从至少需要 7 步才能还原的状态（4b3c）中产生随机状态（4b3）。

为使打乱表上的短解打乱难以被辨认，TNoodle 将所有生成的 Skewb 打乱序列设为至少 11 步，即使存在更短的解。然而，0.13.5 之前的线程安全漏洞可能使打乱序列被截断：

  • 截断后的序列只要仍至少需要 7 步还原，就会被使用，因此仍符合 4b3c；
  • 但截断没有保留随机打乱分布，违反了 4b3。

详情见 TNoodle 的 GitHub 项目。

对历史打乱解长的分析提示，过去绝大多数比赛的状态分布可能未受影响。但至少有一场大型比赛 CubingUSA Nationals 2018 的状态明显偏向较短最优解，因此发现了此漏洞。感谢 Sébastien Auroux 提醒我们注意该问题，也感谢 Tim Reynolds 与 Jeremy Fleischman 在过去的周末共同定位并准备 TNoodle 修复。

我们还确认，其他魔方的打乱未受类似漏洞影响。

受影响打乱的完整列表见此处。CubingUSA Nationals 2018 的 Skewb 打乱最优解长度分布如下：

最优解长度预期打乱数实际打乱数
7 步≈2051
8 步≈7884
9 步≈9361
10 步≈50
11 步≈00

我们认为，该比赛尝试次数很多，使生成 CubingUSA Nationals 2018 打乱所用电脑更容易出现触发漏洞的条件。

尽管打乱分布所受影响可以测量，WRC 决定保留这 86 个截断打乱对应的全部 Skewb 成绩，理由如下：

  1. 我们不认为此前有人知道这个漏洞，也不认为主办方、代表或选手曾故意利用它。该漏洞由 WRC 和 WST 负责。
  2. 代表正确遵守了规则，使用当时官方版本 TNoodle 的输出，且按规则 4b1要求，没有提前检查或分析打乱。
  3. 所有这些打乱的最优解仍至少需要 7 步。
  4. 受影响程度尚未使选手相对于未来的 Skewb 选手获得明显不公平的优势。

对于未来事件，请注意：如果打乱不符合规则，是因为并非来自当时现行的官方打乱程序，相关尝试仍应删除，例如意外使用旧版 TNoodle 的事件。
html.en:
A bug in TNoodle 0.13.4 and earlier resulted in 86 Skewb scrambles for official competitions that were accidentally truncated. As a result, they were not generated in a way that satisfies the requirements in Regulation 4b3. Of these scrambles, 73 were for CubingUSA Nationals 2018. The WRC has decided to keep these results.

As described in the TNoodle 0.13.5 announcement:

Per the WCA Regulations, an official scramble sequence for Skewb must produce a random state (4b3) from those that require at least 7 moves (4b3c) to solve.

In order to make it hard to distinguish scrambles with short solutions on a scramble sheet, TNoodle was designed to ensure that all generated Skewb scramble sequences are at least 11 moves (even if there is an optional solution with fewer moves). However, a thread safety bug in TNoodle before version 0.13.5 made it possible for scramble sequences to be truncated, such that:

  • a truncated scramble sequence would be used if it required at least 7 moves to solve (still satisfying Regulation 4b3c), but
  • the truncation did not preserve the random scramble distribution (violating Regulation 4b3).

More details are available at the TNoodle project on GitHub.

An analysis of solution lengths for historical scrambles suggests that this did not affect the distribution of states for the vast majority of past competitions. However, it did result in a significant bias of states towards shorter optimal solutions for at least one major competition (CubingUSA Nationals 2018), which led to the discovery of this bug. We would like to thank Sébastien Auroux for bringing it to our attention, and Tim Reynolds for working with Jeremy Fleischman to identify and prepare a fix for TNoodle over the past weekend.

We have also verified that scrambles for other puzzles were not affected by a bug like this.

A full list of affected scrambles is available here. In particular, the distribution of optimal solution length for Skewb scrambles at CubingUSA Nationals 2018 was as follows:

Optimal Solution LengthExpected # of scramblesActual # of scrambles
7 moves≈2051
8 moves≈7884
9 moves≈9361
10 moves≈50
11 moves≈00

We believe that the large number of attempts for the competition caused conditions for the bug to happen with higher likelihood on the computer that was used to generate scramble sequences for CubingUSA Nationals 2018.

Although the impact on the scramble distribution is measurable, the WRC has decided to keep all Skewb results from the 86 truncated scrambles because:

  1. We do not believe that this bug was known to anyone, or purposely used by any organizers, Delegates, or competitors. This bug is the responsibility of the WRC and the WST.
  2. Delegates properly followed the Regulations by using the output of a current official version TNoodle without inspecting or analyzing the scrambles ahead of time, as required by Regulation 4b1.
  3. The scrambles all still required at least of 7 moves for an optimal solution.
  4. The affected results are not affected to the extent that the competitors received a clearly unfair advantage against future Skewb competitors.

For future incidents, please note that attempts should still be removed if their scramble sequences do not follow the Regulations because they did not come from a current official scramble program, as in the case of an incident where an old version of TNoodle was used by accident.

title.zh: 使用旧版 TNoodle 生成金字塔打乱
title.en: Old version of TNoodle used for Pyraminx scrambles

html.zh:
为容纳更多选手组，代表重新生成金字塔第一轮打乱时，意外使用了三年前的 TNoodle 0.9.0。该版本生成的金字塔打乱分布与当时现行版本 0.13.3 不同。虽无法确定本案中是否对选手产生了显著影响，但对于此类事件，没有通用方法判断选手是否获得了优势。因此，WRC 决定不作例外地适用规则 4f，使 YJ Fest 2018 金字塔第一轮受影响选手的成绩无效。

注：TNoodle 可联系 WCA 网站检测自身是否过时，但电脑未联网时无法检测，而比赛中这种情况很常见。提醒负责生成打乱的人员务必确认手头使用的是最新版 TNoodle。

我们知道这一决定严厉，影响了许多选手。然而，WCA 比赛打乱的完整性至关重要，WCA 的使命也要求我们努力提供公平、平等的条件。
html.en:
While re-generating scrambles for the 1st round of Pyraminx to accommodate a larger number of competitor groups, the Delegate accidentally used a version of TNoodle from 3 years ago (0.9.0). This version of TNoodle generates a different distribution of Pyraminx scrambles from the current version (0.13.3). Although it is unclear if this could have had a significant impact on competitors in this particular case, there is no general way to decide whether competitors may have received an advantage in an incident like this. As a result, the WRC has decided that Regulation 4f applies to this incident without exception, invalidating results from affected people in the first round of Pyraminx from YJ Fest 2018.

Note: TNoodle contains a mechanism to contact the WCA website and detect if it is out of date, but this mechanism cannot detect if it is out of date when the computer is not connected to the internet (which is common at competitions). Individuals generating scrambles are reminded to take care and make sure they have the latest version of TNoodle on hand.

We know that this is a harsh decision that affects a significant number of competitors. However, the integrity of scrambles in WCA competitions is essential and the mission of the WCA states that we must strive for fair and equal conditions.

title.zh: 选手在多盲记忆阶段转动了魔方
title.en: Competitor made a move in the memorization phase of Multi Blind

html.zh:
多盲尝试中，一名选手在记忆阶段意外转动了其中一个魔方。

B3c 禁止在记忆阶段转动魔方，处罚为取消该次尝试资格；第 F 章的其他规则并未取代此规定，因此整次尝试本应被取消资格。

不过，WRC 认为只将该魔方计为未还原、允许选手继续完成其余部分更为公平。
html.en:
During their Multi Blind attempt, a competitor accidentaly made a move on one of their cubes during the memorization phase.

Rule B3c) forbids to apply moves during the memorization (penalty : disqualification of the attempt), and is not superseded by other rules in the F article, so the whole attempt should be disqualified.

However, the WRC found more fair to consider only that cube as unsolved, and let the competitor continue the rest of the attempt.

title.zh: 打乱员在魔表打乱中犯了相同错误
title.en: Scramblers made a consistent mistake in clock scrambling

html.zh:
在魔表决赛中，一名选手复盘时发现，每个拨针的状态都与应有状态相反。

调查发现，所有打乱员都误解了拨针打乱方式，整轮持续犯了同样的错误。

WRC 决定保留该轮成绩，理由是：

  1. 错误并非由选手造成；
  2. 在这一特定情况下，该错误始终保留了打乱状态的随机分布。

数据库中的打乱已更新，以反映选手实际收到的打乱。
html.en:
In Clock finals, a competitor noticed while reconstructing their solves that every single pin was the opposite of what it should have been.

After investigation, it appeared that all scramblers had a misconception about pin scrambling, and made that mistake through the whole round.

The WRC decided to keep the results of the round, since:

  1. it was not the competitors' fault, and
  2. in this specific case, the random distribution of scrambles states was consistently preserved by the mistake. The scrambles in the database were updated to reflect the actual scrambles received by the competitors.

title.zh: 三阶单手还原被认定使用了错误打乱
title.en: 3x3x3 One-Handed Attempt was identified as misscramble

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，规则 11i 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但现在规则已明确规定处理方式。

一名选手在三阶单手第一轮打破单次世界纪录，后来发现魔方打乱错误。

原定打乱：L2 D F2 D2 F2 L2 R2 D F U2 F' R' B2 F D' B2 L2 R' 实际打乱：L2 D F2 D2 F2 L2 R2 D F U2 F' R' B2 F D' B2 L R'

现场给予选手一次暂定的额外尝试。由于实际打乱并非官方生成的打乱，WRC 决定将额外尝试的成绩接受为正式成绩。

相关规则： 4b) 魔方必须使用计算机生成的随机打乱序列打乱。 4g) 打乱后，打乱员必须核对魔方是否打乱正确。如果状态错误，必须纠正，例如还原魔方后重新执行打乱序列。

本决定与多个先例一致。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations.

A competitor broke the single World Record the first round of 3x3x3 One-Handed. It was later found that the cube was not scrambled correctly.

Original scramble: L2 D F2 D2 F2 L2 R2 D F U2 F' R' B2 F D' B2 L2 R' Given scramble: L2 D F2 D2 F2 L2 R2 D F U2 F' R' B2 F D' B2 L R'

A provisional extra attempt was granted to the competitor. The WRC has decided to accept the result of the extra attempt as the official result because the given scramble was not an officially generated scramble.

Relevant Regulations: 4b) Puzzles must be scrambled using computer-generated random scramble sequences. 4g) After scrambling a puzzle, the scrambler must verify that the puzzle is scrambled correctly. If the puzzle state is wrong, the scrambler must correct it (e.g. by solving the puzzle and applying the scramble sequence again).

This decision is in line with several precedents.

title.zh: 选手停表后立即短暂触碰魔方
title.en: A competitor briefly touched the puzzle immediately after stopping the timer

html.zh:
四阶第一轮中，一名选手因成绩而兴奋，在停表后立即短暂触碰了魔方。

由于触碰并非故意，本次还原不予处罚。A6e 将更新，以与此裁定一致。
html.en:
In 4x4x4, first round, a competitor got excited about his result and briefly touched the puzzle immediately after stopping the timer.

Since the touch was unintentional, the solve will not be penalized. The A6e rule will be updated to comply with this ruling.

title.zh: 裁判忘记在选手脸部与魔方之间放置遮挡板（有额外尝试）
title.en: A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle (extra available)

html.zh:
说明：这些事件发生后，B4c 已修改，明确规定：类似情况下，若代表认为选手没有不良意图，可以保留原成绩。

裁判忘记在选手脸部与魔方之间放置遮挡板。该次尝试结束后发现问题，并给予了暂定的额外尝试。WRC 决定接受原成绩，因为没有迹象表明选手利用了这一情况，且错误并非由选手造成。

PBQ Berkeley 2018 也发生了相同情况，当时保留了原尝试成绩。

在许多事件中，WRC 采用的理由是：与其使用流程存在问题的原尝试，不如使用流程正确的额外尝试。WRC 在 PBQ Oshawa 2019 采用了这一理由，以可用的额外尝试替代原尝试。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: After these incidents took place, B4c has been changed to explicitly state that in similar incidents the original solve can stand, if the delegate believes the competitor didn't have any bad intentions

A judge forgot to hold a sheet between the competitor's face and the puzzle. This was found after the end of the attempt and a provisional extra was granted. The WRC decided to accept the result as there was no sign of the competitor abusing the situation and it was not his fault.

The same situation occurred during PBQ Berkeley 2018 where the original attempt was kept.

For a lot of incidents, the WRC used the reasoning that it's better to use an extra attempt where the procedure was correctly followed over an existing attempt where there was a problem with the procedure. The WRC used this reasoning for PBQ Oshawa 2019, where an extra was available and used over the existing attempt.

title.zh: 三阶单手还原被认定使用了错误打乱
title.en: 3x3x3 One-Handed Attempt was identified as misscramble

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理后，规则 11i 已更新。事件结果不会改变，但现在规则已明确规定处理方式。

一名选手在三阶单手第二轮第四次尝试中打破欧洲纪录。复盘时发现魔方打乱错误，漏掉了打乱中间的一步。比赛现场给予选手一次暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 决定以额外尝试替代原尝试。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since the resolution of this incident, the regulation 11i has been updated. The outcome of this incident wouldn't change, but how it should be handled is now explicitely stated in the regulations.

A competitor broke the European Record in his fourth attempt the second round of 3x3x3 One-Handed. When trying to reconstruct the solve, it was discovered that the puzzle was not scrambled correctly (one move in the middle of the scramble was missing). The competitor was granted a provisional extra attempt at the competition.

The WRC decided to replace the original attempt with the extra attempt.

title.zh: 选手签名前，裁判已将魔方送回打乱台
title.en: A judge sent the cube back to the scrambling table before the competitor could sign

html.zh:
Skewb 决赛中，一名选手取得好成绩，表现兴奋。就在他短暂分神时，裁判没有记录成绩，而是将魔方送回打乱台。直到选手意识到自己尚未签名，才发现此事。比赛现场给予了暂定的额外尝试。

WRC 决定保留原成绩。裁判没有遵循规则规定的流程，具体而言，未记录成绩，忽略了 A7b。我们认为不应因此让选手承受不利后果。此外，还有充分证据证明原成绩有效，包括录像和目击证人。
html.en:
In the final round of Skewb, a competitor received a good result and reacted excitedly. While he was inattentive for a short moment, his judge did not write the result down but sent the puzzle back to the scrambling table. This was discovered when the competitor realized he didn't sign for the attempt. A provisional extra attempt was granted at the competition.

The WRC has decided that the original result should be kept. The judge did not follow the approach described in the Regulations. More specifically, he ignored A7b by not recording the result. We believe that this should not result in a disadvantage for the competitor. Furthermore, there was enough proof that the original result was legit (recordings as well as eyewitnesses).

title.zh: 工作人员在代表和主办方不知情的情况下补赛错过的轮次
title.en: Staff member competes in missed rounds without knowledge of Delegate and organizer

html.zh:
一名选手错过了四阶和五阶第一轮。他询问主办方是否还能参赛，遭到拒绝。由于自己也是工作人员，他转而请另一名工作人员为自己的尝试打乱并担任裁判。

WRC 决定删除这两轮的成绩。该选手滥用了工作人员身份，从而获得优待。这也违反了 4b4，因为这些打乱此前已使用过。
html.en:
A competitor was late for the first round of 4x4x4 and 5x5x5. He asked the organizer if it would still be possible to compete, which was denied. As the competitor was also a staff member, he decided to ask a fellow staff member to scramble and judge his attempts.

The WRC has decided that the results of both rounds must be removed. The competitor abused his position as a staff member and got a preferential treatment through this. This was also a violation of 4b4 as the scrambles had already been used earlier.

title.zh: 选手使用前置摄像头录制还原
title.en: Competitor filmed his attempts with a front-facing camera

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理完毕后，规则 2i2a 已更新，允许代表对此类事件酌情判断。

一名选手在二阶第一轮使用前置摄像头，第三次尝试前被发现。他承认此前轮次也采用了相同的摄像头设置。WRC 根据 2i2a 决定将此前的成绩判为 DNF。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: Since resolution of this incident, regulation 2i2a has been updated to allow for delegate discretion for this type of incident.

A competitor used a front-facing camera in the first round of 2x2x2. This was noticed before the 3rd attempt. He admitted he had used the same camera setup in the previous rounds. The WRC decided to DNF the previous results per 2i2a

title.zh: 赛后发现成绩单缺少签名
title.en: Missing signatures found after the competition

html.zh:
赛后发现，Skewb 某次尝试缺少选手和裁判双方的签名。WRC 决定将该成绩改为 DNF。

此事件违反并忽略了 A7b 和 A7c。具体而言，裁判没有确认成绩正确、完整、格式规范且清晰可读，选手也没有核对并签署成绩；这些都是结束一次尝试的必要步骤。

尽管这一决定可能显得严厉，我们认为这些规则对确保成绩正确、有效十分重要。因此，未按 A7b 和 A7c 完成的成绩，不应被接受为有效成绩。
html.en:
Both the competitor's and the judge's signatures were found missing for one attempt in Skewb after the competition. The WRC decided to change the result to DNF.

This incident is violating and ignoring A7b and A7c. More concrete, the judge did not acknowledge that the result is correct, complete, properly formatted, and clearly readable and the competitor did not check and sign the result. These are the steps to finish an attempt.

Although this can be seen as a harsh decision, we believe that these are important regulations to assure the correctness and validness result. For that reason, accepting results which were done without following A7b and A7c, should not be accepted as valid results.

title.zh: 场地布置存在多项问题
title.en: Several issues with the venue setup

html.zh:
该比赛的场地布置存在多项问题和疑虑。主要问题是候场选手能够观看正在比赛的选手；此外，显然还可以通过插队选择打乱组。

一名选手报告了这一有问题的布置；他曾故意试图利用这一情况，在某一轮提前观察打乱。WRC 与其达成一致，将他该轮的所有成绩改为 DNF。
html.en:
There were several issues and concerns regarding the venue setup at this competition. The main point was that waiting competitors were able to watch competing competitors. Additionally, it was obviously possible to choose scramble groups by cutting the waiting line.

The questionable setup was reported by a competitor who intentionally tried to abuse it by pre-inspecting scrambles in one round. The WRC agreed with him to change all his results from this particular round to DNF.

title.zh: 选手误报 Square-1 重复打乱
title.en: Competitor mistakenly reported duplicate scramble in Square-1

html.zh:
一名选手报告，他在 Square-1 第一次和第二次尝试中收到了相同打乱。后来查明两次打乱均正确，因此第二次成绩最初记为 DNF，但现场仍给予了额外尝试。

由于两个形状确实相似，WRC 决定接受额外尝试成绩，以认可选手的诚实，避免使选手不愿报告重复打乱。
html.en:
A competitor reported that he had received the same scrambles for the first and second attempt in Square-1. It turned out that both attempts were scrambled correctly so the result of the second attempt was initially recorded as DNF but an extra attempt was granted.

As both cube shapes were indeed similar, the WRC has decided to accept the result of the extra attempt to acknowledge the honesty of the competitor and to avoid discouraging competitors from reporting repeated scrambles.

title.zh: 三阶多盲时限执行不符合规定
title.en: Irregular enforcement of time limits for 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded

html.zh:
Kansai Open 2018 的三阶多盲采用“两次取最佳”赛制，并在通常时限之外使用累计时限。WCA 指导明确说明，三阶多盲不能采用累计时限。

WRC 决定删除第二次尝试的全部成绩。此决定仅影响一名选手，其他成绩均为 DNS。
html.en:
At Kansai Open 2018, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind was held as "Best of 2" with a cumulative time limit in combination with the regular time limit. The WCA Guidelines clarify it is not possible to hold 3x3x3 Multi-Blind with a cumulative time limit.

The WRC has decided that all results of the second attempt should be removed. This decision only affected one comeptitor (all other results were DNS).

title.zh: 代表意外重复使用先前比赛的打乱
title.en: Delegate accidentally reused scrambles from previous competition

html.zh:
ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 的代表在本场比赛多个轮次中，意外使用了先前比赛 STEM Educ8 2018 的打乱。这些打乱在前一场比赛成绩公布后已可公开获取。

WRC 决定，不接受 ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 所有受影响成绩为 WCA 正式成绩，涉及二阶、三阶、四阶、三阶单手、金字塔及 Square-1。因此，只有五魔方和七阶的成绩得到认可。

我们知道，这一严厉决定会影响许多年轻选手。然而，WCA 比赛打乱的完整性至关重要，在此不能宽免。
html.en:
The delegate of ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 accidentally used scrambles from a prior competition (STEM Educ8 2018) for multiple rounds of this competition. These scrambles have been publicly accesible since the results of the earlier competition were published.

The WRC has decided that all affected results of ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 will not be accepted as official WCA results. These are: 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and Square-1. Accordingly, only the results of Megaminx and 7x7x7 Cube will be recognized.

We know that this is a harsh decision with consequences for many young competitors. However, the integrity of scrambles in WCA competitions is essential and does not allow us to be lenient here.

title.zh: 选手在以往比赛的部分单手还原中使用胸部辅助
title.en: Competitor used his chest in some OH attempts in previous competitions

html.zh:
发现一名选手在单手还原中使用胸部辅助。与代表讨论时，该选手提到自己在以前的比赛中也这样做过。没有可用的视频证据，无法追溯确定哪些次还原因使用胸部而违反规则。

WRC 决定不取消任何以往成绩，因为无法查明哪些次还原受到影响。此外，过去这些情况均未被裁判发现，因此我们认为选手使用胸部并未取得显著优势。
html.en:
A competitor was found using his chest during One-Handed. When discussing this issue with the delegate, the competitor mentioned he had also done this in previous competitions. There is no video proof available to retroactively identify the attempts in which he broke the Regulations by using his chest.

The WRC has decided to not disqualify any of the prior attempts as it is not possible to track which attempts where affected. Additionally, as none of the past cases were noticed by judges, we believe the competitor did not have a significant advantage by using his chest.

title.zh: 使用当时非官方的 TNoodle 版本生成打乱
title.en: Non-currently-official version of TNoodle used to generate scrambles

html.zh: 比赛打乱使用旧版 TNoodle 生成。最终决定接受该比赛成绩为正式成绩。
html.en: Competition scrambles were generated using an old version of TNoodle. The decision was to accept the competition results as official.

title.zh: 筛选打乱
title.en: Scramble filtering

html.zh:
说明：此事件处理完毕后，规则 4b1 已修改，明确禁止代表筛选打乱。

二阶决赛中出现了一个非常幸运的打乱。一名选手以此取得国家纪录（NR），大家都前去祝贺。代表怀疑还原情况已经泄露，因此更换了打乱组。所有还原成绩均予保留。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: After the resolution of this incident, regulation 4b1 has been changed to explicitely disallow scramble filtering by delegates.

There was a very lucky scramble during the 2x2x2 Cube final. A competitor got NR on that scramble, and everyone went to congratulate him. The Delegate changed the scramble group suspecting filtration of the solve. All the solves were kept.

title.zh: 三阶脚拧使用非官方 Stackmat 计时器
title.en: 3x3x3 With Feet solving with a non-official Stackmat

html.zh: 发现一名选手使用非官方 Stackmat 计时器进行三阶脚拧；该计时器并非组织团队提供。现场给予了额外尝试。裁定认为，提供比赛器材是组织团队的责任，并接受了额外尝试的成绩。
html.en: One competitor was found to be using a non-official Stackmat timer, which wasn't provided by the organization team for the 3x3x3 With Feet event, and it was granted an extra attempt. It was decided that the organization team is responsible to provide the competition equipment, and the result of the extra attempt was accepted.

title.zh: 计时器运行偏慢
title.en: Timer ran in slow mode

html.zh: 一名选手取得了 7.51 秒的成绩。查看还原视频时，明显看出实际还原用时超过 7 秒。检查发现，双手抬起后计时器会停顿一段时间。该计时器被撤下，代表给予了额外尝试。
html.en: A competitor set a time of 7.51 seconds. When checking the video of the solve, it was clear that the solve took more than 7 seconds. The timer was checked and it was found that the timer would stop for a while after lifting both hands. The timer was removed and an extra attempt was granted by the Delegate.

title.zh: 三阶盲拧成功还原时未使用遮挡板
title.en: 3x3x3 Blindfolded solve without sight blocker

html.zh:
一次成功还原中，裁判未使用遮挡板。为预防后续需要，现场给予了一次额外尝试，但理事会决定保留原成绩。

此类情况更新后的裁定，请参阅这条事件日志。
html.en:
A judge did not use a sight blocker in a succesful solve. An extra attempt was granted just in case, but the Board decided that the original result should stand.

For an updated ruling on this type of cases please see this Incident Log.

title.zh: 五阶盲拧成绩未写入成绩单
title.en: 5x5x5 Blindfolded result missing on the score sheet

html.zh: 一名选手成功完成五阶盲拧，但成绩未写入成绩单。选手录下了该次还原，因此从视频中恢复了用时，并将成绩接受为正式成绩。
html.en: A competitor got a succesful 5x5x5 Blindfolded solve. The result wasn't written on the score sheet, but the competitor had recorded the solve, so the time was retrieved from the video and the result accepted as official.

title.zh: 盲拧项目中可通过触摸辨别的标志
title.en: Perceptible logos for Blindfolded events

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，按规则 3l，三阶盲拧现已允许标志，但其他盲拧项目仍不允许。

比赛中发现，许多选手在盲拧项目中使用了可通过触摸辨别的标志。这些选手被要求移除这些标志。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, logos are now permitted for 3x3 Blindfolded, but not other blindfolded events per regulation 3l

During the competition, it was noticed that a lot of competitors were using perceptible logos for Blindfolded events. The competitors were asked to remove such logos.

title.zh: EnChroma 眼镜
title.en: EnChroma glasses

html.zh: 一名轻度色盲的美国选手正在试用名为 EnChroma 的特殊色盲眼镜，其作用是滤除部分光谱。经决定，此类眼镜不太可能带来不公平优势，应根据现行规则允许使用。
html.en: A mildly colorblind US competitor is trying out special glasses for the colorblind called EnChroma that block out some parts of the color spectrum. It has been decided that these glasses are not likely to offer an unfair advantage, and should be allowed under the current Regulations.

title.zh: 三阶脚拧时未使用垫子
title.en: 3x3x3 With Feet solving without a Mat

html.zh: 发现一名选手在三阶脚拧中未使用垫子，组织团队也未为该项目提供垫子，该选手因此被取消该项目资格。裁定认为，提供比赛器材是组织团队的责任，本应给予选手额外尝试。
html.en: One competitor was found doing their attempts without a Mat, which was not provided by the organization team for the 3x3x3 With Feet event, and it was disqualified from the event. It was decided that the organization team is responsible to provide the competition equipment, and that the competitor should have been granted extra attempts.

title.zh: 选手在多盲中使用了一个带标志的魔方
title.en: A competitor used one cube with a logo in a Multi-Blind attempt

html.zh:
说明：截至 2025 年，规则 3k2b 已明确规定，多盲中带标志的魔方应计为未还原。

一名选手在多盲中使用了一个带标志的魔方，直到该次尝试结束后才被发现。按当时规则 3k2，使用不允许的魔方会导致整次尝试 DNF。由于这对多盲而言后果过于严厉，WRC 决定仅将不符合规定的那个魔方计为未还原，不影响其他魔方。WRC 正在讨论如何修改规则以体现这一处理原则（见 GitHub issue）。
html.en:
DISCLAIMER: As of 2025, there is now a clear regulation, regulation 3k2b, that states that cubes with a logo during multiblind should count as unsolved.

A competitor used a cube with a logo in his Multi-Blind attempt. This was only found after the attempt. Currently, according to 3k2, using a non-permitted puzzle results in DNF of the attempt. As this would be a very harsh consequence in Multi-Blind, the WRC has decided count the non-permitted puzzle as unsolved, without affecting other puzzles The WRC is discussing how to revise the Regulations to reflect this policy (see GitHub issue).

title.zh: 关于盲拧的重要公告
title.en: Important announcement about blindfolded solving

html.zh: WCA 已在 WCA 论坛发布一项关于盲拧的重要公告。
html.en: WCA made an important announcement about blindfolded solving on the WCA forum.

title.zh: 关于盲拧的重要公告
title.en: Important announcement about blindfolded solving

html.zh:
各位社群成员：

WCA 董事会经过广泛调查，并与该选手进行了多次交谈后，得出结论：已有毫无疑问的证据表明，2007 年盲拧世界纪录保持者在多场 WCA 比赛的盲拧项目中作弊。该选手并未承认作弊。

证据

证据显示，该选手通过从眼罩下方偷看来作弊。

这些证据来自对 WCA 比赛中多次盲拧还原录像的分析。许多录像都强烈表明存在作弊，因为该选手使用了复杂的方法，且还原成功率达到 100%（77 次还原全部正确）。使用这种方法还原魔方角块时，许多棱块和角块的位置和／或朝向会发生改变。

2007 年世界锦标赛多盲项目的一段录像提供了毫无疑问的证据。录像显示，该选手在执行某一步骤时犯了错误（错误地撤销预设步骤），却没有纠正该错误，而是重新开始还原魔方。只有该选手看到了自己犯错，才可能这样做。否则，他要么会撤销错误的转动，要么就无法再将魔方还原。

裁定

WCA 作出以下裁定：

  • 自今日起，禁止该选手参加所有 WCA 比赛，为期三年。如果该选手充分配合 WCA，可在两年后申诉请求恢复参赛资格。
  • WCA 已将该选手的全部盲拧还原成绩改为 DNF（未完成）。
  • WCA 已要求该选手将盲拧项目所得奖金退还给比赛组织者，以便组织者重新分配奖金。

其他措施

为防止今后在盲拧项目中作弊，WCA 决定采取以下措施：

所有依照《WCA 比赛规则 2007》举办的比赛都必须执行一项临时规则。在预计于 2008 年 3 月发布的《WCA 比赛规则 2008》中，这项新增规则将与其他一些预防措施一并正式纳入。

该规则要求在还原阶段，将一张纸（或类似物品）置于选手面部与魔方之间。WCA 正在寻找一种容易获得、兼顾坐姿和站姿还原、且不需要裁判一直手持纸张的装置。

WCA 希望向以下人员致敬：

  • 新的世界纪录保持者：Danyang Chen、Chris Hardwick（两次）及 Dennis Strehlau。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的世界冠军：Rafal Guzewicz（两次）及 Chris Hardwick。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的银牌得主：Shotaro Makisumi、Dror Vomberg、Bernett Orlando。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的铜牌得主：Tyson Mao、Yumu Tabuchi、Sinpei Araki。
  • 所有其他因该选手作弊而受到损害的人。

沟通

由于该选手当时尚未满 18 岁，WCA 不会在对外沟通中使用其姓名。出于同样原因，WCA 仅向少数相关方提供了此事的详细报告。我们恳请社群共同保护该选手的隐私。

如果社群成员怀疑其他成员作弊，WCA 鼓励他们联系 WCA 董事会，而不是公开发表声明和／或助长不友善的公开讨论。

这项裁定是 WCA 作出的一个非常艰难的决定，但一项有组织的运动如果不执行规则，便失去了意义。WCA 感谢所有协助此次调查的人。

欢迎所有社群成员在 WCA 论坛回应这份公告。所有涉及个人指涉或敌意表达的消息都会受到版主管理。

WCA 的使命

WCA 的使命是：在公平的条件下，让更多国家举办更多比赛，让更多人参与并获得更多乐趣。

致以诚挚的问候，

WCA 董事会

  • Gilles Roux（法国）
  • Masayuki Akimoto（日本）
  • Ron van Bruchem（荷兰）
  • Tyson Mao（美国）
html.en:
Fellow members of our community,

WCA board has come to the conclusion that there is proof beyond any doubt that the 2007 world record holder for blindfolded solving has cheated in the blindfolded events of several WCA competitions. The conclusion of WCA board has come after extensive investigations and a number of conversations with the competitor. The competitor has not confessed.

Proof Proof shows that the competitor cheated by peeking underneath the blindfold. The proof consists of the analysis of videos of several blindfolded solves in WCA competitions. Many videos gave a strong indication of cheating, because of the applied complex method combined with a flawless accuracy (77 correct solves out of 77 solves). The method had the effect that many edge and corner pieces changed positions and/or orientation while solving the corners of the cube. One video of the multiple blindfolded event in World Championship 2007 brought proof beyond any doubt. The video shows that the competitor made an error (incorrect undo of set-up moves) during the execution of a step, and that instead of correcting the error, the competitor started solving the cube again. This is only possible if the competitor would have seen that he had made a mistake. Otherwise he would either have undone his incorrect moves, or he would not have been able to solve the cube anymore.

Verdict WCA has come to the following verdict.

  • WCA has banned the competitor for three years for all WCA competitions, starting today. The competitor may appeal for reinstatement after two years, if he fully cooperates with WCA.
  • WCA has changed all blindfolded solves of the competitor to the result DNF (did not finish).
  • WCA has requested the competitor to return his prize money in blindfolded events to the competition organisers. The organisers can then redistribute the prize money.

Other measurements WCA has come to the following measurement to prevent future cheating in the blindfolded event: A temporary regulation must be applied for all competitions under WCA Regulations 2007. For WCA Regulations 2008 (expected March 2008) the additional regulation will be fully integrated, including some other preventive measurements. The regulation consists of placing a sheet of paper (or a similar object) between the face of a competitor and the cube during the solving phase. WCA is looking for a widely available multi-purpose (solving while sitting and while standing) device that would not require the judge to constantly hold the paper.

WCA wants to honour:

  • the new world record holders: Danyang Chen, Chris Hardwick (twice) and Dennis Strehlau.
  • the new world champions of World Championship 2007: Rafal Guzewicz (twice) and Chris Hardwick.
  • the new silver medal winners of World Championship 2007: Shotaro Makisumi, Dror Vomberg, Bernett Orlando
  • the new bronze medal winners of World Championship 2007: Tyson Mao, Yumu Tabuchi, Sinpei Araki
  • all others who were damaged by the cheating of the competitor.

Communication WCA will not use the competitor’s name in communication because the competitor is still under 18 years of age. For the same reason WCA distributed a detailed report on this matter only to a small number of involved parties. We kindly request our community to support the privacy of the competitor.

WCA encourages members of our community who have suspicions of cheating by other members to contact the WCA board, instead of making public announcements and/or feeding unfriendly public discussions. The verdict is a very difficult decision by the WCA, but an organised sport is meaningless if its rules are not enforced. WCA would like to extend gratitude to everyone who assisted in this investigation.

All members of our community are welcome to respond to this announcement on the WCA forum. All messages with personal references or hostile expressions will be moderated.

Mission of WCA The mission of WCA is: more competitions in more countries with more people and more fun, under fair conditions.

Kind regards,

WCA Board Gilles Roux (France) Masayuki Akimoto (Japan) Ron van Bruchem (Netherlands) Tyson Mao (USA)
